verses.textZh: 神的儿子 耶稣基督福音的开始。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的儿子 耶稣基督福音的开始。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的儿子，耶稣基督福音的起头。
verses.textEnNiv: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,
verses.textEnEsv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the Good News about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God. It began
verses.textEnNasb: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God,
verses.textEn: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,

verses.textZh: 正如以赛亚先知的书上写着： "看哪，我差遣我的使者在你面前， 预备你的道路；
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如以赛亚先知的书上写着： "看哪，我差遣我的使者在你面前， 预备你的道路；
verses.textZhCuv: 正如先知以赛亚 书上记着说： 看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面， 预备道路。
verses.textEnNiv: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: "I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way" —
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet, "Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way,
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written in the Prophets: "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You."
verses.textEnNlt: just as the prophet Isaiah had written: "Look, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, and he will prepare your way.
verses.textEnNasb: just as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: "Behold, I am sending My messenger before You, Who will prepare Your way;
verses.textEn: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: "I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way" —

verses.textZh: 在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路。
verses.textEnNiv: "a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: the voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight,’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; Make His paths straight.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He is a voice shouting in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord ’s coming! Clear the road for him!’ "
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of one calling out in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, Make His paths straight!’ "
verses.textEn: "a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ "

verses.textZh: 照这话，施洗的约翰在旷野出现了，传讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照这话，施洗的约翰在旷野出现了，传讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
verses.textZhCuv: 照这话，约翰来了，在旷野施洗，传悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
verses.textEnNiv: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: John appeared, baptizing in the wilderness and proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: This messenger was John the Baptist. He was in the wilderness and preached that people should be baptized to show that they had repented of their sins and turned to God to be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEn: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.textZh: 犹太全地和全耶路撒冷的人，都出来到他那里去，承认自己的罪，在约旦河里受了他的洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太全地和全耶路撒冷的人，都出来到他那里去，承认自己的罪，在约旦河里受了他的洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到约翰那里，承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the country of Judea and all Jerusalem were going out to him and were being baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the land of Judea, and those from Jerusalem, went out to him and were all baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
verses.textEnNlt: All of Judea, including all the people of Jerusalem, went out to see and hear John. And when they confessed their sins, he baptized them in the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the country of Judea was going out to him, and all the people of Jerusalem; and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
verses.textEn: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

verses.textZh: 约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫和野蜜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫和野蜜。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。
verses.textEnNiv: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnEsv: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair and wore a leather belt around his waist and ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now John was clothed with camel’s hair and with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNlt: His clothes were woven from coarse camel hair, and he wore a leather belt around his waist. For food he ate locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEnNasb: John was clothed with camel’s hair and wore a leather belt around his waist, and his diet was locusts and wild honey.
verses.textEn: John wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

verses.textZh: 他传讲说："有一位在我以后来的，能力比我大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带都没有资格。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他传讲说："有一位在我以后来的，能力比我大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带都没有资格。
verses.textZhCuv: 他传道说：「有一位在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带也是不配的。
verses.textEnNiv: And this was his message: "After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
verses.textEnEsv: And he preached, saying, "After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he preached, saying, "There comes One after me who is mightier than I, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.
verses.textEnNlt: John announced: "Someone is coming soon who is greater than I am—so much greater that I’m not even worthy to stoop down like a slave and untie the straps of his sandals.
verses.textEnNasb: And he was preaching, saying, "After me One is coming who is mightier than I, and I am not fit to bend down and untie the straps of His sandals.
verses.textEn: And this was his message: "After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.

verses.textZh: 我用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我是用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。」
verses.textEnNiv: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: I have baptized you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: I indeed baptized you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit!"
verses.textEnNasb: I baptized you with water; but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEn: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

verses.textZh: 那时候耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约旦河里受了约翰的洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时候耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约旦河里受了约翰的洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约旦河里受了 约翰的洗。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass in those days that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
verses.textEn: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子降在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子降在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子，降在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came up out of the water, immediately he saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately, coming up from the water, He saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending upon Him like a dove.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus came up out of the water, he saw the heavens splitting apart and the Holy Spirit descending on him like a dove.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately coming up out of the water, He saw the heavens opening, and the Spirit, like a dove, descending upon Him;
verses.textEn: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

verses.textZh: 又有声音从天上来说："你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有声音从天上来说："你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有声音从天上来，说：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」
verses.textEnNiv: And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
verses.textEnEsv: And a voice came from heaven, "You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a voice came from heaven, "You are My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNlt: And a voice from heaven said, "You are my dearly loved Son, and you bring me great joy."
verses.textEnNasb: and a voice came from the heavens: "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."
verses.textEn: And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."

verses.textZh: 圣灵随即催促耶稣到旷野去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵随即催促耶稣到旷野去。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵就把耶稣催到旷野里去。
verses.textEnNiv: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit immediately drove him out into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately the Spirit drove Him into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit then compelled Jesus to go into the wilderness,
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately the Spirit *brought Him out into the wilderness.
verses.textEn: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,

verses.textZh: 他在那里四十天，受撒但的试探，和野兽在一起，有天使来服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在那里四十天，受撒但的试探，和野兽在一起，有天使来服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在旷野四十天，受撒但的试探，并与野兽同在一处，且有天使来伺候他。
verses.textEnNiv: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. And he was with the wild animals, and the angels were ministering to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan, and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: where he was tempted by Satan for forty days. He was out among the wild animals, and angels took care of him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was in the wilderness for forty days, being tempted by Satan; and He was with the wild animals, and the angels were serving Him.
verses.textEn: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.

verses.textZh: 约翰被捕以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣讲神的福音，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰被捕以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣讲神的福音，
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰下监以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣传神的福音，
verses.textEnNiv: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Now after John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee, proclaiming the gospel of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after John was put in prison, Jesus came to Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
verses.textEnNlt: Later on, after John was arrested, Jesus went into Galilee, where he preached God’s Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,
verses.textEn: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.

verses.textZh: <red>说："时候到了，神的国近了，你们应当悔改，相信福音。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说："时候到了，神的国近了，你们应当悔改，相信福音。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「<red>日期满了，神的国近了。你们当悔改，信福音！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“The time has come,”</red> he said. <red>“The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent and believe in the gospel."
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent, and believe in the gospel."
verses.textEnNlt: "The time promised by God has come at last!" he announced. "The Kingdom of God is near! Repent of your sins and believe the Good News!"
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God has come near; repent and believe in the gospel."
verses.textEn: <red>“The time has come,”</red> he said. <red>“The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣沿着加利利海边行走，看见西门和他弟弟安得烈在海上撒网；他们是渔夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣沿着加利利海边行走，看见西门和他弟弟安得烈在海上撒网；他们是渔夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣顺着加利利的海边走，看见西门和西门的兄弟安得烈在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.
verses.textEnEsv: Passing alongside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as He walked by the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Jesus was walking along the shore of the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew throwing a net into the water, for they fished for a living.
verses.textEnNasb: As He was going along the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net in the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.textEn: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣就对他们说："来跟从我，我要使你们成为得人的渔夫。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣就对他们说："来跟从我，我要使你们成为得人的渔夫。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Come, follow me,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“and I will send you out to fish for people.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Follow me, and I will make you become fishers of men."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "Follow Me, and I will make you become fishers of men."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus called out to them, "Come, follow me, and I will show you how to fish for people!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Follow Me, and I will have you become fishers of people."
verses.textEn: <red>“Come, follow me,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“and I will send you out to fish for people.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们立刻撇下网，跟从了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们立刻撇下网，跟从了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。
verses.textEnNiv: At once they left their nets and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately they left their nets and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: They immediately left their nets and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And they left their nets at once and followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.
verses.textEn: At once they left their nets and followed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣稍往前走，看见西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的弟弟约翰，正在船上整理鱼网，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣稍往前走，看见西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的弟弟约翰，正在船上整理鱼网，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣稍往前走，又见西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰在船上补网。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.
verses.textEnEsv: And going on a little farther, he saw James the son of Zebedee and John his brother, who were in their boat mending the nets.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had gone a little farther from there, He saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending their nets.
verses.textEnNlt: A little farther up the shore Jesus saw Zebedee’s sons, James and John, in a boat repairing their nets.
verses.textEnNasb: And going on a little farther, He saw James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
verses.textEn: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.

verses.textZh: 他立即呼召他们。他们撇下父亲西庇太和雇工在船上，就跟从他去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他立即呼召他们。他们撇下父亲西庇太和雇工在船上，就跟从他去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣随即招呼他们，他们就把父亲 西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟从耶稣去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately He called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He called them at once, and they also followed him, leaving their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired men.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately He called them; and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men, and went away to follow Him.
verses.textEn: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.

verses.textZh: 他们到了迦百农，耶稣随即在安息日进入会堂教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了迦百农，耶稣随即在安息日进入会堂教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了迦百农，耶稣就在安息日进了会堂教训人。
verses.textEnNiv: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath he entered the synagogue and was teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus and his companions went to the town of Capernaum. When the Sabbath day came, he went into the synagogue and began to teach.
verses.textEnNasb: They *went into Capernaum; and immediately on the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and began to teach.
verses.textEn: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.

verses.textZh: 大家对他的教训都很惊奇，因为他教导他们，像一个有权柄的人，不像经学家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家对他的教训都很惊奇，因为他教导他们，像一个有权柄的人，不像经学家。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人很希奇他的教训；因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像文士。
verses.textEnNiv: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were astonished at His teaching, for He taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.textEnNlt: The people were amazed at his teaching, for he taught with real authority—quite unlike the teachers of religious law.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were amazed at His teaching; for He was teaching them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.textEn: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.

verses.textZh: 就在那时，会堂里有一个被污灵附着的人，喊叫起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时，会堂里有一个被污灵附着的人，喊叫起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 在会堂里，有一个人被污鬼附着。他喊叫说：
verses.textEnNiv: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit. And he cried out,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit. And he cried out,
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, a man in the synagogue who was possessed by an evil spirit cried out,
verses.textEnNasb: Just then there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
verses.textEn: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,

verses.textZh: 说："拿撒勒人耶稣，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？你来毁灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："拿撒勒人耶稣，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？你来毁灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是神的圣者。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnEsv: "What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are— the Holy One of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Let us alone! What have we to do with You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you interfering with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "What business do You have with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are: the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEn: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣斥责他说："住口！从他身上出来！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣斥责他说："住口！从他身上出来！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣责备他说：「<red>不要作声！从这人身上出来吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bep quiet!”</red> said Jesus sternly. <red>“Come out of him!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silent, and come out of him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus reprimanded him. "Be quiet! Come out of the man," he ordered.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"
verses.textEn: <red>“Bep quiet!”</red> said Jesus sternly. <red>“Come out of him!”</red>

verses.textZh: 污灵使那人抽疯，大声喊叫，就从他身上出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 污灵使那人抽疯，大声喊叫，就从他身上出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 污鬼叫那人抽了一阵风，大声喊叫，就出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.
verses.textEnEsv: And the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying out with a loud voice, came out of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the unclean spirit had convulsed him and cried out with a loud voice, he came out of him.
verses.textEnNlt: At that, the evil spirit screamed, threw the man into a convulsion, and then came out of him.
verses.textEnNasb: After throwing him into convulsions and crying out with a loud voice, the unclean spirit came out of him.
verses.textEn: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.

verses.textZh: 众人都很惊讶，于是彼此对问说："这是怎么一回事？是个有权能的新道理啊！他吩咐污灵，污灵竟服从了他！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都很惊讶，于是彼此对问说："这是怎么一回事？是个有权能的新道理啊！他吩咐污灵，污灵竟服从了他！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都惊讶，以致彼此对问说：「这是什么事？是个新道理啊！他用权柄吩咐污鬼，连污鬼也听从了他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, "What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him."
verses.textEnEsv: And they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? What new doctrine is this? For with authority He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him."
verses.textEnNlt: Amazement gripped the audience, and they began to discuss what had happened. "What sort of new teaching is this?" they asked excitedly. "It has such authority! Even evil spirits obey his orders!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they were all amazed, so they debated among themselves, saying, "What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him."
verses.textEn: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, "What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him."

verses.textZh: 耶稣的名声立刻传遍了加利利一带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的名声立刻传遍了加利利一带。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的名声就传遍了加利利的四方。
verses.textEnNiv: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: And at once his fame spread everywhere throughout all the surrounding region of Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately His fame spread throughout all the region around Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: The news about Jesus spread quickly throughout the entire region of Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately the news about Him spread everywhere into all the surrounding region of Galilee.
verses.textEn: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.

verses.textZh: 他们一出会堂，就和雅各、约翰到西门和安得烈的家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一出会堂，就和雅各、约翰到西门和安得烈的家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们一出会堂，就同着雅各、约翰，进了西门和安得烈的家。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he left the synagogue and entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as soon as they had come out of the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.textEnNlt: After Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went to Simon and Andrew’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately after they left the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
verses.textEn: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

verses.textZh: 西门的岳母正在发烧躺着，他们立刻告诉耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门的岳母正在发烧躺着，他们立刻告诉耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门的岳母正害热病躺着，就有人告诉耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Simon’s mother-in-law lay ill with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and they told Him about her at once.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a high fever. They told Jesus about her right away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Simon’s mother-in-law was lying sick with a fever; and they immediately *spoke to Jesus about her.
verses.textEn: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.

verses.textZh: 耶稣走到她面前，拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走到她面前，拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进前拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and the fever left her, and she began to serve them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and immediately the fever left her. And she served them.
verses.textEnNlt: So he went to her bedside, took her by the hand, and helped her sit up. Then the fever left her, and she prepared a meal for them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He came to her and raised her up, taking her by the hand, and the fever left her, and she served them.
verses.textEn: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.

verses.textZh: 到了黄昏，有人不断把生病的和被鬼附的，都带到耶稣面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了黄昏，有人不断把生病的和被鬼附的，都带到耶稣面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 天晚日落的时候，有人带着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，来到耶稣跟前。
verses.textEnNiv: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.
verses.textEnEsv: That evening at sundown they brought to him all who were sick or oppressed by demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to Him all who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening after sunset, many sick and demon-possessed people were brought to Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when evening came, after the sun had set, they began bringing to Him all who were ill and those who were demon-possessed.
verses.textEn: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.

verses.textZh: 全城的人都聚集在门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全城的人都聚集在门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 合城的人都聚集在门前。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole town gathered at the door,
verses.textEnEsv: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole town gathered at the door to watch.
verses.textEnNasb: And the whole city had gathered at the door.
verses.textEn: The whole town gathered at the door,

verses.textZh: 耶稣医好了各样的病，也赶出许多的鬼，并且不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣医好了各样的病，也赶出许多的鬼，并且不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣治好了许多害各样病的人，又赶出许多鬼，不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。
verses.textEnNiv: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.
verses.textEnEsv: And he healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. And he would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and He did not allow the demons to speak, because they knew Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus healed many people who were sick with various diseases, and he cast out many demons. But because the demons knew who he was, he did not allow them to speak.
verses.textEnNasb: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and He would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
verses.textEn: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.

verses.textZh: 次日凌晨，天还没有亮，耶稣起身出去，来到荒野的地方，在那里祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日凌晨，天还没有亮，耶稣起身出去，来到荒野的地方，在那里祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，天未亮的时候，耶稣起来，到旷野地方去，在那里祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
verses.textEnEsv: And rising very early in the morning, while it was still dark, he departed and went out to a desolate place, and there he prayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the morning, having risen a long while before daylight, He went out and departed to a solitary place; and there He prayed.
verses.textEnNlt: Before daybreak the next morning, Jesus got up and went out to an isolated place to pray.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the early morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went away to a secluded place, and prayed there for a time.
verses.textEn: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.

verses.textZh: 西门和那些跟他在一起的人就去寻找耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门和那些跟他在一起的人就去寻找耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门和同伴追了他去，
verses.textEnNiv: Simon and his companions went to look for him,
verses.textEnEsv: And Simon and those who were with him searched for him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Simon and those whowere with Him searched for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Later Simon and the others went out to find him.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon and his companions eagerly searched for Him;
verses.textEn: Simon and his companions went to look for him,

verses.textZh: 他们找到了，就对他说："大家都在找你呢！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们找到了，就对他说："大家都在找你呢！"
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见了就对他说：「众人都找你。」
verses.textEnNiv: and when they found him, they exclaimed: "Everyone is looking for you!"
verses.textEnEsv: and they found him and said to him, "Everyone is looking for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they found Him, they said to Him, "Everyone is looking for You."
verses.textEnNlt: When they found him, they said, "Everyone is looking for you."
verses.textEnNasb: and they found Him and *said to Him, "Everyone is looking for You."
verses.textEn: and when they found him, they exclaimed: "Everyone is looking for you!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我们到邻近的乡镇去吧，我也好在那里传道，因为我就是为这事而来的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我们到邻近的乡镇去吧，我也好在那里传道，因为我就是为这事而来的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>我们可以往别处去，到邻近的乡村，我也好在那里传道，因为我是为这事出来的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Let us go on to the next towns, that I may preach there also, for that is why I came out."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because for this purpose I have come forth."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "We must go on to other towns as well, and I will preach to them, too. That is why I came."
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to them, "Let’s go somewhere else to the towns nearby, so that I may also preach there; for this is why I came."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他走遍加利利全地，在他们的会堂里传道，并且赶鬼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他走遍加利利全地，在他们的会堂里传道，并且赶鬼。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是在加利利全地，进了会堂，传道，赶鬼。
verses.textEnNiv: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went throughout all Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and casting out demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was preaching in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and casting out demons.
verses.textEnNlt: So he traveled throughout the region of Galilee, preaching in the synagogues and casting out demons.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went into their synagogues preaching throughout Galilee, and casting out the demons.
verses.textEn: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

verses.textZh: 有一个患痲风的人，来到耶稣跟前，跪下求他说："如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个患痲风的人，来到耶稣跟前，跪下求他说："如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个长大麻风的来求耶稣，向他跪下，说：「你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, "If you are willing, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnEsv: And a leper came to him, imploring him, and kneeling said to him, "If you will, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a leper came to Him, imploring Him, kneeling down to Him and saying to Him, "If You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEnNlt: A man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus, begging to be healed. "If you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: And a man with leprosy *came to Jesus, imploring Him and kneeling down, and saying to Him, "If You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEn: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, "If you are willing, you can make me clean."

verses.textZh: 耶稣动了怜悯的心，就伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣动了怜悯的心，就伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣动了慈心，就伸手摸他，说：「<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Moved with pity, he stretched out his hand and touched him and said to him, "I will; be clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus, moved with compassion, stretched out His hand and touched him, and said to him, "I am willing; be cleansed."
verses.textEnNlt: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!"
verses.textEnNasb: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out with His hand and touched him, and *said to him, "I am willing; be cleansed."
verses.textEn: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red>

verses.textZh: 痲风立刻离开了他，他就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 痲风立刻离开了他，他就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大麻风即时离开他，他就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately the leprosy left him, and he was made clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as He had spoken, immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly the leprosy disappeared, and the man was healed.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.
verses.textEn: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.

verses.textZh: 耶稣打发那人离开以前，严厉地吩咐他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣打发那人离开以前，严厉地吩咐他，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣严严地嘱咐他，就打发他走，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus sternly charged him and sent him away at once,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He strictly warned him and sent him away at once,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus sent him on his way with a stern warning:
verses.textEnNasb: And He sternly warned him and immediately sent him away,
verses.textEn: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:

verses.textZh: <red>说："你千万不可把这事告诉任何人，你只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的，为你得洁净献祭，好向大家作证。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说："你千万不可把这事告诉任何人，你只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的，为你得洁净献祭，好向大家作证。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「<red>你要谨慎，什么话都不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又因为你洁净了，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“See that you don’t tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, for a proof to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t tell anyone about this. Instead, go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."
verses.textEnNasb: and He *said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.textEn: <red>“See that you don’t tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 但那人出来，竟任意传讲，就把这事传开了，以致耶稣不能再公开进城，只好留在外边荒野的地方；然而还是有人从各处到他那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那人出来，竟任意传讲，就把这事传开了，以致耶稣不能再公开进城，只好留在外边荒野的地方；然而还是有人从各处到他那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人出去，倒说许多的话，把这件事传扬开了，叫耶稣以后不得再明明地进城，只好在外边旷野地方。人从各处都就了他来。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.
verses.textEnEsv: But he went out and began to talk freely about it, and to spread the news, so that Jesus could no longer openly enter a town, but was out in desolate places, and people were coming to him from every quarter.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, he went out and began to proclaim it freely, and to spread the matter, so that Jesus could no longer openly enter the city, but was outside in deserted places; and they came to Him from every direction.
verses.textEnNlt: But the man went and spread the word, proclaiming to everyone what had happened. As a result, large crowds soon surrounded Jesus, and he couldn’t publicly enter a town anywhere. He had to stay out in the secluded places, but people from everywhere kept coming to him.
verses.textEnNasb: But he went out and began to proclaim it freely and to spread the news around, to such an extent that Jesus could no longer publicly enter a city, but stayed out in unpopulated areas; and they were coming to Him from everywhere.
verses.textEn: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.

verses.textZh: 过了些日子，耶稣再回到迦百农。一听说他在屋子里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了些日子，耶稣再回到迦百农。一听说他在屋子里，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了些日子，耶稣又进了迦百农。人听见他在房子里，
verses.textEnNiv: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he returned to Capernaum after some days, it was reported that he was at home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And again He entered Capernaum after some days, and it was heard that He was in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus returned to Capernaum several days later, the news spread quickly that he was back home.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus came back to Capernaum a few days later, it was heard that He was at home.
verses.textEn: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.

verses.textZh: 许多人就都来聚集，甚至连门前都没有地方了，耶稣就对他们讲道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人就都来聚集，甚至连门前都没有地方了，耶稣就对他们讲道。
verses.textZhCuv: 就有许多人聚集，甚至连门前都没有空地；耶稣就对他们讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even at the door. And he was preaching the word to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately many gathered together, so that there was no longer room to receive them, not even near the door. And He preached the word to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the house where he was staying was so packed with visitors that there was no more room, even outside the door. While he was preaching God’s word to them,
verses.textEnNasb: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer space, not even near the door; and He was speaking the word to them.
verses.textEn: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.

verses.textZh: 那时有人把一个瘫子带到耶稣那里，是由四个人抬来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有人把一个瘫子带到耶稣那里，是由四个人抬来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人带着一个瘫子来见耶稣，是用四个人抬来的；
verses.textEnNiv: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came, bringing to him a paralytic carried by four men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to Him, bringing a paralytic who was carried by four men.
verses.textEnNlt: four men arrived carrying a paralyzed man on a mat.
verses.textEnNasb: And some people *came, bringing to Him a man who was paralyzed, carried by four men.
verses.textEn: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.

verses.textZh: 因为人挤，不能带到他面前，就对着耶稣所在的地方，拆去房顶；拆通了，就把瘫子连人带褥子缒了下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人挤，不能带到他面前，就对着耶稣所在的地方，拆去房顶；拆通了，就把瘫子连人带褥子缒了下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人多，不得近前，就把耶稣所在的房子，拆了房顶，既拆通了，就把瘫子连所躺卧的褥子都缒下来。
verses.textEnNiv: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they could not get near him because of the crowd, they removed the roof above him, and when they had made an opening, they let down the bed on which the paralytic lay.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they could not come near Him because of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where He was. So when they had broken through, they let down the bed on which the paralytic was lying.
verses.textEnNlt: They couldn’t bring him to Jesus because of the crowd, so they dug a hole through the roof above his head. Then they lowered the man on his mat, right down in front of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they were unable to get to Him because of the crowd, they removed the roof above Him; and after digging an opening, they let down the pallet on which the paralyzed man was lying.
verses.textEn: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见他们的信心，就对瘫子说："<red>孩子，你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见他们的信心，就对瘫子说："<red>孩子，你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「<red>小子，你的罪赦了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“Son, your sins are forgiven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven you."
verses.textEnNlt: Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, "My child, your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus, seeing their faith, *said to the paralyzed man, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“Son, your sins are forgiven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 当时有几个经学家也坐在那里，心里议论说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时有几个经学家也坐在那里，心里议论说：
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个文士坐在那里，心里议论，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,
verses.textEnEsv: Now some of the scribes were sitting there, questioning in their hearts,
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of the scribes were sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.textEnNlt: But some of the teachers of religious law who were sitting there thought to themselves,
verses.textEnNasb: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking it over in their hearts,
verses.textEn: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,

verses.textZh: "这个人为甚么这样说话？他说僭妄的话了。除了神一位以外，谁能赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这个人为甚么这样说话？他说僭妄的话了。除了神一位以外，谁能赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「这个人为什么这样说呢？他说僭妄的话了。除了神以外，谁能赦罪呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Why does this man speak like that? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why does this Man speak blasphemies like this? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What is he saying? This is blasphemy! Only God can forgive sins!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Why does this man speak that way? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins except God alone?"
verses.textEn: "Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣心里立刻知道他们这样议论，就对他们说："<red>你们心里为甚么议论这事？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣心里立刻知道他们这样议论，就对他们说："<red>你们心里为甚么议论这事？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣心中知道他们心里这样议论，就说：「你们心里为什么这样议论呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, <red>“Why are you thinking these things?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they thus questioned within themselves, said to them, "Why do you question these things in your hearts?
verses.textEnNkjv: But immediately, when Jesus perceived in His spirit that they reasoned thus within themselves, He said to them, "Why do you reason about these things in your hearts?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew immediately what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you question this in your hearts?
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately Jesus, aware in His spirit that they were thinking that way within themselves, *said to them, "Why are you thinking about these things in your hearts?
verses.textEn: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, <red>“Why are you thinking these things?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>对瘫子说‘你的罪赦了’，或说‘起来，拿着你的褥子走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>对瘫子说‘你的罪赦了’，或说‘起来，拿着你的褥子走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或对瘫子说『你的罪赦了』，或说『起来！拿你的褥子行走』，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Rise, take up your bed and walk’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise, take up your bed and walk’?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it easier to say to the paralyzed man ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or ‘Stand up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
verses.textEnNasb: Which is easier, to say to the paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven’; or to say, ‘Get up, and pick up your pallet and walk’?
verses.textEn: <red>Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而为了要你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而为了要你们知道人子在地上有赦罪的权柄，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄。」就对瘫子说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the man,
verses.textEnEsv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—he said to the paralytic—
verses.textEnNkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—He said to the paralytic,
verses.textEnNlt: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said,
verses.textEnNasb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—He *said to the paralyzed man,
verses.textEn: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the man,

verses.textZh: <red>我吩咐你，起来，拿起你的褥子，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我吩咐你，起来，拿起你的褥子，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>我吩咐你，起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I say to you, rise, pick up your bed, and go home."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
verses.textEnNlt: "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"
verses.textEnNasb: "I say to you, get up, pick up your pallet, and go home."
verses.textEn: <red>“I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众出去了。众人都非常惊奇，颂赞神，说："我们从来没有见过这样的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众出去了。众人都非常惊奇，颂赞神，说："我们从来没有见过这样的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众人面前出去了，以致众人都惊奇，归荣耀与神，说：「我们从来没有见过这样的事！」
verses.textEnNiv: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he rose and immediately picked up his bed and went out before them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, "We never saw anything like this!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went out in the presence of them all, so that all were amazed and glorified God, saying, "We never saw anything like this!"
verses.textEnNlt: And the man jumped up, grabbed his mat, and walked out through the stunned onlookers. They were all amazed and praised God, exclaiming, "We’ve never seen anything like this before!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he got up and immediately picked up the pallet and went out in the sight of everyone, so that they were all amazed and were glorifying God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"
verses.textEn: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣又出去，到了加利利海边；众人都到他面前来，他就教导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又出去，到了加利利海边；众人都到他面前来，他就教导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又出到海边去，众人都就了他来，他便教训他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
verses.textEnEsv: He went out again beside the sea, and all the crowd was coming to him, and he was teaching them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went out again by the sea; and all the multitude came to Him, and He taught them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus went out to the lakeshore again and taught the crowds that were coming to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went out again by the seashore; and all the people were coming to Him, and He was teaching them.
verses.textEn: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

verses.textZh: 他往前走的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"他就起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他往前走的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"他就起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣经过的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未坐在税关上，就对他说：「<red>你跟从我来。</red>」他就起来，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector’s booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth, and he said to him, "Follow me." And he rose and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As He passed by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me." So he arose and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at his tax collector’s booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him. So Levi got up and followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: As He passed by, He saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting in the tax office, and He *said to him, "Follow Me!" And he got up and followed Him.
verses.textEn: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector’s booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.

verses.textZh: 后来耶稣在利未家里吃饭，有很多税吏和罪人也来与他和门徒一起吃饭；因为这样的人很多，并且他们已经跟随了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来耶稣在利未家里吃饭，有很多税吏和罪人也来与他和门徒一起吃饭；因为这样的人很多，并且他们已经跟随了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在利未家里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人与耶稣并门徒一同坐席；因为这样的人多，他们也跟随耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he reclined at table in his house, many tax collectors and sinners were reclining with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as He was dining in Levi’s house, that many tax collectors and sinners also sat together with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many, and they followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, Levi invited Jesus and his disciples to his home as dinner guests, along with many tax collectors and other disreputable sinners. (There were many people of this kind among Jesus’ followers.)
verses.textEnNasb: And it *happened that He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners were dining with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many of them, and they were following Him.
verses.textEn: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.

verses.textZh: 法利赛派的经学家，看见耶稣与罪人和税吏一起吃饭，就对耶稣的门徒说："他跟税吏和罪人一起吃饭吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛派的经学家，看见耶稣与罪人和税吏一起吃饭，就对耶稣的门徒说："他跟税吏和罪人一起吃饭吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人中的文士 看见耶稣和罪人并税吏一同吃饭，就对他门徒说：「他和税吏并罪人一同吃喝吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: "Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, "Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw Him eating with the tax collectors and sinners, they said to His disciples, "How isit that He eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnNlt: But when the teachers of religious law who were Pharisees saw him eating with tax collectors and other sinners, they asked his disciples, "Why does he eat with such scum? "
verses.textEnNasb: When the scribes of the Pharisees saw that He was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they said to His disciples, "Why is He eating with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEn: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: "Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见了，就对他们说："<red>健康的人不需要医生，有病的人才需要；我来不是要召义人，而是要召罪人。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见了，就对他们说："<red>健康的人不需要医生，有病的人才需要；我来不是要召义人，而是要召罪人。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见，就对他们说：「<red>康健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, <red>“It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus heard it, He said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick. I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard this, he told them, "Healthy people don’t need a doctor—sick people do. I have come to call not those who think they are righteous, but those who know they are sinners."
verses.textEnNasb: And hearing this, Jesus *said to them, "It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick; I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners."
verses.textEn: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, <red>“It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”</red>

verses.textZh: 约翰的门徒和法利赛人正在禁食，有人来问耶稣说："为甚么约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒常常禁食，你的门徒却不禁食呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰的门徒和法利赛人正在禁食，有人来问耶稣说："为甚么约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒常常禁食，你的门徒却不禁食呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，约翰的门徒和法利赛人禁食。他们来问耶稣说：「约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, "How is it that John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. And people came and said to him, "Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The disciples of John and of the Pharisees were fasting. Then they came and said to Him, "Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?"
verses.textEnNlt: Once when John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, some people came to Jesus and asked, "Why don’t your disciples fast like John’s disciples and the Pharisees do?"
verses.textEnNasb: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting; and they *came and *said to Him, "Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?"
verses.textEn: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, "How is it that John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："新郎跟宾客在一起的时候，宾客怎能禁食呢？只要新郎还在，就不能禁食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："新郎跟宾客在一起的时候，宾客怎能禁食呢？只要新郎还在，就不能禁食。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能禁食呢？新郎还同在，他们不能禁食。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Can the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to them, "Can the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them they cannot fast.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Do wedding guests fast while celebrating with the groom? Of course not. They can’t fast while the groom is with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "While the groom is with them, the attendants of the groom cannot fast, can they? As long as they have the groom with them, they cannot fast.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但日子到了，新郎要被取去，离开他们，那一天他们就要禁食了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但日子到了，新郎要被取去，离开他们，那一天他们就要禁食了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in those days.
verses.textEnNlt: But someday the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
verses.textEnNasb: But the days will come when the groom is taken away from them, and then they will fast, on that day.
verses.textEn: <red>But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>没有人会把一块新布缝在旧衣服上，如果这样，新的布就会把旧衣服扯破，裂开的地方就更大了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>没有人会把一块新布缝在旧衣服上，如果这样，新的布就会把旧衣服扯破，裂开的地方就更大了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>没有人把新布缝在旧衣服上，恐怕所补上的新布带坏了旧衣服，破的就更大了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; or else the new piece pulls away from the old, and the tear is made worse.
verses.textEnNlt: "Besides, who would patch old clothing with new cloth? For the new patch would shrink and rip away from the old cloth, leaving an even bigger tear than before.
verses.textEnNasb: "No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; otherwise, the patch pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear results.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>也没有人会把新酒装在旧皮袋里，如果这样，酒就会把皮袋胀破，酒和皮袋都损坏了；新酒总该装在新皮袋里。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>也没有人会把新酒装在旧皮袋里，如果这样，酒就会把皮袋胀破，酒和皮袋都损坏了；新酒总该装在新皮袋里。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里，恐怕酒把皮袋裂开，酒和皮袋就都坏了；惟把新酒装在新皮袋里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins—and the wine is destroyed, and so are the skins. But new wine is for fresh wineskins."
verses.textEnNkjv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine bursts the wineskins, the wine is spilled, and the wineskins are ruined. But new wine must be put into new wineskins."
verses.textEnNlt: "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. For the wine would burst the wineskins, and the wine and the skins would both be lost. New wine calls for new wineskins."
verses.textEnNasb: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost and the skins as well; but one puts new wine into fresh wineskins."
verses.textEn: <red>And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一次，在安息日，耶稣从麦田经过，他的门徒一面走路，一面摘麦穗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，在安息日，耶稣从麦田经过，他的门徒一面走路，一面摘麦穗。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣当安息日从麦地经过。他门徒行路的时候，掐了麦穗。
verses.textEnNiv: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.
verses.textEnEsv: One Sabbath he was going through the grainfields, and as they made their way, his disciples began to pluck heads of grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened that He went through the grainfields on the Sabbath; and as they went His disciples began to pluck the heads of grain.
verses.textEnNlt: One Sabbath day as Jesus was walking through some grainfields, his disciples began breaking off heads of grain to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened that He was passing through the grainfields on the Sabbath, and His disciples began to make their way along while picking the heads of grain.
verses.textEn: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人对耶稣说："你看，他们为甚么作安息日不可作的事？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人对耶稣说："你看，他们为甚么作安息日不可作的事？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人对耶稣说：「看哪，他们在安息日为什么做不可做的事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees said to him, "Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the Pharisees were saying to him, "Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Pharisees said to Him, "Look, why do they do what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the Pharisees said to Jesus, "Look, why are they breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees were saying to Him, "Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEn: The Pharisees said to him, "Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>大卫和跟他一起的人在饥饿缺食的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>大卫和跟他一起的人在饥饿缺食的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「经上记着大卫和跟从他的人缺乏饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Have you never read what David did, when he was in need and was hungry, he and those who were with him:
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Have you never read what David did when he was in need and hungry, he and those with him:
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said to them, "Haven’t you ever read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Have you never read what David did when he was in need and he and his companions became hungry;
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他不是在亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，进了神的殿，吃了除祭司以外谁都不可以吃的陈设饼，而且还给跟他在一起的人吃吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他不是在亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，进了神的殿，吃了除祭司以外谁都不可以吃的陈设饼，而且还给跟他在一起的人吃吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他当亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，怎么进了神的殿，吃了陈设饼，又给跟从他的人吃。这饼除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: how he entered the house of God, in the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the bread of the Presence, which it is not lawful for any but the priests to eat, and also gave it to those who were with him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: how he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the showbread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and also gave some to those who were with him?"
verses.textEnNlt: He went into the house of God (during the days when Abiathar was high priest) and broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests are allowed to eat. He also gave some to his companions."
verses.textEnNasb: how he entered the house of God in the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the consecrated bread, which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests, and he also gave it to those who were with him?"
verses.textEn: <red>In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又告诉他们："安息日是为人设立的，人并不是为安息日设立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又告诉他们："安息日是为人设立的，人并不是为安息日设立的。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又对他们说：「安息日是为人设立的，人不是为安息日设立的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, <red>“The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to them, "The Sabbath was made to meet the needs of people, and not people to meet the requirements of the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath.
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, <red>“The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，人子也是安息日的主。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，人子也是安息日的主。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，人子也是安息日的主。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Son of Man is also Lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: So the Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the Son of Man is Lord, even of the Sabbath."
verses.textEn: <red>So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人，他的一只手枯干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人，他的一只手枯干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人枯干了一只手。
verses.textEnNiv: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.
verses.textEnEsv: Again he entered the synagogue, and a man was there with a withered hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He entered the synagogue again, and a man was there who had a withered hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus went into the synagogue again and noticed a man with a deformed hand.
verses.textEnNasb: He entered a synagogue again; and a man was there whose hand was withered.
verses.textEn: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.

verses.textZh: 众人窥探他会不会在安息日医治那个人，好去控告他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人窥探他会不会在安息日医治那个人，好去控告他。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人窥探耶稣，在安息日医治不医治，意思是要控告耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: And they watched Jesus, to see whether he would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they watched Him closely, whether He would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Since it was the Sabbath, Jesus’ enemies watched him closely. If he healed the man’s hand, they planned to accuse him of working on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were watching Him closely to see if He would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse Him.
verses.textEn: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对那一只手枯干了的人说："<red>起来，站在当中！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对那一只手枯干了的人说："<red>起来，站在当中！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对那枯干一只手的人说：「<red>起来，站在当中。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, <red>“Stand up in front of everyone.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the man with the withered hand, "Come here."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to the man who had the withered hand, "Step forward."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said to the man with the deformed hand, "Come and stand in front of everyone."
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to the man with the withered hand, " Get up and come forward!"
verses.textEn: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, <red>“Stand up in front of everyone.”</red>

verses.textZh: 又对他们说："<red>在安息日哪一样是可以作的呢：作好事还是坏事？救命还是害命？</red>"他们一声不响。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又对他们说："<red>在安息日哪一样是可以作的呢：作好事还是坏事？救命还是害命？</red>"他们一声不响。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问众人说：「<red>在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，哪样是可以的呢？</red>」他们都不作声。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus asked them, <red>“Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?”</red> But they remained silent.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to kill?" But they were silent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they kept silent.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned to his critics and asked, "Does the law permit good deeds on the Sabbath, or is it a day for doing evil? Is this a day to save life or to destroy it?" But they wouldn’t answer him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Is it lawful to do good on the Sabbath or to do harm, to save a life or to kill?" But they kept silent.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus asked them, <red>“Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?”</red> But they remained silent.

verses.textZh: 耶稣怒目环视他们，因他们的心刚硬而难过，就对那人说："<red>伸出手来！</red>"他把手一伸，手就复原了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣怒目环视他们，因他们的心刚硬而难过，就对那人说："<red>伸出手来！</red>"他把手一伸，手就复原了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣怒目周围看他们，忧愁他们的心刚硬，就对那人说：「<red>伸出手来！</red>」他把手一伸，手就复了原。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.
verses.textEnEsv: And he looked around at them with anger, grieved at their hardness of heart, and said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had looked around at them with anger, being grieved by the hardness of their hearts, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked around at them angrily and was deeply saddened by their hard hearts. Then he said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored!
verses.textEnNasb: After looking around at them with anger, grieved at their hardness of heart, He *said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.
verses.textEn: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人出来，立刻和希律党人商量怎样对付耶稣，好除掉他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人出来，立刻和希律党人商量怎样对付耶稣，好除掉他。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人出去，同希律一党的人商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisees went out and immediately held counsel with the Herodians against him, how to destroy him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees went out and immediately plotted with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.
verses.textEnNlt: At once the Pharisees went away and met with the supporters of Herod to plot how to kill Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees went out and immediately began conspiring with the Herodians against Him, as to how they might put Him to death.
verses.textEn: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去，一大群从加利利来的人跟着他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去，一大群从加利利来的人跟着他；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去，有许多人从加利利跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the sea, and a great crowd followed, from Galilee and Judea
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea. And a great multitude from Galilee followed Him, and from Judea
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus went out to the lake with his disciples, and a large crowd followed him. They came from all over Galilee, Judea,
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus withdrew to the sea with His disciples; and a large multitude from Galilee followed, and also from Judea,
verses.textEn: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.

verses.textZh: 还有许多人听见他所作的一切事，就从犹太、耶路撒冷、以土迈、约旦河外和推罗、西顿一带地方来到他跟前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有许多人听见他所作的一切事，就从犹太、耶路撒冷、以土迈、约旦河外和推罗、西顿一带地方来到他跟前。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有许多人听见他所做的大事，就从犹太、耶路撒冷、以土买、约旦河外，并泰尔、西顿的四方来到他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jerusalem and Idumea and from beyond the Jordan and from around Tyre and Sidon. When the great crowd heard all that he was doing, they came to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Jerusalem and Idumea and beyond the Jordan; and those from Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they heard how many things He was doing, came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem, Idumea, from east of the Jordan River, and even from as far north as Tyre and Sidon. The news about his miracles had spread far and wide, and vast numbers of people came to see him.
verses.textEnNasb: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon, a great number of people heard about everything that He was doing and came to Him.
verses.textEn: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.

verses.textZh: 因为人多，耶稣就吩咐门徒为他预备一只小船，免得众人拥挤他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人多，耶稣就吩咐门徒为他预备一只小船，免得众人拥挤他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因为人多，就吩咐门徒叫一只小船伺候着，免得众人拥挤他。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he told his disciples to have a boat ready for him because of the crowd, lest they crush him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So He told His disciples that a small boat should be kept ready for Him because of the multitude, lest they should crush Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus instructed his disciples to have a boat ready so the crowd would not crush him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He told His disciples to see that a boat would be ready for Him because of the masses, so that they would not crowd Him;
verses.textEn: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.

verses.textZh: 他医好了许多人，所以凡有病的都挤过来要摸他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他医好了许多人，所以凡有病的都挤过来要摸他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他治好了许多人，所以凡有灾病的，都挤进来要摸他。
verses.textEnNiv: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.
verses.textEnEsv: for he had healed many, so that all who had diseases pressed around him to touch him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He healed many, so that as many as had afflictions pressed about Him to touch Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He had healed many people that day, so all the sick people eagerly pushed forward to touch him.
verses.textEnNasb: for He had healed many, with the result that all those who had diseases pushed in around Him in order to touch Him.
verses.textEn: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.

verses.textZh: 污灵每次看到他，就仆倒在他面前，大声喊叫说："你是神的儿子！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 污灵每次看到他，就仆倒在他面前，大声喊叫说："你是神的儿子！"
verses.textZhCuv: 污鬼无论何时看见他，就俯伏在他面前，喊着说：「你是神的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God."
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw Him, fell down before Him and cried out, saying, "You are the Son of God."
verses.textEnNlt: And whenever those possessed by evil spirits caught sight of him, the spirits would throw them to the ground in front of him shrieking, "You are the Son of God!"
