verses.textEnNasb: And whenever the unclean spirits saw Him, they would fall down before Him and shout, "You are the Son of God!"
verses.textEn: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, "You are the Son of God."

verses.textZh: 耶稣再三严厉地吩咐他们，不要把他的身分张扬出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣再三严厉地吩咐他们，不要把他的身分张扬出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要把他显露出来。
verses.textEnNiv: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he strictly ordered them not to make him known.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He sternly warned them that they should not make Him known.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus sternly commanded the spirits not to reveal who he was.
verses.textEnNasb: And He strongly warned them not to reveal who He was.
verses.textEn: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上了山，呼召自己所要的人，他们就来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上了山，呼召自己所要的人，他们就来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上了山，随自己的意思叫人来；他们便来到他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went up on the mountain and called to him those whom he desired, and they came to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He went up on the mountain and called to Him those He Himself wanted. And they came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Jesus went up on a mountain and called out the ones he wanted to go with him. And they came to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *went up on the mountain and *summoned those whom He Himself wanted, and they came to Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.

verses.textZh: 他选立了十二个人，称他们为使徒 ，要他们跟自己常在一起，好差遣他们去传道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他选立了十二个人，称他们为使徒 ，要他们跟自己常在一起，好差遣他们去传道，
verses.textZhCuv: 他就设立十二个人，要他们常和自己同在，也要差他们去传道，
verses.textEnNiv: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach
verses.textEnEsv: And he appointed twelve (whom he also named apostles) so that they might be with him and he might send them out to preach
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He appointed twelve, that they might be with Him and that He might send them out to preach,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he appointed twelve of them and called them his apostles. They were to accompany him, and he would send them out to preach,
verses.textEnNasb: And He appointed twelve, so that they would be with Him and that He could send them out to preach,
verses.textEn: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach

verses.textZh: 又有权柄赶鬼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有权柄赶鬼。
verses.textZhCuv: 并给他们权柄赶鬼。
verses.textEnNiv: and to have authority to drive out demons.
verses.textEnEsv: and have authority to cast out demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to have power to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
verses.textEnNlt: giving them authority to cast out demons.
verses.textEnNasb: and to have authority to cast out the demons.
verses.textEn: and to have authority to drive out demons.

verses.textZh: 他选立的十二个人是：西门 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他选立的十二个人是：西门 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 这十二个人有西门（耶稣又给他起名叫彼得），
verses.textEnNiv: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
verses.textEnEsv: He appointed the twelve: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon, to whom He gave the name Peter;
verses.textEnNlt: These are the twelve he chose: Simon (whom he named Peter),
verses.textEnNasb: And He appointed the twelve: Simon (to whom He gave the name Peter),
verses.textEn: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),

verses.textZh: 西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的弟弟约翰 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西庇太的儿子雅各，和雅各的弟弟约翰 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 还有西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰（又给这两个人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），
verses.textEnNiv: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means "sons of thunder"),
verses.textEnEsv: James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James (to whom he gave the name Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder);
verses.textEnNkjv: James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James, to whom He gave the name Boanerges, that is, "Sons of Thunder";
verses.textEnNlt: James and John (the sons of Zebedee, but Jesus nicknamed them "Sons of Thunder" ),
verses.textEnNasb: James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James (to them He gave the name Boanerges, which means, "Sons of Thunder");
verses.textEn: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means "sons of thunder"),

verses.textZh: 安得烈、腓力、巴多罗迈、马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、达太、激进派的西门，
verses.textZhCnvs: 安得烈、腓力、巴多罗迈、马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、达太、激进派的西门，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多罗买、马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，并奋锐党的西门，
verses.textEnNiv: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot
verses.textEnEsv: Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Zealot,
verses.textEnNkjv: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Cananite;
verses.textEnNlt: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Thaddaeus, Simon (the zealot ),
verses.textEnNasb: and Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, and Simon the Zealot;
verses.textEn: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot

verses.textZh: 以及加略人犹大，就是出卖耶稣的那个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及加略人犹大，就是出卖耶稣的那个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
verses.textEnEsv: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him. And they went into a house.
verses.textEnNlt: Judas Iscariot (who later betrayed him).
verses.textEnNasb: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.
verses.textEn: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了屋子，群众又聚了来，以致他们连饭都不能吃，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了屋子，群众又聚了来，以致他们连饭都不能吃，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了一个屋子，众人又聚集，甚至他连饭也顾不得吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went home, and the crowd gathered again, so that they could not even eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
verses.textEnNlt: One time Jesus entered a house, and the crowds began to gather again. Soon he and his disciples couldn’t even find time to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *came home, and the crowd *gathered again, to such an extent that they could not even eat a meal.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.

verses.textZh: 那些和他在一起的人听见了，就出来抓住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些和他在一起的人听见了，就出来抓住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。
verses.textEnNiv: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, "He is out of his mind."
verses.textEnEsv: And when his family heard it, they went out to seize him, for they were saying, "He is out of his mind."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when His own people heard aboutthis, they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, "He is out of His mind."
verses.textEnNlt: When his family heard what was happening, they tried to take him away. "He’s out of his mind," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: And when His own people heard about this, they came out to take custody of Him; for they were saying, "He has lost His senses."
verses.textEn: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, "He is out of his mind."

verses.textZh: 从耶路撒冷下来的经学家说："他有别西卜附在身上！"又说："他靠着鬼王赶鬼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从耶路撒冷下来的经学家说："他有别西卜附在身上！"又说："他靠着鬼王赶鬼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从耶路撒冷下来的文士说：「他是被别西卜附着」；又说：「他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, "He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons."
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem were saying, "He is possessed by Beelzebul," and "by the prince of demons he casts out the demons."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, "He has Beelzebub," and, "By the ruler of the demons He casts out demons."
verses.textEnNlt: But the teachers of religious law who had arrived from Jerusalem said, "He’s possessed by Satan, the prince of demons. That’s where he gets the power to cast out demons."
verses.textEnNasb: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem were saying, "He is possessed by Beelzebul," and "He casts out the demons by the ruler of the demons."
verses.textEn: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, "He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons."

verses.textZh: 耶稣把他们叫来，用比喻对他们说："<red>撒但怎能赶逐撒但呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣把他们叫来，用比喻对他们说："<red>撒但怎能赶逐撒但呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说：「撒但怎能赶出撒但呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: <red>“How can Satan drive out Satan?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he called them to him and said to them in parables, "How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.textEnNkjv: So He called them to Himself and said to them in parables: "How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus called them over and responded with an illustration. "How can Satan cast out Satan?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And so He called them to Himself and began speaking to them in parables: "How can Satan cast out Satan?
verses.textEn: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: <red>“How can Satan drive out Satan?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一国若自相纷争，那国就站立不住；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一国若自相纷争，那国就站立不住；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若一国自相纷争，那国就站立不住；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.textEnNlt: "A kingdom divided by civil war will collapse.
verses.textEnNasb: And if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
verses.textEn: <red>If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一家若自相纷争，那家就站立不住。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一家若自相纷争，那家就站立不住。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若一家自相纷争，那家就站立不住。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
verses.textEnNlt: Similarly, a family splintered by feuding will fall apart.
verses.textEnNasb: If a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
verses.textEn: <red>If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果撒但自相攻打纷争，不但站立不住，而且还要灭亡。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果撒但自相攻打纷争，不但站立不住，而且还要灭亡。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若撒但自相攻打纷争，他就站立不住，必要灭亡。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he cannot stand, but is coming to an end.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.
verses.textEnNlt: And if Satan is divided and fights against himself, how can he stand? He would never survive.
verses.textEnNasb: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he cannot stand, but he is finished!
verses.textEn: <red>And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>谁都不能进入壮汉的家，抢夺他的财物，除非先把壮汉捆绑起来，才可以抢劫他的家。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>谁都不能进入壮汉的家，抢夺他的财物，除非先把壮汉捆绑起来，才可以抢劫他的家。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>没有人能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具；必先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But no one can enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man. Then indeed he may plunder his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one can enter a strong man’s house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man. And then he will plunder his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me illustrate this further. Who is powerful enough to enter the house of a strong man and plunder his goods? Only someone even stronger—someone who could tie him up and then plunder his house.
verses.textEnNasb: But no one can enter the strong man’s house and plunder his property unless he first ties up the strong man, and then he will plunder his house.
verses.textEn: <red>In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，世人的一切罪和一切亵渎的话，都可以得到赦免；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，世人的一切罪和一切亵渎的话，都可以得到赦免；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，世人一切的罪和一切亵渎的话都可得赦免；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Truly, I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the children of man, and whatever blasphemies they utter,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Assuredly, I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they may utter;
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, all sin and blasphemy can be forgiven,
verses.textEnNasb: "Truly I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons and daughters of men, and whatever blasphemies they commit;
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但亵渎圣灵的，就永世不得赦免，他还要担当罪恶到永远。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但亵渎圣灵的，就永世不得赦免，他还要担当罪恶到永远。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡亵渎圣灵的，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin"—
verses.textEnNkjv: but he who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation"—
verses.textEnNlt: but anyone who blasphemes the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven. This is a sin with eternal consequences."
verses.textEnNasb: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin"—
verses.textEn: <red>but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说这话，是因为他们说他有污灵附在身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说这话，是因为他们说他有污灵附在身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话是因为他们说：「他是被污鬼附着的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said this because they were saying, "He has an impure spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: for they were saying, "He has an unclean spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: because they said, "He has an unclean spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them this because they were saying, "He’s possessed by an evil spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: because they were saying, "He has an unclean spirit."
verses.textEn: He said this because they were saying, "He has an impure spirit."

verses.textZh: 耶稣的母亲和弟弟来了，站在外面，传话给他，叫他出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的母亲和弟弟来了，站在外面，传话给他，叫他出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，耶稣的母亲和弟兄来，站在外边，打发人去叫他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.
verses.textEnEsv: And his mother and his brothers came, and standing outside they sent to him and called him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His brothers and His mother came, and standing outside they sent to Him, calling Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him. They stood outside and sent word for him to come out and talk with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then His mother and His brothers *came, and while standing outside they sent word to Him, calling for Him.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.

verses.textZh: 有许多人正围坐在耶稣身边，他们告诉他："你看，你的母亲和弟弟 在外面找你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多人正围坐在耶稣身边，他们告诉他："你看，你的母亲和弟弟 在外面找你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人在耶稣周围坐着，他们就告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄在外边找你。」
verses.textEnNiv: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, "Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you."
verses.textEnEsv: And a crowd was sitting around him, and they said to him, "Your mother and your brothers are outside, seeking you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a multitude was sitting around Him; and they said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are outside seeking You."
verses.textEnNlt: There was a crowd sitting around Jesus, and someone said, "Your mother and your brothers are outside asking for you."
verses.textEnNasb: And a crowd was sitting around Him, and they *said to Him, "Behold, Your mother and Your brothers are outside looking for You."
verses.textEn: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, "Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答他们："谁是我的母亲，我的弟兄呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答他们："谁是我的母亲，我的弟兄呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whop are my mother and my brothers?”</red> he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, "Who are my mother and my brothers?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered them, saying, "Who is My mother, or My brothers?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"
verses.textEnNasb: Answering them, He *said, "Who are My mother and My brothers?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whop are my mother and my brothers?”</red> he asked.

verses.textZh: 于是四面观看那些围坐的人，说："<red>你们看，我的母亲！我的弟兄！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是四面观看那些围坐的人，说："<red>你们看，我的母亲！我的弟兄！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就四面观看那周围坐着的人，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, <red>“Here are my mother and my brothers!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And looking about at those who sat around him, he said, "Here are my mother and my brothers!
verses.textEnNkjv: And He looked around in a circle at those who sat about Him, and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
verses.textEnNlt: Then he looked at those around him and said, "Look, these are my mother and brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: And looking around at those who were sitting around Him, He *said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!
verses.textEn: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, <red>“Here are my mother and my brothers!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡遵行神旨意的，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡遵行神旨意的，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡遵行神旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever does the will of God, he is my brother and sister and mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and My sister and mother."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother."
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever does the will of God, this is My brother, and sister, and mother."
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又在海边教导人。有一大群人聚集到他那里，因此他上船坐下来。船在海中，群众都朝着海站在岸上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又在海边教导人。有一大群人聚集到他那里，因此他上船坐下来。船在海中，群众都朝着海站在岸上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又在海边教训人。有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海里，众人都靠近海，站在岸上。
verses.textEnNiv: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water’s edge.
verses.textEnEsv: Again he began to teach beside the sea. And a very large crowd gathered about him, so that he got into a boat and sat in it on the sea, and the whole crowd was beside the sea on the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And again He began to teach by the sea. And a great multitude was gathered to Him, so that He got into a boat and sat init on the sea; and the whole multitude was on the land facing the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again Jesus began teaching by the lakeshore. A very large crowd soon gathered around him, so he got into a boat. Then he sat in the boat while all the people remained on the shore.
verses.textEnNasb: Again He began to teach by the sea. And such a very large crowd gathered to Him that He got into a boat on the sea and sat down; and the whole crowd was by the sea on the land.
verses.textEn: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water’s edge.

verses.textZh: 他用比喻教训他们许多事，在教训中他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用比喻教训他们许多事，在教训中他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就用比喻教训他们许多道理。在教训之间，对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:
verses.textEnEsv: And he was teaching them many things in parables, and in his teaching he said to them:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He taught them many things by parables, and said to them in His teaching:
verses.textEnNlt: He taught them by telling many stories in the form of parables, such as this one:
verses.textEnNasb: And He was teaching them many things in parables, and was saying to them in His teaching,
verses.textEn: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:

verses.textZh: <red>"你们听着！有一个撒种的出去撒种，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们听着！有一个撒种的出去撒种，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们听啊！有一个撒种的出去撒种。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Listen! Behold, a sower went out to sow.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Listen! Behold, a sower went out to sow.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen! A farmer went out to plant some seed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen to this! Behold, the sower went out to sow;
verses.textEn: <red>“Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>撒的时候，有的落在路旁，小鸟飞来就吃掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>撒的时候，有的落在路旁，小鸟飞来就吃掉了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as he sowed, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as he sowed, that some seed fell by the wayside; and the birds of the air came and devoured it.
verses.textEnNlt: As he scattered it across his field, some of the seed fell on a footpath, and the birds came and ate it.
verses.textEnNasb: as he was sowing, some seed fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate it up.
verses.textEn: <red>As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在泥土不多的石地上，因为泥土不深，很快就长起来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在泥土不多的石地上，因为泥土不深，很快就长起来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Other seed fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil, and immediately it sprang up, since it had no depth of soil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some fell on stony ground, where it did not have much earth; and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seed fell on shallow soil with underlying rock. The seed sprouted quickly because the soil was shallow.
verses.textEnNasb: Other seed fell on the rocky ground where it did not have much soil; and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of soil.
verses.textEn: <red>Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但太阳一出来，就把它晒干，又因为没有根就枯萎了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但太阳一出来，就把它晒干，又因为没有根就枯萎了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when the sun rose, it was scorched, and since it had no root, it withered away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the sun was up it was scorched, and because it had no root it withered away.
verses.textEnNlt: But the plant soon wilted under the hot sun, and since it didn’t have deep roots, it died.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.textEn: <red>But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在荆棘里，荆棘长起来，把它挤住，它就结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在荆棘里，荆棘长起来，把它挤住，它就结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了，就不结实；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Other seed fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some seed fell among thorns; and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no crop.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seed fell among thorns that grew up and choked out the tender plants so they produced no grain.
verses.textEnNasb: Other seed fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it yielded no crop.
verses.textEn: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在好土里，就生长繁茂，结出果实，有三十倍的、有六十倍的、有一百倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在好土里，就生长繁茂，结出果实，有三十倍的、有六十倍的、有一百倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有落在好土里的，就发生长大，结实有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And other seeds fell into good soil and produced grain, growing up and increasing and yielding thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold."
verses.textEnNkjv: But other seed fell on good ground and yielded a crop that sprang up, increased and produced: some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some a hundred."
verses.textEnNlt: Still other seeds fell on fertile soil, and they sprouted, grew, and produced a crop that was thirty, sixty, and even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"
verses.textEnNasb: Other seeds fell into the good soil, and as they grew up and increased, they yielded a crop and produced thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much."
verses.textEn: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又说："<red>有耳可听的，就应当听。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又说："<red>有耳可听的，就应当听。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「<red>有耳可听的，就应当听！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said, <red>“Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said, <red>“Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣独自一人的时候，那些经常跟着他的人和十二门徒，来问这些比喻的意义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣独自一人的时候，那些经常跟着他的人和十二门徒，来问这些比喻的意义。
verses.textZhCuv: 无人的时候，跟随耶稣的人和十二个门徒问他这比喻的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he was alone, those around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when He was alone, those around Him with the twelve asked Him about the parable.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when Jesus was alone with the twelve disciples and with the others who were gathered around, they asked him what the parables meant.
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as He was alone, His followers, along with the twelve disciples, began asking Him about the parables.
verses.textEn: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>神的国的奥秘，只给你们知道，但对于外人，一切都用比喻，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>神的国的奥秘，只给你们知道，但对于外人，一切都用比喻，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「神国的奥秘只叫你们知道，若是对外人讲，凡事就用比喻，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them, <red>“The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "To you has been given the secret of the kingdom of God, but for those outside everything is in parables,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "To you it has been given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God; but to those who are outside, all things come in parables,
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secret of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables for everything I say to outsiders,
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "To you has been given the mystery of the kingdom of God, but for those who are outside, everything comes in parables,
verses.textEn: He told them, <red>“The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables</red>

verses.textZh: <red>叫他们 ‘看是看见了，却不领悟， 听是听见了，却不明白， 免得他们回转过来，得到赦免。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>叫他们 ‘看是看见了，却不领悟， 听是听见了，却不明白， 免得他们回转过来，得到赦免。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫他们 看是看见，却不晓得； 听是听见，却不明白； 恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>so that, “ ‘theypn may be ever seeing but never perceiving, andld ever hearing but never understanding; otherwiseln they might turn and be forgiven!’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so that "‘they may indeed see but not perceive, and may indeed hear but not understand, lest they should turn and be forgiven.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: so that ‘Seeing they may see and not perceive, And hearing they may hear and not understand; Lest they should turn, Andtheirsins be forgiven them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled: ‘When they see what I do, they will learn nothing. When they hear what I say, they will not understand. Otherwise, they will turn to me and be forgiven.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: so that while seeing they may see, and not perceive, and while hearing, they may hear, and not understand, otherwise they might return and it would be forgiven them."
verses.textEn: <red>so that, “ ‘theypn may be ever seeing but never perceiving, andld ever hearing but never understanding; otherwiseln they might turn and be forgiven!’”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>你们不明白这个比喻，怎能明白一切比喻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>你们不明白这个比喻，怎能明白一切比喻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又对他们说：「你们不明白这比喻吗？这样怎能明白一切的比喻呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand all the parables?
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Do you not understand this parable? How then will you understand all the parables?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to them, "If you can’t understand the meaning of this parable, how will you understand all the other parables?
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Do you not understand this parable? How will you understand all the parables?
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Don’t you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>撒种的人所撒的就是道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>撒种的人所撒的就是道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>撒种之人所撒的就是道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The farmer sows the word.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The sower sows the word.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sower sows the word.
verses.textEnNlt: The farmer plants seed by taking God’s word to others.
verses.textEnNasb: The sower sows the word.
verses.textEn: <red>The farmer sows the word.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺了去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the ones along the path, where the word is sown: when they hear, Satan immediately comes and takes away the word that is sown in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the ones by the wayside where the word is sown. When they hear, Satan comes immediately and takes away the word that was sown in their hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: The seed that fell on the footpath represents those who hear the message, only to have Satan come at once and take it away.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who are beside the road where the word is sown; and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
verses.textEn: <red>Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>照样，那撒在石地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢欢喜喜地接受了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>照样，那撒在石地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢欢喜喜地接受了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the ones sown on rocky ground: the ones who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: These likewise are the ones sown on stony ground who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
verses.textEnNlt: The seed on the rocky soil represents those who hear the message and immediately receive it with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: And in a similar way these are the ones sown with seed on the rocky places, who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy;
verses.textEn: <red>Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是他们里面没有根，只是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难，受到迫害，就立刻跌倒了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是他们里面没有根，只是暂时的；一旦为道遭遇患难，受到迫害，就立刻跌倒了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但他心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they have no root in themselves, but endure for a while; then, when tribulation or persecution arises on account of the word, immediately they fall away.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they have no root in themselves, and so endure only for a time. Afterward, when tribulation or persecution arises for the word’s sake, immediately they stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: But since they don’t have deep roots, they don’t last long. They fall away as soon as they have problems or are persecuted for believing God’s word.
verses.textEnNasb: and yet they have no firm root in themselves, but are only temporary; then, when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately they fall away.
verses.textEn: <red>But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在荆棘里的，是指另一些人；他们听了道，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在荆棘里的，是指另一些人；他们听了道，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And others are the ones sown among thorns. They are those who hear the word,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the ones sown among thorns; they are the ones who hear the word,
verses.textEnNlt: The seed that fell among the thorns represents others who hear God’s word,
verses.textEnNasb: And others are the ones sown with seed among the thorns; these are the ones who have heard the word,
verses.textEn: <red>Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而今世的忧虑、财富的迷惑，以及种种的欲望，接连进来，把道挤住，就结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而今世的忧虑、财富的迷惑，以及种种的欲望，接连进来，把道挤住，就结不出果实来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑，和别样的私欲进来，把道挤住了，就不能结实。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but the cares of the world and the deceitfulness of riches and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word, and it proves unfruitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.textEnNlt: but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the worries of this life, the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things, so no fruit is produced.
verses.textEnNasb: but the worries of the world, and the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desires for other things enter and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.textEn: <red>but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，接受了，并且结出果实，有三十倍的、有六十倍的、有一百倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那撒在好土里的，就是人听了道，接受了，并且结出果实，有三十倍的、有六十倍的、有一百倍的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那撒在好地上的，就是人听道，又领受，并且结实，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But those that were sown on the good soil are the ones who hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold."
verses.textEnNkjv: But these are the ones sown on good ground, those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit: some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some a hundred."
verses.textEnNlt: And the seed that fell on good soil represents those who hear and accept God’s word and produce a harvest of thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as had been planted!"
verses.textEnNasb: And those are the ones sown with seed on the good soil; and they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much."
verses.textEn: <red>Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>灯难道是拿来放在量器底下或床底下的吗？它不是该放在灯台上吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>灯难道是拿来放在量器底下或床底下的吗？它不是该放在灯台上吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对他们说：「人拿灯来，岂是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在灯台上吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Is a lamp brought in to be put under a basket, or under a bed, and not on a stand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Also He said to them, "Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Is it not to be set on a lampstand?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus asked them, "Would anyone light a lamp and then put it under a basket or under a bed? Of course not! A lamp is placed on a stand, where its light will shine.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "A lamp is not brought to be put under a basket, or under a bed, is it? Is it not brought to be put on the lampstand?
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don’t you put it on its stand?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为没有甚么隐藏的事不被显明出来，没有甚么掩盖的事不被揭露的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为没有甚么隐藏的事不被显明出来，没有甚么掩盖的事不被揭露的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为掩藏的事，没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事，没有不露出来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For nothing is hidden except to be made manifest; nor is anything secret except to come to light.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there is nothing hidden which will not be revealed, nor has anything been kept secret but that it should come to light.
verses.textEnNlt: For everything that is hidden will eventually be brought into the open, and every secret will be brought to light.
verses.textEnNasb: For nothing is hidden, except to be revealed; nor has anything been secret, but that it would come to light.
verses.textEn: <red>For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有耳可听的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有耳可听的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有耳可听的，就应当听！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."
verses.textEnNasb: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣又对他们说："要留心你们所听到的，你们用甚么尺度量给人，神也要用甚么尺度量给你们，并且要超过尺度给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣又对他们说："要留心你们所听到的，你们用甚么尺度量给人，神也要用甚么尺度量给你们，并且要超过尺度给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：「你们所听的要留心。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要多给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Considerp carefully what you hear,”</red> he continued. <red>“With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Pay attention to what you hear: with the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and still more will be added to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Take heed what you hear. With the same measure you use, it will be measured to you; and to you who hear, more will be given.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he added, "Pay close attention to what you hear. The closer you listen, the more understanding you will be given —and you will receive even more.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "Take care what you listen to. By your standard of measure it will be measured to you; and more will be given you besides.
verses.textEn: <red>“Considerp carefully what you hear,”</red> he continued. <red>“With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为那有的，还要给他；那没有的，就算他有甚么也要拿去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为那有的，还要给他；那没有的，就算他有甚么也要拿去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For to the one who has, more will be given, and from the one who has not, even what he has will be taken away."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever has, to him more will be given; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him."
verses.textEnNlt: To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what little understanding they have will be taken away from them."
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him."
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>神的国好象人在地里撒种，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>神的国好象人在地里撒种，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：「神的国如同人把种撒在地上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He also said, <red>“This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "The kingdom of God is as if a man should scatter seed on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "The kingdom of God is as if a man should scatter seed on the ground,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus also said, "The Kingdom of God is like a farmer who scatters seed on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying, "The kingdom of God is like a man who casts seed upon the soil;
verses.textEn: He also said, <red>“This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他夜里睡觉，白天起来，种子发芽生长，自己也不知道怎么会这样的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他夜里睡觉，白天起来，种子发芽生长，自己也不知道怎么会这样的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种就发芽渐长，那人却不晓得如何这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He sleeps and rises night and day, and the seed sprouts and grows; he knows not how.
verses.textEnNkjv: and should sleep by night and rise by day, and the seed should sprout and grow, he himself does not know how.
verses.textEnNlt: Night and day, while he’s asleep or awake, the seed sprouts and grows, but he does not understand how it happens.
verses.textEnNasb: and he goes to bed at night and gets up daily, and the seed sprouts and grows—how, he himself does not know.
verses.textEn: <red>Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>地生五谷是自然的，先长苗，后吐穗，最后穗上结满了子粒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>地生五谷是自然的，先长苗，后吐穗，最后穗上结满了子粒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>地生五谷是出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The earth produces by itself, first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the earth yields crops by itself: first the blade, then the head, after that the full grain in the head.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth produces the crops on its own. First a leaf blade pushes through, then the heads of wheat are formed, and finally the grain ripens.
verses.textEnNasb: The soil produces crops by itself; first the stalk, then the head, then the mature grain in the head.
verses.textEn: <red>All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>庄稼熟了，就派人用镰刀割下，因为收成的时候到了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>庄稼熟了，就派人用镰刀割下，因为收成的时候到了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>谷既熟了，就用镰刀去割，因为收成的时候到了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when the grain is ripe, at once he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the grain ripens, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come."
verses.textEnNlt: And as soon as the grain is ready, the farmer comes and harvests it with a sickle, for the harvest time has come."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the crop permits, he immediately puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come."
verses.textEn: <red>As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”</red>

verses.textZh: 又说："<red>我们要把神的国比作甚么呢？我们可以用甚么比喻来形容它呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："<red>我们要把神的国比作甚么呢？我们可以用甚么比喻来形容它呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：「神的国，我们可用什么比较呢？可用什么比喻表明呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Again he said, <red>“What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "With what can we compare the kingdom of God, or what parable shall we use for it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "To what shall we liken the kingdom of God? Or with what parable shall we picture it?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "How can I describe the Kingdom of God? What story should I use to illustrate it?
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying, "How shall we picture the kingdom of God, or by what parable shall we present it?
verses.textEn: Again he said, <red>“What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>它好象一粒芥菜种，刚种下去的时候，比地上的一切种子都小，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>它好象一粒芥菜种，刚种下去的时候，比地上的一切种子都小，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，虽比地上的百种都小，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when sown on the ground, is the smallest of all the seeds on earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: It is like a mustard seed which, when it is sown on the ground, is smaller than all the seeds on earth;
verses.textEnNlt: It is like a mustard seed planted in the ground. It is the smallest of all seeds,
verses.textEnNasb: It is like a mustard seed, which, when sown upon the soil, though it is the smallest of all the seeds that are upon the soil,
verses.textEn: <red>It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>种下以后，生长起来，却比一切蔬菜都大，长出大枝子，甚至天空的飞鸟都可以在它的荫下搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>种下以后，生长起来，却比一切蔬菜都大，长出大枝子，甚至天空的飞鸟都可以在它的荫下搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但种上以后，就长起来，比各样的菜都大，又长出大枝来，甚至天上的飞鸟可以宿在它的荫下。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yet when it is sown it grows up and becomes larger than all the garden plants and puts out large branches, so that the birds of the air can make nests in its shade."
verses.textEnNkjv: but when it is sown, it grows up and becomes greater than all herbs, and shoots out large branches, so that the birds of the air may nest under its shade."
verses.textEnNlt: but it becomes the largest of all garden plants; it grows long branches, and birds can make nests in its shade."
verses.textEnNasb: yet when it is sown, it grows up and becomes larger than all the garden plants, and forms large branches, with the result that the birds of the sky can nest under its shade."
verses.textEn: <red>Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照着他们所能听懂的，向他们讲道；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照着他们所能听懂的，向他们讲道；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照他们所能听的，对他们讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.
verses.textEnEsv: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with many such parables He spoke the word to them as they were able to hear it.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus used many similar stories and illustrations to teach the people as much as they could understand.
verses.textEnNasb: And with many such parables He was speaking the word to them, so far as they were able to understand it;
verses.textEn: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.

verses.textZh: 不用比喻，就不对他们讲。只有单独和自己的门徒在一起的时候，才把一切解释给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不用比喻，就不对他们讲。只有单独和自己的门徒在一起的时候，才把一切解释给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不用比喻，就不对他们讲；没有人的时候，就把一切的道讲给门徒听。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.
verses.textEnEsv: He did not speak to them without a parable, but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: But without a parable He did not speak to them. And when they were alone, He explained all things to His disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, in his public ministry he never taught without using parables; but afterward, when he was alone with his disciples, he explained everything to them.
verses.textEnNasb: and He did not speak to them without a parable; but He was explaining everything privately to His own disciples.
verses.textEn: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.

verses.textZh: 当天黄昏，耶稣对门徒说："<red>我们渡到海那边去吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当天黄昏，耶稣对门徒说："<red>我们渡到海那边去吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 当那天晚上，耶稣对门徒说：「<red>我们渡到那边去吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go over to the other side.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, "Let us go across to the other side."
verses.textEnNkjv: On the same day, when evening had come, He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side."
verses.textEnNlt: As evening came, Jesus said to his disciples, "Let’s cross to the other side of the lake."
verses.textEnNasb: On that day, when evening came, He *said to them, "Let’s go over to the other side."
verses.textEn: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go over to the other side.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒离开群众，耶稣已经在船上，他们就载他过去，也有别的船和他同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒离开群众，耶稣已经在船上，他们就载他过去，也有别的船和他同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒离开众人，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把他一同带去；也有别的船和他同行。
verses.textEnNiv: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And leaving the crowd, they took him with them in the boat, just as he was. And other boats were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had left the multitude, they took Him along in the boat as He was. And other little boats were also with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So they took Jesus in the boat and started out, leaving the crowds behind (although other boats followed).
verses.textEnNasb: After dismissing the crowd, they *took Him along with them in the boat, just as He was; and other boats were with Him.
verses.textEn: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.

verses.textZh: 忽然起了狂风，波浪不断地打进船来，舱里积满了水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然起了狂风，波浪不断地打进船来，舱里积满了水。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然起了暴风，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。
verses.textEnNiv: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.
verses.textEnEsv: And a great windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking into the boat, so that the boat was already filling.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a great windstorm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so that it was already filling.
verses.textEnNlt: But soon a fierce storm came up. High waves were breaking into the boat, and it began to fill with water.
verses.textEnNasb: And a fierce gale of wind *developed, and the waves were breaking over the boat so much that the boat was already filling with water.
verses.textEn: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却在船尾靠着枕头睡着了。门徒把他叫醒，对他说："老师，我们要死了，你不管吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却在船尾靠着枕头睡着了。门徒把他叫醒，对他说："老师，我们要死了，你不管吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在船尾上，枕着枕头睡觉。门徒叫醒了他，说：「夫子！我们丧命，你不顾吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, "Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?"
verses.textEnEsv: But he was in the stern, asleep on the cushion. And they woke him and said to him, "Teacher, do you not care that we are perishing?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He was in the stern, asleep on a pillow. And they awoke Him and said to Him, "Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was sleeping at the back of the boat with his head on a cushion. The disciples woke him up, shouting, "Teacher, don’t you care that we’re going to drown?"
verses.textEnNasb: And yet Jesus Himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they *woke Him and *said to Him, "Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?"
verses.textEn: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, "Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣起来，斥责了风，又对海说："<red>不要作声！安静吧！</red>"风就停止，大大地平静了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣起来，斥责了风，又对海说："<red>不要作声！安静吧！</red>"风就停止，大大地平静了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣醒了，斥责风，向海说：「<red>住了吧！静了吧！</red>」风就止住，大大地平静了。
verses.textEnNiv: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, <red>“Quiet! Be still!”</red> Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.
verses.textEnEsv: And he awoke and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, "Peace! Be still!" And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He arose and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Peace, be still!" And the wind ceased and there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and said to the waves, "Silence! Be still!" Suddenly the wind stopped, and there was a great calm.
verses.textEnNasb: And He got up and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, "Hush, be still." And the wind died down and it became perfectly calm.
verses.textEn: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, <red>“Quiet! Be still!”</red> Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

verses.textZh: 然后对他们说："<red>为甚么这样胆怯呢？你们怎么没有信心呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对他们说："<red>为甚么这样胆怯呢？你们怎么没有信心呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>为什么胆怯？你们还没有信心吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his disciples, <red>“Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Why are you so afraid? Have you still no faith?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Why are you so fearful? Howis it that you have no faith?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked them, "Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?"
verses.textEn: He said to his disciples, <red>“Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒非常惧怕，彼此说："这到底是谁，连风和海都听从他？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒非常惧怕，彼此说："这到底是谁，连风和海都听从他？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说：「这到底是谁，连风和海也听从他了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They were terrified and asked each other, "Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they were filled with great fear and said to one another, "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said to one another, "Who can this be, that even the wind and the sea obey Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples were absolutely terrified. "Who is this man?" they asked each other. "Even the wind and waves obey him!"
verses.textEnNasb: They became very much afraid and said to one another, "Who, then, is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?"
verses.textEn: They were terrified and asked each other, "Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!"

verses.textZh: 他们到了海的那边，进入格拉森人的地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了海的那边，进入格拉森人的地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到海那边格拉森人的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.
verses.textEnEsv: They came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gerasenes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gadarenes.
verses.textEnNlt: So they arrived at the other side of the lake, in the region of the Gerasenes.
verses.textEnNasb: They came to the other side of the sea, into the region of the Gerasenes.
verses.textEn: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.

verses.textZh: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污灵附着的人，从墓地里迎面而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污灵附着的人，从墓地里迎面而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污鬼附着的人从坟茔里出来迎着他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus had stepped out of the boat, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had come out of the boat, immediately there met Him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus climbed out of the boat, a man possessed by an evil spirit came out from the tombs to meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: When He got out of the boat, immediately a man from the tombs with an unclean spirit met Him.
verses.textEn: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.

verses.textZh: 那人经常住在坟墓中间，从来没有人能绑住他，甚至用锁炼都不能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人经常住在坟墓中间，从来没有人能绑住他，甚至用锁炼都不能。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人常住在坟茔里，没有人能捆住他，就是用铁链也不能；
verses.textEnNiv: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.
verses.textEnEsv: He lived among the tombs. And no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain,
verses.textEnNkjv: who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no one could bind him, not even with chains,
verses.textEnNlt: This man lived in the burial caves and could no longer be restrained, even with a chain.
verses.textEnNasb: He lived among the tombs; and no one was able to bind him anymore, not even with a chain,
verses.textEn: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.

verses.textZh: 曾经有很多次，人用脚镣和锁炼捆绑他，锁炼却被他挣断，脚镣也被他弄碎，始终没有人能制伏他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 曾经有很多次，人用脚镣和锁炼捆绑他，锁炼却被他挣断，脚镣也被他弄碎，始终没有人能制伏他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人屡次用脚镣和铁链捆锁他，铁链竟被他挣断了，脚镣也被他弄碎了；总没有人能制伏他。
verses.textEnNiv: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
verses.textEnEsv: for he had often been bound with shackles and chains, but he wrenched the chains apart, and he broke the shackles in pieces. No one had the strength to subdue him.
verses.textEnNkjv: because he had often been bound with shackles and chains. And the chains had been pulled apart by him, and the shackles broken in pieces; neither could anyone tame him.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever he was put into chains and shackles—as he often was—he snapped the chains from his wrists and smashed the shackles. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
verses.textEnNasb: because he had often been bound with shackles and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him and the shackles broken in pieces; and no one was strong enough to subdue him.
verses.textEn: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.

verses.textZh: 他昼夜在坟墓里和山野间喊叫，又用石头砍自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他昼夜在坟墓里和山野间喊叫，又用石头砍自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 他昼夜常在坟茔里和山中喊叫，又用石头砍自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.
verses.textEnEsv: Night and day among the tombs and on the mountains he was always crying out and cutting himself with stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains and in the tombs, crying out and cutting himself with stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Day and night he wandered among the burial caves and in the hills, howling and cutting himself with sharp stones.
verses.textEnNasb: Constantly, night and day, he was screaming among the tombs and in the mountains, and cutting himself with stones.
verses.textEn: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.

verses.textZh: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他，
verses.textZhCuv: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他，
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and fell down before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and worshiped Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus was still some distance away, the man saw him, ran to meet him, and bowed low before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Seeing Jesus from a distance, he ran up and bowed down before Him;
verses.textEn: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.

verses.textZh: 大声呼叫，说："至高神的儿子耶稣，我跟你有甚么关系呢？我指着神恳求你，不要叫我受苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声呼叫，说："至高神的儿子耶稣，我跟你有甚么关系呢？我指着神恳求你，不要叫我受苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大声呼叫说：「至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？我指着神恳求你，不要叫我受苦！」
verses.textEnNiv: He shouted at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And crying out with a loud voice, he said, "What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, do not torment me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cried out with a loud voice and said, "What have I to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I implore You by God that You do not torment me."
verses.textEnNlt: With a shriek, he screamed, "Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In the name of God, I beg you, don’t torture me!"
verses.textEnNasb: and shouting with a loud voice, he *said, " What business do You have with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I implore You by God, do not torment me!"
verses.textEn: He shouted at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God’s name don’t torture me!"

verses.textZh: 因为当时耶稣吩咐他："<red>你这污灵，从这人身上出来！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为当时耶稣吩咐他："<red>你这污灵，从这人身上出来！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 是因耶稣曾吩咐他说：「<red>污鬼啊，从这人身上出来吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: For Jesus had said to him, <red>“Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For he was saying to him, "Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For He said to him, "Come out of the man, unclean spirit!"
verses.textEnNlt: For Jesus had already said to the spirit, "Come out of the man, you evil spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: For He had already been saying to him, "Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!"
verses.textEn: For Jesus had said to him, <red>“Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣问他："<red>你叫甚么名字？</red>"他回答："<red>我名叫‘群’，因为我们众多。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣问他："<red>你叫甚么名字？</red>"他回答："<red>我名叫‘群’，因为我们众多。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问他说：「<red>你名叫什么？</red>」回答说：「<red>我名叫『群』，因为我们多的缘故</red>」；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus asked him, <red>“What is your name?”</red> “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" He replied, "My name is Legion, for we are many."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He asked him, "What is your name?" And he answered, saying, "My name is Legion; for we are many."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus demanded, "What is your name?" And he replied, "My name is Legion, because there are many of us inside this man."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was asking him, "What is your name?" And he *said to Him, "My name is Legion, for we are many."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus asked him, <red>“What is your name?”</red> “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

verses.textZh: 他再三央求耶稣，不要把他们从那地方赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再三央求耶稣，不要把他们从那地方赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 就再三地求耶稣，不要叫他们离开那地方。
verses.textEnNiv: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.
verses.textEnEsv: And he begged him earnestly not to send them out of the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he begged Him earnestly that He would not send them out of the country.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the evil spirits begged him again and again not to send them to some distant place.
verses.textEnNasb: And he begged Him earnestly not to send them out of the region.
verses.textEn: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.

verses.textZh: 附近的山坡上有一大群猪正在吃东西；
verses.textZhCnvs: 附近的山坡上有一大群猪正在吃东西；
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里山坡上，有一大群猪吃食；
verses.textEnNiv: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a great herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a large herd of swine was feeding there near the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding on the hillside nearby.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a large herd of pigs feeding nearby on the mountain.
verses.textEn: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.

verses.textZh: 污灵求耶稣说："打发我们到猪群那里附在猪身上吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 污灵求耶稣说："打发我们到猪群那里附在猪身上吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼就央求耶稣说：「求你打发我们往猪群里，附着猪去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The demons begged Jesus, "Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them."
verses.textEnEsv: and they begged him, saying, "Send us to the pigs; let us enter them."
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the demons begged Him, saying, "Send us to the swine, that we may enter them."
verses.textEnNlt: "Send us into those pigs," the spirits begged. "Let us enter them."
verses.textEnNasb: And the demons begged Him, saying, "Send us into the pigs so that we may enter them."
verses.textEn: The demons begged Jesus, "Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them."

verses.textZh: 耶稣准了他们。污灵就出来，进到猪群里去，于是那群猪闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了，猪的数目约有两千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣准了他们。污灵就出来，进到猪群里去，于是那群猪闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了，猪的数目约有两千。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣准了他们，污鬼就出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在海里，淹死了。猪的数目约有二千。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
verses.textEnEsv: So he gave them permission. And the unclean spirits came out and entered the pigs; and the herd, numbering about two thousand, rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at once Jesus gave them permission. Then the unclean spirits went out and entered the swine (there were about two thousand); and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the sea, and drowned in the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus gave them permission. The evil spirits came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd of about 2,000 pigs plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned in the water.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus gave them permission. And coming out, the unclean spirits entered the pigs; and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they were drowned in the sea.
verses.textEn: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

verses.textZh: 放猪的人都逃跑了，到城里和各乡村去报告，大家就来看发生了甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放猪的人都逃跑了，到城里和各乡村去报告，大家就来看发生了甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 放猪的就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。众人就来，要看是什么事。
verses.textEnNiv: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: The herdsmen fled and told it in the city and in the country. And people came to see what it was that had happened.
verses.textEnNkjv: So those who fed the swine fled, and they told it in the city and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that had happened.
verses.textEnNlt: The herdsmen fled to the nearby town and the surrounding countryside, spreading the news as they ran. People rushed out to see what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Their herdsmen ran away and reported it in the city and in the countryside. And the people came to see what it was that had happened.
verses.textEn: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

verses.textZh: 他们来到耶稣跟前，看见那被鬼附过的人，就是曾被名叫‘群’的鬼附过的人，坐在那里，穿上了衣服，神志清醒，他们就害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到耶稣跟前，看见那被鬼附过的人，就是曾被名叫‘群’的鬼附过的人，坐在那里，穿上了衣服，神志清醒，他们就害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Jesus and saw the demon-possessed man, the one who had had the legion, sitting there, clothed and in his right mind, and they were afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to Jesus, and saw the one whohadbeen demon-possessed and had the legion, sitting and clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: A crowd soon gathered around Jesus, and they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons. He was sitting there fully clothed and perfectly sane, and they were all afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: And then they *came to Jesus and *saw the man who had been demon-possessed sitting down, clothed and in his right mind, the very man who had previously had the "legion"; and they became frightened.
verses.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

verses.textZh: 看见的人把被鬼附过的人所遭遇的和那群猪的事，告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见的人把被鬼附过的人所遭遇的和那群猪的事，告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见这事的，便将鬼附之人所遇见的和那群猪的事都告诉了众人；
verses.textEnNiv: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who had seen it described to them what had happened to the demon-possessed man and to the pigs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who saw it told them how it happened to him whohadbeen demon-possessed, and about the swine.
verses.textEnNlt: Then those who had seen what happened told the others about the demon-possessed man and the pigs.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who had seen it described to them how it had happened to the demon-possessed man, and all about the pigs.
verses.textEn: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.

verses.textZh: 他们就要求耶稣离开他们的地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就要求耶稣离开他们的地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就央求耶稣离开他们的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.
verses.textEnEsv: And they began to beg Jesus to depart from their region.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they began to plead with Him to depart from their region.
verses.textEnNlt: And the crowd began pleading with Jesus to go away and leave them alone.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began to beg Him to leave their region.
verses.textEn: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.

verses.textZh: 耶稣上船的时候，那被鬼附过的人来求他，要和他在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣上船的时候，那被鬼附过的人来求他，要和他在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上船的时候，那从前被鬼附着的人恳求和耶稣同在。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
verses.textEnEsv: As he was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed with demons begged him that he might be with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He got into the boat, he who had been demon-possessed begged Him that he might be with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon possessed begged to go with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And as He was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed was begging Him that he might accompany Him.
verses.textEn: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣不许，却对他说："<red>你回家到你的亲属那里去，把主为你作了多么大的事，并他怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣不许，却对他说："<red>你回家到你的亲属那里去，把主为你作了多么大的事，并他怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣不许，却对他说：「<red>你回家去，到你的亲属那里，将主为你所做的是何等大的事，是怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus did not let him, but said, <red>“Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he did not permit him but said to him, "Go home to your friends and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you."
verses.textEnNkjv: However, Jesus did not permit him, but said to him, "Go home to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how He has had compassion on you."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "No, go home to your family, and tell them everything the Lord has done for you and how merciful he has been."
verses.textEnNasb: And He did not let him, but He *said to him, "Go home to your people and report to them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how He had mercy on you."
verses.textEn: Jesus did not let him, but said, <red>“Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人就走了，开始在低加波利传讲耶稣为他所作的大事，众人都希奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就走了，开始在低加波利传讲耶稣为他所作的大事，众人都希奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就走了，在低加坡里传扬耶稣为他做了何等大的事，众人就都希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him, and everyone marveled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he departed and began to proclaim in Decapolis all that Jesus had done for him; and all marveled.
verses.textEnNlt: So the man started off to visit the Ten Towns of that region and began to proclaim the great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed at what he told them.
verses.textEnNasb: And he went away and began to proclaim in Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed.
verses.textEn: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又坐船渡到那边；还在海边的时候，有一大群人向他围拢过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又坐船渡到那边；还在海边的时候，有一大群人向他围拢过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣坐船又渡到那边去，就有许多人到他那里聚集；他正在海边上。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus had crossed again in the boat to the other side, a great crowd gathered about him, and he was beside the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Jesus had crossed over again by boat to the other side, a great multitude gathered to Him; and He was by the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus got into the boat again and went back to the other side of the lake, where a large crowd gathered around him on the shore.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus had crossed over again in the boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him; and He stayed by the seashore.
verses.textEn: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.

verses.textZh: 当时来了一位会堂的主管，名叫叶鲁。他一看见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时来了一位会堂的主管，名叫叶鲁。他一看见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个管会堂的人，名叫睚鲁，来见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: Then came one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, and seeing him, he fell at his feet
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue came, Jairus by name. And when he saw Him, he fell at His feet
verses.textEnNlt: Then a leader of the local synagogue, whose name was Jairus, arrived. When he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet,
verses.textEnNasb: And one of the synagogue officials, named Jairus, *came, and upon seeing Him, *fell at His feet
verses.textEn: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.

verses.textZh: 迫切地求他说："我的小女儿快要死了，请你来按手在她身上，把她救活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迫切地求他说："我的小女儿快要死了，请你来按手在她身上，把她救活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 再三地求他，说：「我的小女儿快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她痊愈，得以活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He pleaded earnestly with him, "My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live."
verses.textEnEsv: and implored him earnestly, saying, "My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well and live."
verses.textEnNkjv: and begged Him earnestly, saying, "My little daughter lies at the point of death. Come and lay Your hands on her, that she may be healed, and she will live."
verses.textEnNlt: pleading fervently with him. "My little daughter is dying," he said. "Please come and lay your hands on her; heal her so she can live."
verses.textEnNasb: and *pleaded with Him earnestly, saying, "My little daughter is at the point of death; please come and lay Your hands on her, so that she will get well and live."
verses.textEn: He pleaded earnestly with him, "My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live."
