verses.textZh: 耶稣就和他一起去了。 一大群人跟着他，拥挤着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就和他一起去了。 一大群人跟着他，拥挤着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就和他同去。 有许多人跟随拥挤他。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went with him. And a great crowd followed him and thronged about him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus went with him, and a great multitude followed Him and thronged Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus went with him, and all the people followed, crowding around him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went off with him; and a large crowd was following Him and pressing in on Him.
verses.textEn: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.

verses.textZh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏病，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏病，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，
verses.textEnNiv: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a woman who had had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain woman had a flow of blood for twelve years,
verses.textEnNlt: A woman in the crowd had suffered for twelve years with constant bleeding.
verses.textEnNasb: A woman who had had a hemorrhage for twelve years,
verses.textEn: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.

verses.textZh: 在好些医生手中受了许多痛苦，又花尽了她一切所有的，不仅毫无起色，反而更加沉重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在好些医生手中受了许多痛苦，又花尽了她一切所有的，不仅毫无起色，反而更加沉重。
verses.textZhCuv: 在好些医生手里受了许多的苦，又花尽了她所有的，一点也不见好，病势反倒更重了。
verses.textEnNiv: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.
verses.textEnEsv: and who had suffered much under many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better but rather grew worse.
verses.textEnNkjv: and had suffered many things from many physicians. She had spent all that she had and was no better, but rather grew worse.
verses.textEnNlt: She had suffered a great deal from many doctors, and over the years she had spent everything she had to pay them, but she had gotten no better. In fact, she had gotten worse.
verses.textEnNasb: and had endured much at the hands of many physicians, and had spent all that she had and was not helped at all, but instead had become worse—
verses.textEn: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.

verses.textZh: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后面来杂在人群中间，摸耶稣的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后面来杂在人群中间，摸耶稣的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后头来，杂在众人中间，摸耶稣的衣裳，
verses.textEnNiv: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,
verses.textEnEsv: She had heard the reports about Jesus and came up behind him in the crowd and touched his garment.
verses.textEnNkjv: When she heard about Jesus, she came behind Him in the crowd and touched His garment.
verses.textEnNlt: She had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him through the crowd and touched his robe.
verses.textEnNasb: after hearing about Jesus, she came up in the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
verses.textEn: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,

verses.textZh: 因为她说："只要摸到他的衣服，我就必痊愈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为她说："只要摸到他的衣服，我就必痊愈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 意思说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」
verses.textEnNiv: because she thought, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed."
verses.textEnEsv: For she said, "If I touch even his garments, I will be made well."
verses.textEnNkjv: For she said, "If only I may touch His clothes, I shall be made well."
verses.textEnNlt: For she thought to herself, "If I can just touch his robe, I will be healed."
verses.textEnNasb: For she had been saying to herself, "If I just touch His garments, I will get well."
verses.textEn: because she thought, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed."

verses.textZh: 于是她血漏的源头立刻干了，她在身体上感觉到病已经得了医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她血漏的源头立刻干了，她在身体上感觉到病已经得了医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是她血漏的源头立刻干了；她便觉得身上的灾病好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately the flow of blood dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her disease.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of the affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately the bleeding stopped, and she could feel in her body that she had been healed of her terrible condition.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately the flow of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her disease.
verses.textEn: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.

verses.textZh: 耶稣自己立刻觉得有能力从他里面出去，就转过身来对群众说："<red>谁摸了我的衣服？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣自己立刻觉得有能力从他里面出去，就转过身来对群众说："<red>谁摸了我的衣服？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣顿时心里觉得有能力从自己身上出去，就在众人中间转过来，说：「<red>谁摸我的衣裳？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, <red>“Who touched my clothes?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus, perceiving in himself that power had gone out from him, immediately turned about in the crowd and said, "Who touched my garments?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in Himself that power had gone out of Him, turned around in the crowd and said, "Who touched My clothes?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus realized at once that healing power had gone out from him, so he turned around in the crowd and asked, "Who touched my robe?"
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately Jesus, perceiving in Himself that power from Him had gone out, turned around in the crowd and said, "Who touched My garments?"
verses.textEn: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, <red>“Who touched my clothes?”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒对他说："<red>你看，这么多人拥挤你，你还问‘谁摸我’吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒对他说："<red>你看，这么多人拥挤你，你还问‘谁摸我’吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒对他说：「<red>你看众人拥挤你，还说『谁摸我』吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, <red>‘Who touched me?’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And his disciples said to him, "You see the crowd pressing around you, and yet you say, ‘Who touched me?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But His disciples said to Him, "You see the multitude thronging You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: His disciples said to him, "Look at this crowd pressing around you. How can you ask, ‘Who touched me?’"
verses.textEnNasb: And His disciples said to Him, "You see the crowd pressing in on You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ "
verses.textEn: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, <red>‘Who touched me?’”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣周围观看，要看作这事的女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣周围观看，要看作这事的女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣周围观看，要见做这事的女人。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he looked around to see who had done it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: But he kept on looking around to see who had done it.
verses.textEnNasb: And He looked around to see the woman who had done this.
verses.textEn: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.

verses.textZh: 那女人知道在她身上所成就的事，就恐惧战兢地前来向耶稣俯伏，把实情全告诉了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人知道在她身上所成就的事，就恐惧战兢地前来向耶稣俯伏，把实情全告诉了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐惧战兢，来俯伏在耶稣跟前，将实情全告诉他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.
verses.textEnEsv: But the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came in fear and trembling and fell down before him and told him the whole truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him and told Him the whole truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the frightened woman, trembling at the realization of what had happened to her, came and fell to her knees in front of him and told him what she had done.
verses.textEnNasb: But the woman, fearing and trembling, aware of what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him and told Him the whole truth.
verses.textEn: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："<red>女儿，你的信使你痊愈了，平安地回去吧，你的病已经好了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："<red>女儿，你的信使你痊愈了，平安地回去吧，你的病已经好了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对她说：「<red>女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的灾病痊愈了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to her, <red>“Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your affliction."
verses.textEnNlt: And he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace. Your suffering is over."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace and be cured of your disease."
verses.textEn: He said to her, <red>“Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在说话的时候，有人从会堂主管的家里来说："你的女儿已经死了，何必还劳动老师呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在说话的时候，有人从会堂主管的家里来说："你的女儿已经死了，何必还劳动老师呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说：「你的女儿死了，何必还劳动先生呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," they said. "Why bother the teacher anymore?"
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking, there came from the ruler’s house some who said, "Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?"
verses.textEnNkjv: While He was still speaking, some came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house who said, "Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the Teacher any further?"
verses.textEnNlt: While he was still speaking to her, messengers arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. They told him, "Your daughter is dead. There’s no use troubling the Teacher now."
verses.textEnNasb: While He was still speaking, people *came from the house of the synagogue official, saying, "Your daughter has died; why bother the Teacher further?"
verses.textEn: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," they said. "Why bother the teacher anymore?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对会堂主管说："<red>不要怕！只要信！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对会堂主管说："<red>不要怕！只要信！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对管会堂的说：「<red>不要怕，只要信！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, <red>“Don’t be afraid; just believe.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But overhearing what they said, Jesus said to the ruler of the synagogue, "Do not fear, only believe."
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, He said to the ruler of the synagogue, "Do not be afraid; only believe."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus, "Don’t be afraid. Just have faith."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, overhearing what was being spoken, *said to the synagogue official, "Do not be afraid, only believe."
verses.textEn: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, <red>“Don’t be afraid; just believe.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他不许别人跟他一起去，只带了彼得、雅各和雅各的弟弟约翰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他不许别人跟他一起去，只带了彼得、雅各和雅各的弟弟约翰。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰同去，不许别人跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.
verses.textEnEsv: And he allowed no one to follow him except Peter and James and John the brother of James.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He permitted no one to follow Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus stopped the crowd and wouldn’t let anyone go with him except Peter, James, and John (the brother of James).
verses.textEnNasb: And He allowed no one to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
verses.textEn: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.

verses.textZh: 他们来到会堂主管的家，耶稣看见许多人哭泣哀号，一片混乱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到会堂主管的家，耶稣看见许多人哭泣哀号，一片混乱，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到管会堂的家里；耶稣看见那里乱嚷，并有人大大地哭泣哀号，
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.
verses.textEnEsv: They came to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and Jesus saw a commotion, people weeping and wailing loudly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and saw a tumult and those who wept and wailed loudly.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw much commotion and weeping and wailing.
verses.textEnNasb: They *came to the house of the synagogue official, and He *saw a commotion, and people loudly weeping and wailing.
verses.textEn: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.

verses.textZh: 就走进去，对众人说："<red>为甚么大哭大嚷呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就走进去，对众人说："<red>为甚么大哭大嚷呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 进到里面，就对他们说：「<red>为什么乱嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He went in and said to them, <red>“Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had entered, he said to them, "Why are you making a commotion and weeping? The child is not dead but sleeping."
verses.textEnNkjv: When He came in, He said to them, "Why make this commotion and weep? The child is not dead, but sleeping."
verses.textEnNlt: He went inside and asked, "Why all this commotion and weeping? The child isn’t dead; she’s only asleep."
verses.textEnNasb: And after entering, He *said to them, "Why are you making a commotion and weeping? The child has not died, but is asleep."
verses.textEn: He went in and said to them, <red>“Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”</red>

verses.textZh: 众人就嘲笑他。耶稣把众人都赶出去，带着孩子的父母和跟随他的门徒，进入孩子所在的房间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人就嘲笑他。耶稣把众人都赶出去，带着孩子的父母和跟随他的门徒，进入孩子所在的房间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就嗤笑耶稣。耶稣把他们都撵出去，就带着孩子的父母和跟随的人进了孩子所在的地方，
verses.textEnNiv: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child’s father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.
verses.textEnEsv: And they laughed at him. But he put them all outside and took the child’s father and mother and those who were with him and went in where the child was.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they ridiculed Him. But when He had put them all outside, He took the father and the mother of the child, and those whowere with Him, and entered where the child was lying.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd laughed at him. But he made them all leave, and he took the girl’s father and mother and his three disciples into the room where the girl was lying.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began laughing at Him. But putting them all outside, He *took along the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and *entered the room where the child was in bed.
verses.textEn: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child’s father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.

verses.textZh: 耶稣拉着孩子的手，对她说："<red>大利大，古米！</red>"翻译出来就是："小女孩，我吩咐你起来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣拉着孩子的手，对她说："<red>大利大，古米！</red>"翻译出来就是："小女孩，我吩咐你起来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 就拉着孩子的手，对她说：「<red>大利大，古米！</red>」（翻出来就是说：「<red>闺女，我吩咐你起来！</red>」）
verses.textEnNiv: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha*ir koum!”*ir (which means <red>“Little girl, I say to you, get up!”).</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Taking her by the hand he said to her, "Talitha cumi," which means, "Little girl, I say to you, arise."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the child by the hand, and said to her, "Talitha, cumi," which is translated, "Little girl, I say to you, arise."
verses.textEnNlt: Holding her hand, he said to her, "Talitha koum," which means "Little girl, get up!"
verses.textEnNasb: And taking the child by the hand, He *said to her, "Talitha, kum!" (which translated means, "Little girl, I say to you, get up!").
verses.textEn: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha*ir koum!”*ir (which means <red>“Little girl, I say to you, get up!”).</red>

verses.textZh: 那女孩子就立刻起来行走；那时她已经十二岁了。众人就非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女孩子就立刻起来行走；那时她已经十二岁了。众人就非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 那闺女立时起来走。他们就大大地惊奇；闺女已经十二岁了。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately the girl got up and began walking (for she was twelve years of age), and they were immediately overcome with amazement.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately the girl arose and walked, for she was twelve years ofage. And they were overcome with great amazement.
verses.textEnNlt: And the girl, who was twelve years old, immediately stood up and walked around! They were overwhelmed and totally amazed.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately the girl got up and began to walk, for she was twelve years old. And immediately they were completely astonished.
verses.textEn: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.

verses.textZh: 耶稣再三嘱咐他们，不要让人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣再三嘱咐他们，不要让人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: And he strictly charged them that no one should know this, and told them to give her something to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He commanded them strictly that no one should know it, and said that something should be given her to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anyone what had happened, and then he told them to give her something to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And He gave them strict orders that no one was to know about this, and He told them to have something given her to eat.
verses.textEn: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

verses.textZh: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡，他的门徒跟着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡，他的门徒跟着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡；门徒也跟从他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: He went away from there and came to his hometown, and his disciples followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went out from there and came to His own country, and His disciples followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus left that part of the country and returned with his disciples to Nazareth, his hometown.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus went out from there and *came into His hometown; and His disciples *followed Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.

verses.textZh: 到了安息日，他开始在会堂里教导人；很多人听见了，都惊奇地说："这个人从哪里得来这一切呢？所赐给他的是怎么样的智慧，竟然借着他的手行出这样的神迹？
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了安息日，他开始在会堂里教导人；很多人听见了，都惊奇地说："这个人从哪里得来这一切呢？所赐给他的是怎么样的智慧，竟然借着他的手行出这样的神迹？
verses.textZhCuv: 到了安息日，他在会堂里教训人。众人听见，就甚希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这些事呢？所赐给他的是什么智慧？他手所做的是何等的异能呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. "Where did this man get these things?" they asked. "What’s this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?
verses.textEnEsv: And on the Sabbath he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were astonished, saying, "Where did this man get these things? What is the wisdom given to him? How are such mighty works done by his hands?
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Sabbath had come, He began to teach in the synagogue. And many hearing Him were astonished, saying, "Where did this Man get these things? And what wisdom is this which is given to Him, that such mighty works are performed by His hands!
verses.textEnNlt: The next Sabbath he began teaching in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. They asked, "Where did he get all this wisdom and the power to perform such miracles?"
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue; and the many listeners were astonished, saying, "Where did this Man learn these things, and what is this wisdom that has been given to Him, and such miracles as these performed by His hands?
verses.textEn: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. "Where did this man get these things?" they asked. "What’s this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?

verses.textZh: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子，雅各、约西、犹大、西门的哥哥吗？他的妹妹们不也在我们这里吗？"他们就厌弃耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子，雅各、约西、犹大、西门的哥哥吗？他的妹妹们不也在我们这里吗？"他们就厌弃耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子雅各、约西、犹大、西门的长兄吗？他妹妹们不也是在我们这里吗？」他们就厌弃他 。
verses.textEnNiv: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t this Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?" And they took offense at him.
verses.textEnEsv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? And are not his sisters here with us?" And they took offense at him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Is this not the carpenter, the Son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And are not His sisters here with us?" So they were offended at Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they scoffed, "He’s just a carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon. And his sisters live right here among us." They were deeply offended and refused to believe in him.
verses.textEnNasb: Is this not the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And are His sisters not here with us?" And they took offense at Him.
verses.textEn: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t this Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?" And they took offense at him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>先知除了在自己的本乡、本族、本家之外，没有不受人尊敬的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>先知除了在自己的本乡、本族、本家之外，没有不受人尊敬的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>大凡先知，除了本地、亲属、本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and among his relatives and in his own household."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor except in his own country, among his own relatives, and in his own house."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told them, "A prophet is honored everywhere except in his own hometown and among his relatives and his own family."
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not dishonored except in his hometown and among his own relatives, and in his own household."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣不能在那里行甚么神迹，只给几个病人按手，医好了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣不能在那里行甚么神迹，只给几个病人按手，医好了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就在那里不得行什么异能，不过按手在几个病人身上，治好他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He could do no mighty work there, except that He laid His hands on a few sick people and healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: And because of their unbelief, he couldn’t do any miracles among them except to place his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He could not do any miracle there except that He laid His hands on a few sick people and healed them.
verses.textEn: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.

verses.textZh: 对于那些人的不信，他感到诧异。 耶稣到周围的乡村去继续教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于那些人的不信，他感到诧异。 耶稣到周围的乡村去继续教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也诧异他们不信，就往周围乡村教训人去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.
verses.textEnEsv: And he marveled because of their unbelief. And he went about among the villages teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He marveled because of their unbelief. Then He went about the villages in a circuit, teaching.
verses.textEnNlt: And he was amazed at their unbelief. Then Jesus went from village to village, teaching the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He was going around the villages, teaching.
verses.textEn: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.

verses.textZh: 他把十二门徒叫来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，赐给他们胜过污灵的权柄；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把十二门徒叫来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，赐给他们胜过污灵的权柄；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，也赐给他们权柄，制伏污鬼；
verses.textEnNiv: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.
verses.textEnEsv: And he called the twelve and began to send them out two by two, and gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He called the twelve to Himself, and began to send them out two by two, and gave them power over unclean spirits.
verses.textEnNlt: And he called his twelve disciples together and began sending them out two by two, giving them authority to cast out evil spirits.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *summoned the twelve and began to send them out in pairs, and gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
verses.textEn: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.

verses.textZh: 吩咐他们说："<red>除了手杖以外，路上甚么都不要带，不要带干粮，不要带口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐他们说："<red>除了手杖以外，路上甚么都不要带，不要带干粮，不要带口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并且嘱咐他们：「行路的时候不要带食物和口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，除了拐杖以外，什么都不要带；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: These were his instructions: <red>“Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He charged them to take nothing for their journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
verses.textEnNkjv: He commanded them to take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bag, no bread, no copper in their money belts—
verses.textEnNlt: He told them to take nothing for their journey except a walking stick—no food, no traveler’s bag, no money.
verses.textEnNasb: and He instructed them that they were to take nothing for their journey, except a mere staff—no bread, no bag, no money in their belt—
verses.textEn: These were his instructions: <red>“Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只穿一双鞋，不要穿两件衣服。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只穿一双鞋，不要穿两件衣服。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只要穿鞋，也不要穿两件褂子」；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but to wear sandals and not put on two tunics.
verses.textEnNkjv: but to wear sandals, and not to put on two tunics.
verses.textEnNlt: He allowed them to wear sandals but not to take a change of clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: but to wear sandals; and He added,"Do not wear two tunics."
verses.textEn: <red>Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又对他们说："你们无论到哪里，进了一家就住在那家，直到离开那个地方。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又对他们说："你们无论到哪里，进了一家就住在那家，直到离开那个地方。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又对他们说：「你们无论到何处，进了人的家，就住在那里，直到离开那地方。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you depart from there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also He said to them, "In whatever place you enter a house, stay there till you depart from that place.
verses.textEnNlt: "Wherever you go," he said, "stay in the same house until you leave town.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Wherever you enter a house, stay there until you leave town.
verses.textEn: <red>Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>甚么地方不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那地方的时候，就要把脚上的灰尘跺下去，作为反对他们的见证。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>甚么地方不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那地方的时候，就要把脚上的灰尘跺下去，作为反对他们的见证。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>何处的人不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那里的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去，对他们作见证。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if any place will not receive you and they will not listen to you, when you leave, shake off the dust that is on your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever will not receive you nor hear you, when you depart from there, shake off the dust under your feet as a testimony against them.Assuredly, I say to you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!"
verses.textEnNlt: But if any place refuses to welcome you or listen to you, shake its dust from your feet as you leave to show that you have abandoned those people to their fate."
verses.textEnNasb: Any place that does not receive you or listen to you, as you go out from there, shake the dust off the soles of your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.textEn: <red>And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，
verses.textEnNiv: They went out and preached that people should repent.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went out and proclaimed that people should repent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out and preached that people should repent.
verses.textEnNlt: So the disciples went out, telling everyone they met to repent of their sins and turn to God.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went out and preached that people are to repent.
verses.textEn: They went out and preached that people should repent.

verses.textZh: 赶出许多鬼，用油抹了许多病人，医好他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赶出许多鬼，用油抹了许多病人，医好他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 又赶出许多的鬼，用油抹了许多病人，治好他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they cast out many demons and anointed with oil many who were sick and healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many who were sick, and healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: And they cast out many demons and healed many sick people, anointing them with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were casting out many demons and were anointing with oil many sick people and healing them.
verses.textEn: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.

verses.textZh: 当时耶稣的名声传扬出去，希律王也听到了。有人说："施洗的约翰从死人中复活了，所以他身上有行神迹的能力。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时耶稣的名声传扬出去，希律王也听到了。有人说："施洗的约翰从死人中复活了，所以他身上有行神迹的能力。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的名声传扬出来。希律王听见了，就说：「施洗的约翰从死里复活了，所以这些异能由他里面发出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known. Some were saying, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnEsv: King Herod heard of it, for Jesus’ name had become known. Some said, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead. That is why these miraculous powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Herod heard ofHim, for His name had become well known. And he said, "John the Baptist is risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him."
verses.textEnNlt: Herod Antipas, the king, soon heard about Jesus, because everyone was talking about him. Some were saying, "This must be John the Baptist raised from the dead. That is why he can do such miracles."
verses.textEnNasb: And King Herod heard about it, for His name had become well known; and people were saying, "John the Baptist has risen from the dead, and that is why these miraculous powers are at work in Him."
verses.textEn: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known. Some were saying, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him."

verses.textZh: 又有人说："他是以利亚。"还有人说："他是先知，像古时先知中的一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有人说："他是以利亚。"还有人说："他是先知，像古时先知中的一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但别人说：「是以利亚。」又有人说：「是先知，正像先知中的一位。」
verses.textEnNiv: Others said, "He is Elijah." And still others claimed, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago."
verses.textEnEsv: But others said, "He is Elijah." And others said, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old."
verses.textEnNkjv: Others said, "It is Elijah." And others said, "It is the Prophet, or like one of the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: Others said, "He’s the prophet Elijah." Still others said, "He’s a prophet like the other great prophets of the past."
verses.textEnNasb: But others were saying, "He is Elijah." And others were saying, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old."
verses.textEn: Others said, "He is Elijah." And still others claimed, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago."

verses.textZh: 希律听见就说："是约翰，我砍了他的头，他又活了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律听见就说："是约翰，我砍了他的头，他又活了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 希律听见却说：「是我所斩的约翰，他复活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when Herod heard this, he said, "John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!"
verses.textEnEsv: But when Herod heard of it, he said, "John, whom I beheaded, has been raised."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Herod heard, he said, "This is John, whom I beheaded; he has been raised from the dead!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod heard about Jesus, he said, "John, the man I beheaded, has come back from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: But when Herod heard about it, he kept saying, "John, whom I beheaded, has risen!"
verses.textEn: But when Herod heard this, he said, "John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!"

verses.textZh: 原来希律曾亲自派人去捉拿约翰，把他捆锁在监里。他这样作，是为了他弟弟的妻子希罗底的缘故，因为他娶了希罗底为妻，
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来希律曾亲自派人去捉拿约翰，把他捆锁在监里。他这样作，是为了他弟弟的妻子希罗底的缘故，因为他娶了希罗底为妻，
verses.textZhCuv: 先是希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，差人去拿住约翰，锁在监里，因为希律已经娶了那妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, whom he had married.
verses.textEnEsv: For it was Herod who had sent and seized John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, because he had married her.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Herod himself had sent and laid hold of John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife; for he had married her.
verses.textEnNlt: For Herod had sent soldiers to arrest and imprison John as a favor to Herodias. She had been his brother Philip’s wife, but Herod had married her.
verses.textEnNasb: For Herod himself had sent men and had John arrested and bound in prison on account of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip, because he had married her.
verses.textEn: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, whom he had married.

verses.textZh: 而约翰曾对希律说："你占有你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 而约翰曾对希律说："你占有你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰曾对希律说：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
verses.textEnEsv: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Because John had said to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
verses.textEnNlt: John had been telling Herod, "It is against God’s law for you to marry your brother’s wife."
verses.textEnNasb: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."
verses.textEn: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife."

verses.textZh: 于是希罗底怀恨在心，想要杀他，只是不能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希罗底怀恨在心，想要杀他，只是不能。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是希罗底怀恨他，想要杀他，只是不能；
verses.textEnNiv: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,
verses.textEnEsv: And Herodias had a grudge against him and wanted to put him to death. But she could not,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Herodias held it against him and wanted to kill him, but she could not;
verses.textEnNlt: So Herodias bore a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But without Herod’s approval she was powerless,
verses.textEnNasb: And Herodias held a grudge against him and wanted to put him to death, and could not do so;
verses.textEn: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,

verses.textZh: 因为希律惧怕约翰，知道他是公义圣洁的人，就保护他。希律听了约翰的话，就非常困扰，却仍然喜欢听他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为希律惧怕约翰，知道他是公义圣洁的人，就保护他。希律听了约翰的话，就非常困扰，却仍然喜欢听他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为希律知道约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，保护他，听他讲论，就多照着行 ，并且乐意听他。
verses.textEnNiv: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled ; yet he liked to listen to him.
verses.textEnEsv: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and he kept him safe. When he heard him, he was greatly perplexed, and yet he heard him gladly.
verses.textEnNkjv: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just and holy man, and he protected him. And when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.textEnNlt: for Herod respected John; and knowing that he was a good and holy man, he protected him. Herod was greatly disturbed whenever he talked with John, but even so, he liked to listen to him.
verses.textEnNasb: for Herod was afraid of John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and he had been protecting him. And when he heard him, he was very perplexed; and yet he used to enjoy listening to him.
verses.textEn: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled ; yet he liked to listen to him.

verses.textZh: 有一天，机会来了。在希律生日的那一天，他为大臣、千夫长和加利利的要人摆设了筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，机会来了。在希律生日的那一天，他为大臣、千夫长和加利利的要人摆设了筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律摆设筵席，请了大臣和千夫长，并加利利作首领的。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: But an opportunity came when Herod on his birthday gave a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then an opportune day came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: Herodias’s chance finally came on Herod’s birthday. He gave a party for his high government officials, army officers, and the leading citizens of Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: An opportune day came when Herod, on his birthday, held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders, and the leading people of Galilee;
verses.textEn: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.

verses.textZh: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和在座的宾客都很开心。王就对女孩子说："你无论想要甚么，只管向我求，我一定给你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和在座的宾客都很开心。王就对女孩子说："你无论想要甚么，只管向我求，我一定给你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和同席的人都欢喜。王就对女子说：「你随意向我求什么，我必给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, "Ask me for anything you want, and I’ll give it to you."
verses.textEnEsv: For when Herodias’s daughter came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests. And the king said to the girl, "Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Herodias’ daughter herself came in and danced, and pleased Herod and those who sat with him, the king said to the girl, "Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then his daughter, also named Herodias, came in and performed a dance that greatly pleased Herod and his guests. "Ask me for anything you like," the king said to the girl, "and I will give it to you."
verses.textEnNasb: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests; and the king said to the girl, "Ask me for whatever you want, and I will give it to you."
verses.textEn: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, "Ask me for anything you want, and I’ll give it to you."

verses.textZh: 并且对她再三起誓："你无论向我求甚么，就是我国的一半，我也一定给你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且对她再三起誓："你无论向我求甚么，就是我国的一半，我也一定给你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对她起誓说：「随你向我求什么，就是我国的一半，我也必给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he promised her with an oath, "Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom."
verses.textEnEsv: And he vowed to her, "Whatever you ask me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: He also swore to her, "Whatever you ask me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom."
verses.textEnNlt: He even vowed, "I will give you whatever you ask, up to half my kingdom!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he swore to her, "Whatever you ask of me, I will give it to you, up to half of my kingdom."
verses.textEn: And he promised her with an oath, "Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom."

verses.textZh: 于是她出去问母亲："我该求甚么呢？"希罗底告诉她："施洗的约翰的头！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她出去问母亲："我该求甚么呢？"希罗底告诉她："施洗的约翰的头！"
verses.textZhCuv: 她就出去对她母亲说：「我可以求什么呢？」她母亲说：「施洗约翰的头。」
verses.textEnNiv: She went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask for?" "The head of John the Baptist," she answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And she went out and said to her mother, "For what should I ask?" And she said, "The head of John the Baptist."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask?" And she said, "The head of John the Baptist!"
verses.textEnNlt: She went out and asked her mother, "What should I ask for?" Her mother told her, "Ask for the head of John the Baptist!"
verses.textEnNasb: And she went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask for?" And she said, "The head of John the Baptist."
verses.textEn: She went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask for?" "The head of John the Baptist," she answered.

verses.textZh: 她急忙到王面前，向王要求说："愿王立刻把施洗的约翰的头放在盘子上给我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她急忙到王面前，向王要求说："愿王立刻把施洗的约翰的头放在盘子上给我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 她就急忙进去见王，求他说：「我愿王立时把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里给我。」
verses.textEnNiv: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: "I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
verses.textEnEsv: And she came in immediately with haste to the king and asked, saying, "I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately she came in with haste to the king and asked, saying, "I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
verses.textEnNlt: So the girl hurried back to the king and told him, "I want the head of John the Baptist, right now, on a tray!"
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately she came in a hurry to the king and asked, saying, "I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter."
verses.textEn: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: "I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter."

verses.textZh: 希律王非常忧愁，但是因为他的誓言和在座的宾客，就不愿拒绝她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律王非常忧愁，但是因为他的誓言和在座的宾客，就不愿拒绝她。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就甚忧愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辞，
verses.textEnNiv: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king was exceedingly sorry, but because of his oaths and his guests he did not want to break his word to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king was exceedingly sorry; yet, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he did not want to refuse her.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king deeply regretted what he had said; but because of the vows he had made in front of his guests, he couldn’t refuse her.
verses.textEnNasb: And although the king was very sorry, because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he was unwilling to refuse her.
verses.textEn: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.

verses.textZh: 希律王立刻差遣一个侍卫，吩咐把约翰的头拿来。侍卫就去了，在监里斩了约翰的头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律王立刻差遣一个侍卫，吩咐把约翰的头拿来。侍卫就去了，在监里斩了约翰的头，
verses.textZhCuv: 随即差一个护卫兵，吩咐拿约翰的头来。护卫兵就去，在监里斩了约翰，
verses.textEnNiv: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately the king sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. He went and beheaded him in the prison
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded his head to be brought. And he went and beheaded him in prison,
verses.textEnNlt: So he immediately sent an executioner to the prison to cut off John’s head and bring it to him. The soldier beheaded John in the prison,
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded him to bring back his head. And he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.textEn: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John’s head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,

verses.textZh: 把头放在盘子上，拿来交给那女孩子，女孩子又交给她的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把头放在盘子上，拿来交给那女孩子，女孩子又交给她的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给女子，女子就给她母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
verses.textEnEsv: and brought his head on a platter and gave it to the girl, and the girl gave it to her mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.
verses.textEnNlt: brought his head on a tray, and gave it to the girl, who took it to her mother.
verses.textEnNasb: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.
verses.textEn: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.

verses.textZh: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸体领去，安放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸体领去，安放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸首领去，葬在坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: When his disciples heard of it, they came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: When his disciples heard ofit, they came and took away his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: When John’s disciples heard what had happened, they came to get his body and buried it in a tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: When his disciples heard about this, they came and carried away his body, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.textEn: On hearing of this, John’s disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.

verses.textZh: 使徒们回来聚集在耶稣跟前，把他们所作和所教导的一切都报告给他听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒们回来聚集在耶稣跟前，把他们所作和所教导的一切都报告给他听。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒聚集到耶稣那里，将一切所做的事、所传的道全告诉他。
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.
verses.textEnEsv: The apostles returned to Jesus and told him all that they had done and taught.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the apostles gathered to Jesus and told Him all things, both what they had done and what they had taught.
verses.textEnNlt: The apostles returned to Jesus from their ministry tour and told him all they had done and taught.
verses.textEnNasb: The apostles *gathered together with Jesus; and they reported to Him all that they had done and taught.
verses.textEn: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>来，你们自己到旷野去休息一下。</red>"因为来往的人多，他们甚至没有时间吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>来，你们自己到旷野去休息一下。</red>"因为来往的人多，他们甚至没有时间吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就说：「<red>你们来，同我暗暗地到旷野地方去歇一歇。</red>」这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有工夫。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, <red>“Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Come away by yourselves to a desolate place and rest a while." For many were coming and going, and they had no leisure even to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Come aside by yourselves to a deserted place and rest a while." For there were many coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said, "Let’s go off by ourselves to a quiet place and rest awhile." He said this because there were so many people coming and going that Jesus and his apostles didn’t even have time to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Come away by yourselves to a secluded place and rest a little while." (For there were many people coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.)
verses.textEn: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, <red>“Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就悄悄地上了船，到旷野去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就悄悄地上了船，到旷野去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就坐船，暗暗地往旷野地方去。
verses.textEnNiv: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went away in the boat to a desolate place by themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they departed to a deserted place in the boat by themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: So they left by boat for a quiet place, where they could be alone.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went away in the boat to a secluded place by themselves.
verses.textEn: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.

verses.textZh: 群众看见他们走了，有许多人认出了他们，就从各城出来，跑到那里，比他们先赶到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众看见他们走了，有许多人认出了他们，就从各城出来，跑到那里，比他们先赶到。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见他们去，有许多认识他们的，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先赶到了。
verses.textEnNiv: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now many saw them going and recognized them, and they ran there on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the multitudes saw them departing, and many knew Him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But many people recognized them and saw them leaving, and people from many towns ran ahead along the shore and got there ahead of them.
verses.textEnNasb: The people saw them going, and many recognized them and ran there together on foot from all the cities, and got there ahead of them.
verses.textEn: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.

verses.textZh: 耶稣一下船，看见一大群人，就怜悯他们，因为他们好象羊没有牧人一样，就开始教导他们许多事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一下船，看见一大群人，就怜悯他们，因为他们好象羊没有牧人一样，就开始教导他们许多事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，因为他们如同羊没有牧人一般，于是开口教训他们许多道理。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.
verses.textEnEsv: When he went ashore he saw a great crowd, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And he began to teach them many things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, when He came out, saw a great multitude and was moved with compassion for them, because they were like sheep not having a shepherd. So He began to teach them many things.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus saw the huge crowd as he stepped from the boat, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus went ashore, He saw a large crowd, and He felt compassion for them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and He began to teach them many things.
verses.textEn: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.

verses.textZh: 天晚了，门徒前来对他说："这里是旷野的地方，天已经很晚了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天晚了，门徒前来对他说："这里是旷野的地方，天已经很晚了，
verses.textZhCuv: 天已经晚了，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，天已经晚了，
verses.textEnNiv: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. "This is a remote place," they said, "and it’s already very late.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it grew late, his disciples came to him and said, "This is a desolate place, and the hour is now late.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the day was now far spent, His disciples came to Him and said, "This is a deserted place, and already the hour is late.
verses.textEnNlt: Late in the afternoon his disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it’s already getting late.
verses.textEnNasb: And when it was already late, His disciples came up to Him and said, " This place is secluded and it is already late;
verses.textEn: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. "This is a remote place," they said, "and it’s already very late.

verses.textZh: 请叫他们散开，好让他们往周围的田舍村庄去，自己买点东西吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请叫他们散开，好让他们往周围的田舍村庄去，自己买点东西吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去，自己买什么吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat."
verses.textEnEsv: Send them away to go into the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread; for they have nothing to eat."
verses.textEnNlt: Send the crowds away so they can go to the nearby farms and villages and buy something to eat."
verses.textEnNasb: send them away so that they may go into the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat."
verses.textEn: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat."

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答他们："你们给他们吃吧！"门徒说："<red>要我们去买两百银币的饼给他们吃吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答他们："你们给他们吃吧！"门徒说："<red>要我们去买两百银币的饼给他们吃吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>你们给他们吃吧。</red>」门徒说：「<red>我们可以去买二十两银子的饼给他们吃吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he answered, <red>“You give them something to eat.”</red> They said to him, “That would take more than half a year’s wages! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered them, "You give them something to eat." And they said to him, "Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give it to them to eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to them, "You give them something to eat." And they said to Him, "Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "You feed them." "With what?" they asked. "We’d have to work for months to earn enough money to buy food for all these people!"
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered them, "You give them something to eat!" And they *said to Him, "Shall we go and spend two hundred denarii on bread, and give it to them to eat?"
verses.textEn: But he answered, <red>“You give them something to eat.”</red> They said to him, “That would take more than half a year’s wages! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："去看看你们有多少饼！"他们知道了，就说："五个饼，还有两条鱼。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："去看看你们有多少饼！"他们知道了，就说："五个饼，还有两条鱼。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们有多少饼，可以去看看。</red>」他们知道了，就说：「<red>五个饼，两条鱼。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> he asked. <red>“Go and see.”</red> When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "How many loaves do you have? Go and see." And when they had found out, they said, "Five, and two fish."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "How many loaves do you have? Go and see." And when they found out they said, "Five, and two fish."
verses.textEnNlt: "How much bread do you have?" he asked. "Go and find out." They came back and reported, "We have five loaves of bread and two fish."
verses.textEnNasb: But He *said to them, "How many loaves do you have? Go look!" And when they found out, they *said, "Five, and two fish."
verses.textEn: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> he asked. <red>“Go and see.”</red> When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣吩咐他们叫大家分组坐在青草地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣吩咐他们叫大家分组坐在青草地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣吩咐他们，叫众人一帮一帮地坐在青草地上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he commanded them all to sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He commanded them to make them all sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told the disciples to have the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.textEnNasb: And He ordered them all to recline by groups on the green grass.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.

verses.textZh: 他们就一排一排地坐了下来，有一百的，有五十的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就一排一排地坐了下来，有一百的，有五十的。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
verses.textEnNiv: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
verses.textEnEsv: So they sat down in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sat down in ranks, in hundreds and in fifties.
verses.textEnNlt: So they sat down in groups of fifty or a hundred.
verses.textEnNasb: They reclined in groups of hundreds and fifties.
verses.textEn: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

verses.textZh: 耶稣拿起这五个饼、两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了；然后把饼擘开，递给门徒摆在群众面前，又把两条鱼也分给群众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣拿起这五个饼、两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了；然后把饼擘开，递给门徒摆在群众面前，又把两条鱼也分给群众。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。
verses.textEnNiv: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.
verses.textEnEsv: And taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven and said a blessing and broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples to set before the people. And he divided the two fish among them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had taken the five loaves and the two fish, He looked up to heaven, blessed and broke the loaves, and gave them to His disciples to set before them; and the two fish He divided among them all.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he kept giving the bread to the disciples so they could distribute it to the people. He also divided the fish for everyone to share.
verses.textEnNasb: And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up toward heaven, He blessed the food and broke the loaves and He gave them to the disciples again and again to set before them; and He divided the two fish among them all.
verses.textEn: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

verses.textZh: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家都吃了，并且吃饱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了。
verses.textEnNiv: They all ate and were satisfied,
verses.textEnEsv: And they all ate and were satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they all ate and were filled.
verses.textEnNlt: They all ate as much as they wanted,
verses.textEnNasb: And they all ate and were satisfied;
verses.textEn: They all ate and were satisfied,

verses.textZh: 他们把剩下的零碎捡起来，装满了十二个篮子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把剩下的零碎捡起来，装满了十二个篮子，
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就把碎饼碎鱼收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textEnNiv: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and of the fish.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of fragments and of the fish.
verses.textEnNlt: and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftover bread and fish.
verses.textEnNasb: and they picked up twelve full baskets of the broken pieces of bread, and of the fish.
verses.textEn: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.

verses.textZh: 吃饼的人，男人就有五千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃饼的人，男人就有五千。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃饼的男人共有五千。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who had eaten the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.textEnNlt: A total of 5,000 men and their families were fed.
verses.textEnNasb: There were five thousand men who ate the loaves.
verses.textEn: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.

verses.textZh: 事后耶稣立刻催门徒上船，叫他们先渡到对岸的伯赛大去，等他自己叫众人散开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 事后耶稣立刻催门徒上船，叫他们先渡到对岸的伯赛大去，等他自己叫众人散开。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边伯赛大去，等他叫众人散开。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately He made His disciples get into the boat and go before Him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while He sent the multitude away.
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately after this, Jesus insisted that his disciples get back into the boat and head across the lake to Bethsaida, while he sent the people home.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately Jesus had His disciples get into the boat and go ahead of Him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while He Himself *dismissed the crowd.
verses.textEn: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.

verses.textZh: 他离开了他们，就上山去祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他离开了他们，就上山去祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既辞别了他们，就往山上去祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.
verses.textEnEsv: And after he had taken leave of them, he went up on the mountain to pray.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had sent them away, He departed to the mountain to pray.
verses.textEnNlt: After telling everyone good-bye, he went up into the hills by himself to pray.
verses.textEnNasb: And after saying goodbye to them, He left for the mountain to pray.
verses.textEn: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上；
verses.textEnNiv: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.
verses.textEnEsv: And when evening came, the boat was out on the sea, and he was alone on the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea; and He was alone on the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Late that night, the disciples were in their boat in the middle of the lake, and Jesus was alone on land.
verses.textEnNasb: When it was evening, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and He was alone on the land.
verses.textEn: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.

verses.textZh: 看见门徒辛辛苦苦地摇橹，因为风不顺。天快亮的时候 ，耶稣在海面上向他们走去，想要赶过他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见门徒辛辛苦苦地摇橹，因为风不顺。天快亮的时候 ，耶稣在海面上向他们走去，想要赶过他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见门徒因风不顺，摇橹甚苦。夜里约有四更天，就在海面上走，往他们那里去，意思要走过他们去。
verses.textEnNiv: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. Shortly before dawn he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,
verses.textEnEsv: And he saw that they were making headway painfully, for the wind was against them. And about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea. He meant to pass by them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He saw them straining at rowing, for the wind was against them. Now about the fourth watch of the night He came to them, walking on the sea, and would have passed them by.
verses.textEnNlt: He saw that they were in serious trouble, rowing hard and struggling against the wind and waves. About three o’clock in the morning Jesus came toward them, walking on the water. He intended to go past them,
verses.textEnNasb: Seeing them straining at the oars—for the wind was against them—at about the fourth watch of the night, He *came to them, walking on the sea; and He intended to pass by them.
verses.textEn: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. Shortly before dawn he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,

verses.textZh: 门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；
verses.textZhCuv: 但门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；
verses.textEnNiv: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,
verses.textEnEsv: but when they saw him walking on the sea they thought it was a ghost, and cried out,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they saw Him walking on the sea, they supposed it was a ghost, and cried out;
verses.textEnNlt: but when they saw him walking on the water, they cried out in terror, thinking he was a ghost.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they saw Him walking on the sea, they thought that it was a ghost, and they cried out;
verses.textEn: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,

verses.textZh: 因为他们都看见了他，非常恐惧。耶稣立刻对他们说："<red>放心吧！是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们都看见了他，非常恐惧。耶稣立刻对他们说："<red>放心吧！是我，不要怕。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们都看见了他，且甚惊慌。耶稣连忙对他们说：「<red>你们放心！是我，不要怕！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, <red>“Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for they all saw him and were terrified. But immediately he spoke to them and said, "Take heart; it is I. Do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNkjv: for they all saw Him and were troubled. But immediately He talked with them and said to them, "Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid."
verses.textEnNlt: They were all terrified when they saw him. But Jesus spoke to them at once. "Don’t be afraid," he said. "Take courage! I am here! "
verses.textEnNasb: for they all saw Him and were terrified. But immediately He spoke with them and *said to them, "Take courage; it is I, do not be afraid."
verses.textEn: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, <red>“Take courage! It is I. Don’t be afraid.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是上了船，和他们在一起，风就平静了。门徒心里十分惊奇，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是上了船，和他们在一起，风就平静了。门徒心里十分惊奇，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就住了；他们心里十分惊奇。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,
verses.textEnEsv: And he got into the boat with them, and the wind ceased. And they were utterly astounded,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went up into the boat to them, and the wind ceased. And they were greatly amazed in themselves beyond measure, and marveled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he climbed into the boat, and the wind stopped. They were totally amazed,
verses.textEnNasb: Then He got into the boat with them, and the wind stopped; and they were utterly astonished,
verses.textEn: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,

verses.textZh: 因为他们还不明白分饼这件事的意义，他们的心还是迟钝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们还不明白分饼这件事的意义，他们的心还是迟钝。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因为他们不明白那分饼的事，心里还是愚顽。
verses.textEnNiv: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.
verses.textEnEsv: for they did not understand about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they had not understood about the loaves, because their heart was hardened.
verses.textEnNlt: for they still didn’t understand the significance of the miracle of the loaves. Their hearts were too hard to take it in.
verses.textEnNasb: for they had not gained any insight from the incident of the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
verses.textEn: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.

verses.textZh: 他们渡过了海，就在革尼撒勒靠岸，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们渡过了海，就在革尼撒勒靠岸，
verses.textZhCuv: 既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
verses.textEnNiv: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret and anchored there.
verses.textEnNlt: After they had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret. They brought the boat to shore
verses.textEnNasb: When they had crossed over they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored at the shore.
verses.textEn: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.

verses.textZh: 一下船，众人立刻认出耶稣来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 一下船，众人立刻认出耶稣来，
verses.textZhCuv: 一下船，众人认得是耶稣，
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they got out of the boat, the people immediately recognized him
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they came out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,
verses.textEnNlt: and climbed out. The people recognized Jesus at once,
verses.textEnNasb: And when they got out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,
verses.textEn: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.

verses.textZh: 就跑遍那一带地方，把有病的人放在褥子上，听见他在哪里，就抬到哪里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就跑遍那一带地方，把有病的人放在褥子上，听见他在哪里，就抬到哪里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见他在何处，便将有病的人用褥子抬到那里。
verses.textEnNiv: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.
verses.textEnEsv: and ran about the whole region and began to bring the sick people on their beds to wherever they heard he was.
verses.textEnNkjv: ran through that whole surrounding region, and began to carry about on beds those who were sick to wherever they heard He was.
verses.textEnNlt: and they ran throughout the whole area, carrying sick people on mats to wherever they heard he was.
verses.textEnNasb: and ran about that entire country and began carrying here and there on their pallets those who were sick, to wherever they heard He was.
verses.textEn: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.

verses.textZh: 耶稣无论到甚么地方，或村庄，或城市，或乡野，众人都把病人放在街上，求耶稣准他们摸他衣服的繸子，摸着的人就都好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣无论到甚么地方，或村庄，或城市，或乡野，众人都把病人放在街上，求耶稣准他们摸他衣服的繸子，摸着的人就都好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病人放在街市上，求耶稣只容他们摸他的衣裳䍁子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
verses.textEnNiv: And wherever he went—into villages, towns or countryside—they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
verses.textEnEsv: And wherever he came, in villages, cities, or countryside, they laid the sick in the marketplaces and implored him that they might touch even the fringe of his garment. And as many as touched it were made well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever He entered, into villages, cities, or the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged Him that they might just touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched Him were made well.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever he went—in villages, cities, or the countryside—they brought the sick out to the marketplaces. They begged him to let the sick touch at least the fringe of his robe, and all who touched him were healed.
verses.textEnNasb: And wherever He entered villages, or cities, or a countryside, they were laying the sick in the marketplaces and imploring Him that they might just touch the fringe of His cloak; and all who touched it were being healed.
verses.textEn: And wherever he went—into villages, towns or countryside—they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.

verses.textZh: 有法利赛人和几个经学家从耶路撒冷来，聚集到耶稣那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有法利赛人和几个经学家从耶路撒冷来，聚集到耶稣那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 有法利赛人和几个文士从耶路撒冷来，到耶稣那里聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the Pharisees gathered to him, with some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes came together to Him, having come from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: One day some Pharisees and teachers of religious law arrived from Jerusalem to see Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees and some of the scribes *gathered to Him after they came from Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus

verses.textZh: 他们看见他的门徒有人用不洁的手，就是没有洗过的手吃饭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见他的门徒有人用不洁的手，就是没有洗过的手吃饭，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们曾看见他的门徒中有人用俗手，就是没有洗的手，吃饭。（
verses.textEnNiv: and saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.
verses.textEnEsv: they saw that some of his disciples ate with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they saw some of His disciples eat bread with defiled, that is, with unwashed hands, they found fault.
verses.textEnNlt: They noticed that some of his disciples failed to follow the Jewish ritual of hand washing before eating.
verses.textEnNasb: and saw that some of His disciples were eating their bread with unholy hands, that is, unwashed.
verses.textEn: and saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人和经学家问耶稣："你的门徒为甚么不遵行古人的传统，用不洁的手吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人和经学家问耶稣："你的门徒为甚么不遵行古人的传统，用不洁的手吃饭呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 原来法利赛人和犹太人都拘守古人的遗传，若不仔细洗手就不吃饭；
verses.textEnNiv: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.
verses.textEnEsv: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands properly, holding to the tradition of the elders,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands in a special way, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: (The Jews, especially the Pharisees, do not eat until they have poured water over their cupped hands, as required by their ancient traditions.
verses.textEnNasb: (For the Pharisees and all the other Jews do not eat unless they carefully wash their hands, thereby holding firmly to the tradition of the elders;
verses.textEn: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："以赛亚指着你们这班伪君子所说的预言是对的，经上记着： ‘这人民用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："以赛亚指着你们这班伪君子所说的预言是对的，经上记着： ‘这人民用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我；
verses.textZhCuv: 从市上来，若不洗浴也不吃饭；还有好些别的规矩，他们历代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、铜器等物。）
verses.textEnNiv: When they come from the marketplace they do not eat unless they wash. And they observe many other traditions, such as the washing of cups, pitchers and kettles. )
verses.textEnEsv: and when they come from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions that they observe, such as the washing of cups and pots and copper vessels and dining couches. )
verses.textEnNkjv: Whentheycome from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other things which they have received and hold, like the washing of cups, pitchers, copper vessels, and couches.
verses.textEnNlt: Similarly, they don’t eat anything from the market until they immerse their hands in water. This is but one of many traditions they have clung to—such as their ceremonial washing of cups, pitchers, and kettles. )

verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人和文士问他说：「你的门徒为什么不照古人的遗传，用俗手吃饭呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, "Why don’t your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with defiled hands?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the Pharisees and the scribes asked him, "Why do your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat with defiled hands?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked Him, "Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashed hands?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the Pharisees and teachers of religious law asked him, "Why don’t your disciples follow our age-old tradition? They eat without first performing the hand-washing ceremony."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Pharisees and the scribes *asked Him, "Why do Your disciples not walk in accordance with the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unholy hands?"
verses.textEn: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, "Why don’t your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with defiled hands?"

verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「以赛亚指着你们假冒为善之人所说的预言是不错的。如经上说： 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: “ ‘Thesepn people honor me with their lips, butld their hearts are far from me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, "‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me;
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them, "Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘This people honors Me withtheirlips, But their heart is far from Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you, for he wrote, ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "Rightly did Isaiah prophesy about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘This people honors Me with their lips, But their heart is far away from Me.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: “ ‘Thesepn people honor me with their lips, butld their hearts are far from me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为摩西说：‘当孝敬父母’，又说：‘咒骂父母的，必被处死。’</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们是离弃神的诫命，拘守人的遗传」；</red>

verses.textEnNiv: And he continued, <red>“You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "You have a fine way of rejecting the commandment of God in order to establish your tradition!
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "All too well you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "You skillfully sidestep God’s law in order to hold on to your own tradition.
verses.textEnNasb: He was also saying to them, "You are experts at setting aside the commandment of God in order to keep your tradition.
verses.textEn: And he continued, <red>“You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!</red>
