verses.textEnNiv: <red>For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’; and, ‘Whoever reviles father or mother must surely die.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’; and, ‘He who curses father or mother, let him be put to death.’
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, Moses gave you this law from God: ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and ‘Anyone who speaks disrespectfully of father or mother must be put to death.’
verses.textEnNasb: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’; and, ‘The one who speaks evil of father or mother, is certainly to be put to death’;
verses.textEn: <red>For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，你们借着所领受的传统，把神的话废弃了。你们还作了许多这一类的事。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，你们借着所领受的传统，把神的话废弃了。你们还作了许多这一类的事。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们倒说：『人若对父母说：我所当奉给你的，已经作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供献的意思），</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: But you say, ‘If a man says to his father or mother, "Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban"—’ (that is, a gift to God),
verses.textEnNlt: But you say it is all right for people to say to their parents, ‘Sorry, I can’t help you. For I have vowed to give to God what I would have given to you.’
verses.textEnNasb: but you say, ‘If a person says to his father or his mother, whatever I have that would help you is Corban (that is, given to God),’
verses.textEn: <red>But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是耶稣又把群众叫过来，对他们说："你们大家都要听我说，也要明白：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是耶稣又把群众叫过来，对他们说："你们大家都要听我说，也要明白：</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>这就是你们承接遗传，废了神的道。你们还做许多这样的事。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: thus making void the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And many such things you do."
verses.textEnNkjv: making the word of God of no effect through your tradition which you have handed down. And many such things you do."
verses.textEnNlt: And so you cancel the word of God in order to hand down your own tradition. And this is only one example among many others."
verses.textEnNasb: thereby invalidating the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down; and you do many things such as that."
verses.textEn: <red>Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”</red>

verses.textEn: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, <red>“Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他对他们说："连你们也是这样不明白吗？难道不知道从外面进去的，不能使人污秽吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他对他们说："连你们也是这样不明白吗？难道不知道从外面进去的，不能使人污秽吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从外面进去的不能污秽人，惟有从里面出来的乃能污秽人。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them. Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: There is nothing outside a person that by going into him can defile him, but the things that come out of a person are what defile him."

verses.textEnNlt: It’s not what goes into your body that defiles you; you are defiled by what comes from your heart. "
verses.textEnNasb: there is nothing outside the person which can defile him if it goes into him; but the things which come out of the person are what defile the person ."

verses.textEnNkjv: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!"

verses.textEn: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.
