verses.textEnNlt: Right away a woman who had heard about him came and fell at his feet. Her little girl was possessed by an evil spirit,
verses.textEnNasb: But after hearing about Him, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit immediately came and fell at His feet.
verses.textEn: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an impure spirit came and fell at his feet.

verses.textZh: 那女人回答他："主啊，是的，不过小狗在桌子底下，也可以吃孩子们掉下来的碎渣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人回答他："主啊，是的，不过小狗在桌子底下，也可以吃孩子们掉下来的碎渣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这妇人是希腊人，属叙利腓尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼离开她的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the woman was a Gentile, a Syrophoenician by birth. And she begged him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a woman whose young daughter had an unclean spirit heard about Him, and she came and fell at His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: and she begged him to cast out the demon from her daughter. Since she was a Gentile, born in Syrian Phoenicia,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the woman was a Gentile, of Syrophoenician descent. And she repeatedly asked Him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.textEn: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："就凭这句话，你回去吧，鬼已经从你女儿身上出去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："就凭这句话，你回去吧，鬼已经从你女儿身上出去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对她说：「让儿女们先吃饱，不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: "First let the children eat all they want," he told her, "for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Let the children be fed first, for it is not right to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEnNkjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syro-Phoenician by birth, and she kept asking Him to cast the demon out of her daughter.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told her, "First I should feed the children—my own family, the Jews. It isn’t right to take food from the children and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to her, "Let the children be satisfied first, for it is not good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs."
verses.textEn: "First let the children eat all they want," he told her, "for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs."

verses.textZh: <red>她回到家里，看见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>她回到家里，看见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人回答说：「<red>主啊，不错；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子们的碎渣儿。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Firstp let the children eat all they want,”</red> he told her, <red>“for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But she answered him, "Yes, Lord; yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to her, "Let the children be filled first, for it is not good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the little dogs."
verses.textEnNlt: She replied, "That’s true, Lord, but even the dogs under the table are allowed to eat the scraps from the children’s plates."
verses.textEnNasb: But she answered and *said to Him, "Yes, Lord, but even the dogs under the table feed on the children’s crumbs."
verses.textEn: <red>“Firstp let the children eat all they want,”</red> he told her, <red>“for it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣从推罗境内出去，经过西顿，回到低加波利地区的加利利海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣从推罗境内出去，经过西顿，回到低加波利地区的加利利海。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对她说：「因这句话，你回去吧；鬼已经离开你的女儿了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told her, "For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "For this statement you may go your way; the demon has left your daughter."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she answered and said to Him, "Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs under the table eat from the children’s crumbs."
verses.textEnNlt: "Good answer!" he said. "Now go home, for the demon has left your daughter."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to her, "Because of this answer, go; the demon has gone out of your daughter."
verses.textEn: Then he told her, "For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter."

verses.textZh: <red>有人带着一个又聋又哑的人到他那里，求耶稣按手在他身上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有人带着一个又聋又哑的人到他那里，求耶稣按手在他身上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told her, <red>“For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And she went home and found the child lying in bed and the demon gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to her, "For this saying go your way; the demon has gone out of your daughter."
verses.textEnNlt: And when she arrived home, she found her little girl lying quietly in bed, and the demon was gone.
verses.textEnNasb: And after going back to her home, she found the child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.
verses.textEn: Then he told her, <red>“For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣把他从人群中带到一边，用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣把他从人群中带到一边，用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又离了泰尔的境界，经过西顿，就从低加坡里境内来到加利利海。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he returned from the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, in the region of the Decapolis.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she had come to her house, she found the demon gone out, and her daughter lying on the bed.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus left Tyre and went up to Sidon before going back to the Sea of Galilee and the region of the Ten Towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Again He left the region of Tyre and came through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, within the region of Decapolis.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

verses.textZh: 然后望着天，长长地叹了一口气，对他说："以法大！"意思是"开了吧"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后望着天，长长地叹了一口气，对他说："以法大！"意思是"开了吧"。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人带着一个耳聋舌结的人来见耶稣，求他按手在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought to him a man who was deaf and had a speech impediment, and they begged him to lay his hand on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, departing from the region of Tyre and Sidon, He came through the midst of the region of Decapolis to the Sea of Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: A deaf man with a speech impediment was brought to him, and the people begged Jesus to lay his hands on the man to heal him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *brought to Him one who was deaf and had difficulty speaking, and they *begged Him to lay His hand on him.
verses.textEn: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.

verses.textZh: 那人的耳朵就开了，舌头也松了，说话也准确了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人的耳朵就开了，舌头也松了，说话也准确了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣领他离开众人，到一边去，就用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，
verses.textEnNiv: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: And taking him aside from the crowd privately, he put his fingers into his ears, and after spitting touched his tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought to Him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech, and they begged Him to put His hand on him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus led him away from the crowd so they could be alone. He put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then, spitting on his own fingers, he touched the man’s tongue.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus took him aside from the crowd, by himself, and put His fingers in his ears, and after spitting, He touched his tongue with the saliva;
verses.textEn: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.

verses.textZh: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人。但他越是嘱咐，他们却越发传扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人。但他越是嘱咐，他们却越发传扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 望天叹息，对他说：「以法大！」就是说：「开了吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, "Ephphatha!" (which means "Be opened!").
verses.textEnEsv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed and said to him, "Ephphatha," that is, "Be opened."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took him aside from the multitude, and put His fingers in his ears, and He spat and touched his tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: Looking up to heaven, he sighed and said, "Ephphatha," which means, "Be opened!"
verses.textEnNasb: and looking up to heaven with a deep sigh, He *said to him, "Ephphatha!" that is, "Be opened!"
verses.textEn: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, "Ephphatha!" (which means "Be opened!").

verses.textZh: 众人非常惊讶说："<red>他所作的一切事都好极了；他竟然使聋子听见，又使哑巴说话。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人非常惊讶说："<red>他所作的一切事都好极了；他竟然使聋子听见，又使哑巴说话。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他的耳朵就开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!”*ir (which means <red>“Be opened!”).</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And his ears were opened, his tongue was released, and he spoke plainly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, looking up to heaven, He sighed, and said to him, "Ephphatha," that is, "Be opened."
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly the man could hear perfectly, and his tongue was freed so he could speak plainly!
verses.textEnNasb: And his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was removed, and he began speaking plainly.
verses.textEn: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!”*ir (which means <red>“Be opened!”).</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人；但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人；但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人；但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus charged them to tell no one. But the more he charged them, the more zealously they proclaimed it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plainly.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told the crowd not to tell anyone, but the more he told them not to, the more they spread the news.
verses.textEnNasb: And He gave them orders not to tell anyone; but the more He ordered them, the more widely they continued to proclaim it.
verses.textEn: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.

verses.textZh: 众人分外希奇，说：「他所做的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑巴也叫他们说话。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人分外希奇，说：「他所做的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑巴也叫他们说话。」
verses.textZhCuv: 众人分外希奇，说：「他所做的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑巴也叫他们说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: People were overwhelmed with amazement. "He has done everything well," they said. "He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak."
verses.textEnEsv: And they were astonished beyond measure, saying, "He has done all things well. He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He commanded them that they should tell no one; but the more He commanded them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
verses.textEnNlt: They were completely amazed and said again and again, "Everything he does is wonderful. He even makes the deaf to hear and gives speech to those who cannot speak."
verses.textEnNasb: And they were utterly astonished, saying, "He has done all things well; He makes even those who are deaf hear, and those who are unable to talk, speak."
verses.textEn: People were overwhelmed with amazement. "He has done everything well," they said. "He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak."

verses.textZh: 那些日子，又有一大群人聚集，他们没有甚么东西吃。耶稣叫门徒来，对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些日子，又有一大群人聚集，他们没有甚么东西吃。耶稣叫门徒来，对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，又有许多人聚集，并没有什么吃的。耶稣叫门徒来，说：
verses.textEnNiv: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,
verses.textEnEsv: In those days, when again a great crowd had gathered, and they had nothing to eat, he called his disciples to him and said to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days, the multitude being very great and having nothing to eat, Jesus called His disciples toHim and said to them,
verses.textEnNlt: About this time another large crowd had gathered, and the people ran out of food again. Jesus called his disciples and told them,
verses.textEnNasb: In those days, when there was again a large crowd and they had nothing to eat, Jesus summoned His disciples and *said to them,
verses.textEn: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,

verses.textZh: <red>"我怜悯这一群人，因为他们和我在一起已经有三天，没有甚么吃的了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我怜悯这一群人，因为他们和我在一起已经有三天，没有甚么吃的了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I have compassion on the crowd, because they have been with me now three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: "I feel sorry for these people. They have been here with me for three days, and they have nothing left to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: "I feel compassion for the people because they have remained with Me for three days already and have nothing to eat.
verses.textEn: <red>“I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果我叫他们散开，饿着肚子回家去，他们会在路上晕倒，因为有人是从很远的地方来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果我叫他们散开，饿着肚子回家去，他们会在路上晕倒，因为有人是从很远的地方来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若打发他们饿着回家，就必在路上困乏，因为其中有从远处来的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if I send them away hungry to their homes, they will faint on the way. And some of them have come from far away."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if I send them away hungry to their own houses, they will faint on the way; for some of them have come from afar."
verses.textEnNlt: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a long distance."
verses.textEnNasb: And if I send them away hungry to their homes, they will faint on the way; and some of them have come from a great distance."
verses.textEn: <red>If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒回答："在这旷野地方，从哪里能找食物叫这些人吃饱呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒回答："在这旷野地方，从哪里能找食物叫这些人吃饱呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒回答说：「在这野地，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples answered, "But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?"
verses.textEnEsv: And his disciples answered him, "How can one feed these people with bread here in this desolate place?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples answered Him, "How can one satisfy these people with bread here in the wilderness?"
verses.textEnNlt: His disciples replied, "How are we supposed to find enough food to feed them out here in the wilderness?"
verses.textEnNasb: And His disciples replied to Him, "Where will anyone be able to find enough bread here in this desolate place to satisfy these people?"
verses.textEn: His disciples answered, "But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?"

verses.textZh: <red>他问他们："你们有多少饼？"他们说："七个。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他问他们："你们有多少饼？"他们说："七个。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问他们说：「<red>你们有多少饼？</red>」他们说：「<red>七个。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he asked them, "How many loaves do you have?" They said, "Seven."
verses.textEnNkjv: He asked them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "How much bread do you have?" "Seven loaves," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was asking them, "How many loaves do you have?" And they said, "Seven."
verses.textEn: <red>“Howp many loaves do you have?”</red> Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣吩咐群众坐在地上；拿起那七个饼，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，叫他们摆开；门徒就摆在众人面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣吩咐群众坐在地上；拿起那七个饼，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，叫他们摆开；门徒就摆在众人面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 他吩咐众人坐在地上，就拿着这七个饼祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，门徒就摆在众人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people, and they did so.
verses.textEnEsv: And he directed the crowd to sit down on the ground. And he took the seven loaves, and having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to set before the people; and they set them before the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground. And He took the seven loaves and gave thanks, broke them and gave them to His disciples to set before them; and they set them before the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus told all the people to sit down on the ground. Then he took the seven loaves, thanked God for them, and broke them into pieces. He gave them to his disciples, who distributed the bread to the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *directed the people to recline on the ground; and taking the seven loaves, He gave thanks and broke them, and started giving them to His disciples to serve, and they served them to the people.
verses.textEn: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people, and they did so.

verses.textZh: 他们还有几条小鱼，耶稣祝了福，就吩咐把这些也摆开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还有几条小鱼，耶稣祝了福，就吩咐把这些也摆开。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有几条小鱼；耶稣祝了福，就吩咐也摆在众人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they had a few small fish. And having blessed them, he said that these also should be set before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also had a few small fish; and having blessed them, He said to set them also before them.
verses.textEnNlt: A few small fish were found, too, so Jesus also blessed these and told the disciples to distribute them.
verses.textEnNasb: They also had a few small fish; and after He had blessed them, He told the disciples to serve these as well.
verses.textEn: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.

verses.textZh: 众人都吃了，并吃饱了。他们把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了七个大篮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都吃了，并吃饱了。他们把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了七个大篮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
verses.textEnNiv: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.textEnEsv: And they ate and were satisfied. And they took up the broken pieces left over, seven baskets full.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they ate and were filled, and they took up seven large baskets of leftover fragments.
verses.textEnNlt: They ate as much as they wanted. Afterward, the disciples picked up seven large baskets of leftover food.
verses.textEnNasb: And they ate and were satisfied; and they picked up seven large baskets full of what was left over of the broken pieces.
verses.textEn: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.textZh: 当时人数约有四千。耶稣解散了群众，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时人数约有四千。耶稣解散了群众，
verses.textZhCuv: 人数约有四千。耶稣打发他们走了，
verses.textEnNiv: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,
verses.textEnEsv: And there were about four thousand people. And he sent them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who had eaten were about four thousand. And He sent them away,
verses.textEnNlt: There were about 4,000 men in the crowd that day, and Jesus sent them home after they had eaten.
verses.textEnNasb: About four thousand men were there; and He dismissed them.
verses.textEn: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,

verses.textZh: 就立刻和门徒上了船，来到大玛努他地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就立刻和门徒上了船，来到大玛努他地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 随即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。
verses.textEnNiv: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
verses.textEnNkjv: immediately got into the boat with His disciples, and came to the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately after this, he got into a boat with his disciples and crossed over to the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately He got into the boat with His disciples and came to the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.textEn: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人出来，跟耶稣辩论；他们想试探他，求他显个从天上来的神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人出来，跟耶稣辩论；他们想试探他，求他显个从天上来的神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人出来盘问耶稣，求他从天上显个神迹给他们看，想要试探他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisees came and began to argue with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven to test him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Pharisees came out and began to dispute with Him, seeking from Him a sign from heaven, testing Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Pharisees heard that Jesus had arrived, they came and started to argue with him. Testing him, they demanded that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Pharisees came out and began to argue with Him, demanding from Him a sign from heaven, to test Him.
verses.textEn: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶稣灵里深深地叹息，说："<red>这世代为甚么总是寻求神迹？我实在告诉你们，决不会有神迹显给这个世代的！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣灵里深深地叹息，说："<red>这世代为甚么总是寻求神迹？我实在告诉你们，决不会有神迹显给这个世代的！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣心里深深地叹息，说：「<red>这世代为什么求神迹呢？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代看。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He sighed deeply and said, <red>“Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly, I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He sighed deeply in His spirit, and said, "Why does this generation seek a sign? Assuredly, I say to you, no sign shall be given to this generation."
verses.textEnNlt: When he heard this, he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, "Why do these people keep demanding a miraculous sign? I tell you the truth, I will not give this generation any such sign."
verses.textEnNasb: Sighing deeply in His spirit, He *said, "Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation!"
verses.textEn: He sighed deeply and said, <red>“Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他离开他们，又上船往对岸去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他离开他们，又上船往对岸去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就离开他们，又上船往海那边去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.
verses.textEnEsv: And he left them, got into the boat again, and went to the other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He left them, and getting into the boat again, departed to the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: So he got back into the boat and left them, and he crossed to the other side of the lake.
verses.textEnNasb: And leaving them, He again embarked and went away to the other side.
verses.textEn: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.

verses.textZh: 门徒忘了带饼，船上除了一个饼，身边没有别的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒忘了带饼，船上除了一个饼，身边没有别的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒忘了带饼；在船上除了一个饼，没有别的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
verses.textEnEsv: Now they had forgotten to bring bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, and they did not have more than one loaf with them in the boat.
verses.textEnNlt: But the disciples had forgotten to bring any food. They had only one loaf of bread with them in the boat.
verses.textEnNasb: And the disciples had forgotten to take bread, and did not have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
verses.textEn: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣嘱咐他们说："你们要小心，提防法利赛人的酵和希律的酵！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣嘱咐他们说："你们要小心，提防法利赛人的酵和希律的酵！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣嘱咐他们说：「<red>你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人的酵和希律的酵。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Be careful,”</red> Jesus warned them. <red>“Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he cautioned them, saying, "Watch out; beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He charged them, saying, "Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod."
verses.textEnNlt: As they were crossing the lake, Jesus warned them, "Watch out! Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was giving orders to them, saying, "Watch out! Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and the leaven of Herod."
verses.textEn: <red>“Be careful,”</red> Jesus warned them. <red>“Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒彼此议论说："这是因为我们没有饼吧？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒彼此议论说："这是因为我们没有饼吧？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此议论说：「这是因为我们没有饼吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: They discussed this with one another and said, "It is because we have no bread."
verses.textEnEsv: And they began discussing with one another the fact that they had no bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "Itis because we have no bread."
verses.textEnNlt: At this they began to argue with each other because they hadn’t brought any bread.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
verses.textEn: They discussed this with one another and said, "It is because we have no bread."

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道了，就说："<red>为甚么议论没有饼这件事呢？你们还不知道，还不明白吗？你们的心还是这么迟钝吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道了，就说："<red>为甚么议论没有饼这件事呢？你们还不知道，还不明白吗？你们的心还是这么迟钝吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看出来，就说：「你们为什么因为没有饼就议论呢？你们还不省悟，还不明白吗？你们的心还是愚顽吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: <red>“Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus, aware of this, said to them, "Why are you discussing the fact that you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive or understand? Are your hearts hardened?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus, being aware of it, said to them, "Why do you reason because you have no bread? Do you not yet perceive nor understand? Is your heart still hardened?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said, "Why are you arguing about having no bread? Don’t you know or understand even yet? Are your hearts too hard to take it in?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus, aware of this, *said to them, "Why are you discussing the fact that you have no bread? Do you not yet comprehend or understand? Do you still have your heart hardened?
verses.textEn: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: <red>“Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们有眼不能看，有耳不能听吗？你们不记得吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们有眼不能看，有耳不能听吗？你们不记得吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们有眼睛，看不见吗？有耳朵，听不见吗？也不记得吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don’t you remember?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Having eyes do you not see, and having ears do you not hear? And do you not remember?
verses.textEnNkjv: Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear? And do you not remember?
verses.textEnNlt: ‘You have eyes—can’t you see? You have ears—can’t you hear?’ Don’t you remember anything at all?
verses.textEnNasb: Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear? And do you not remember,
verses.textEn: <red>Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don’t you remember?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我擘开那五个饼给五千人吃，你们收拾的零碎装满了几个篮子呢？"他们说："十二个。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我擘开那五个饼给五千人吃，你们收拾的零碎装满了几个篮子呢？"他们说："十二个。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 我擘开那五个饼分给五千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少篮子呢？」他们说：「<red>十二个。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”</red> “Twelve,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?" They said to him, "Twelve."
verses.textEnNkjv: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments did you take up?" They said to Him, "Twelve."
verses.textEnNlt: When I fed the 5,000 with five loaves of bread, how many baskets of leftovers did you pick up afterward?" "Twelve," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: when I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces you picked up?" They *said to Him, "Twelve."
verses.textEn: <red>When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”</red> “Twelve,” they replied.

verses.textZh: <red>"那七个饼分给四千人吃，你们收拾的零碎装满了几个大篮子呢？"他们说："七个。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"那七个饼分给四千人吃，你们收拾的零碎装满了几个大篮子呢？"他们说："七个。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「又擘开那七个饼分给四千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少筐子呢？」他们说：「<red>七个。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Andp when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”</red> They answered, “Seven.”
verses.textEnEsv: "And the seven for the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?" And they said to him, "Seven."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also, when I broke the seven for the four thousand, how many large baskets full of fragments did you take up?" And they said, "Seven."
verses.textEnNlt: "And when I fed the 4,000 with seven loaves, how many large baskets of leftovers did you pick up?" "Seven," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: "When I broke the seven for the four thousand, how many large baskets full of broken pieces did you pick up?" And they *said to Him, "Seven."
verses.textEn: <red>“Andp when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?”</red> They answered, “Seven.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你们还不明白吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你们还不明白吗？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们还是不明白吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Do you still not understand?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Do you not yet understand?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "How is it you do not understand?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t you understand yet?" he asked them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "Do you not yet understand?"
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Do you still not understand?”</red>

verses.textZh: 后来他们到了伯赛大，有人带了一个瞎眼的人到他跟前，求耶稣摸他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他们到了伯赛大，有人带了一个瞎眼的人到他跟前，求耶稣摸他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。
verses.textEnNiv: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Bethsaida. And some people brought to him a blind man and begged him to touch him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to Bethsaida; and they brought a blind man to Him, and begged Him to touch him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man to Jesus, and they begged him to touch the man and heal him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *came to Bethsaida. And some people *brought a man who was blind to Jesus and *begged Him to touch him.
verses.textEn: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣拉着他的手，领他到村外，吐唾沫在他的眼睛上，又用双手按在他的身上，问他："<red>你看见甚么没有？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣拉着他的手，领他到村外，吐唾沫在他的眼睛上，又用双手按在他的身上，问他："<red>你看见甚么没有？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说：「<red>你看见什么了？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man’s eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, <red>“Do you see anything?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village, and when he had spit on his eyes and laid his hands on him, he asked him, "Do you see anything?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the town. And when He had spit on his eyes and put His hands on him, He asked him if he saw anything.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then, spitting on the man’s eyes, he laid his hands on him and asked, "Can you see anything now?"
verses.textEnNasb: Taking the man who was blind by the hand, He brought him out of the village; and after spitting in his eyes and laying His hands on him, He asked him, "Do you see anything?"
verses.textEn: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man’s eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, <red>“Do you see anything?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他往上一看，说："我看见人了！看见他们好象树走来走去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他往上一看，说："我看见人了！看见他们好象树走来走去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就抬头一看，说：「我看见人了；他们好像树木，并且行走。」
verses.textEnNiv: He looked up and said, "I see people; they look like trees walking around."
verses.textEnEsv: And he looked up and said, "I see people, but they look like trees, walking."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he looked up and said, "I see men like trees, walking."
verses.textEnNlt: The man looked around. "Yes," he said, "I see people, but I can’t see them very clearly. They look like trees walking around."
verses.textEnNasb: And he looked up and said, "I see people, for I see them like trees, walking around."
verses.textEn: He looked up and said, "I see people; they look like trees walking around."

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣再按手在他的眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复原了，样样都看得清楚了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣再按手在他的眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复原了，样样都看得清楚了。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复了原，样样都看得清楚了。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man’s eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus laid his hands on his eyes again; and he opened his eyes, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He put His hands on his eyes again and made him look up. And he was restored and saw everyone clearly.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus placed his hands on the man’s eyes again, and his eyes were opened. His sight was completely restored, and he could see everything clearly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then again He laid His hands on his eyes; and he looked intently and was restored, and began to see everything clearly.
verses.textEn: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man’s eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

verses.textZh: 耶稣叫他回家去，说："<red>连这村子你也不要进去。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣叫他回家去，说："<red>连这村子你也不要进去。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣打发他回家，说：「<red>连这村子你也不要进去。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus sent him home, saying, <red>“Don’t even go into the village.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent him to his home, saying, "Do not even enter the village."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He sent him away to his house, saying, "Neither go into the town, nor tell anyone in the town."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus sent him away, saying, "Don’t go back into the village on your way home."
verses.textEnNasb: And He sent him to his home, saying, "Do not even enter the village."
verses.textEn: Jesus sent him home, saying, <red>“Don’t even go into the village.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣和门徒出去，要到该撒利亚．腓立比附近的村庄。在路上他问门徒说："<red>人说我是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和门徒出去，要到该撒利亚．腓立比附近的村庄。在路上他问门徒说："<red>人说我是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和门徒出去，往凯撒利亚‧腓立比村庄去；在路上问门徒说：「<red>人说我是谁？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, <red>“Who do people say I am?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus went on with his disciples to the villages of Caesarea Philippi. And on the way he asked his disciples, "Who do people say that I am?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus and His disciples went out to the towns of Caesarea Philippi; and on the road He asked His disciples, saying to them, "Who do men say that I am?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus and his disciples left Galilee and went up to the villages near Caesarea Philippi. As they were walking along, he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus went out, along with His disciples, to the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the way He questioned His disciples, saying to them, "Who do people say that I am?"
verses.textEn: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, <red>“Who do people say I am?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；还有人说是先知里的一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；还有人说是先知里的一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是先知里的一位。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets."
verses.textEnEsv: And they told him, "John the Baptist; and others say, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered, "John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others, one of the prophets."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say you are one of the other prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: They told Him, saying, "John the Baptist; and others say Elijah; and others, one of the prophets."
verses.textEn: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets."

verses.textZh: <red>他又问他们说："那么你们呢？你们说我是谁？"彼得回答："你就是基督。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他又问他们说："那么你们呢？你们说我是谁？"彼得回答："你就是基督。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 又问他们说：「<red>你们说我是谁？</red>」彼得回答说：「<red>你是基督。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red> Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”
verses.textEnEsv: And he asked them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered him, "You are the Christ."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered and said to Him, "You are the Christ."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?" Peter replied, "You are the Messiah. "
verses.textEnNasb: And He continued questioning them: "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered and *said to Him, "You are the Christ."
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red> Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣郑重地嘱咐他们，不要把他的事告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣郑重地嘱咐他们，不要把他的事告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就禁戒他们，不要告诉人。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he strictly charged them to tell no one about him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He strictly warned them that they should tell no one about Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He warned them to tell no one about Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.

verses.textZh: 于是他教导他们，人子必须受许多苦，被长老、祭司长和经学家弃绝、杀害，三天后复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他教导他们，人子必须受许多苦，被长老、祭司长和经学家弃绝、杀害，三天后复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，他教训他们说：「人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，过三天复活。」
verses.textEnNiv: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.
verses.textEnEsv: And he began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus began to tell them that the Son of Man must suffer many terrible things and be rejected by the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He would be killed, but three days later he would rise from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: And He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise from the dead.
verses.textEn: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.

verses.textZh: 耶稣坦白地说了这话，彼得就把他拉到一边，责怪他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣坦白地说了这话，彼得就把他拉到一边，责怪他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣明明地说这话，彼得就拉着他，劝他。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said this plainly. And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke this word openly. Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As he talked about this openly with his disciples, Peter took him aside and began to reprimand him for saying such things.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was stating the matter plainly. And Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
verses.textEn: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣转过身来，望着门徒，斥责彼得说："<red>撒但，退到我后面去！因为你不思念神的事，只思念人的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣转过身来，望着门徒，斥责彼得说："<red>撒但，退到我后面去！因为你不思念神的事，只思念人的事。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣转过来，看着门徒，就责备彼得说：「<red>撒但，退我后边去吧！因为你不体贴神的意思，只体贴人的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. <red>“Get behind me, Satan!”</red> he said. <red>“You do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But turning and seeing his disciples, he rebuked Peter and said, "Get behind me, Satan! For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when He had turned around and looked at His disciples, He rebuked Peter, saying, "Get behind Me, Satan! For you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus turned around and looked at his disciples, then reprimanded Peter. "Get away from me, Satan!" he said. "You are seeing things merely from a human point of view, not from God’s."
verses.textEnNasb: But turning around and seeing His disciples, He rebuked Peter and *said, "Get behind Me, Satan; for you are not setting your mind on God’s purposes, but on man’s."
verses.textEn: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. <red>“Get behind me, Satan!”</red> he said. <red>“You do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是把众人和门徒都叫过来，对他们说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就应当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是把众人和门徒都叫过来，对他们说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就应当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是叫众人和门徒来，对他们说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And calling the crowd to him with his disciples, he said to them, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had called the people to Himself, with His disciples also, He said to them, "Whoever desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, calling the crowd to join his disciples, he said, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must give up your own way, take up your cross, and follow me.
verses.textEnNasb: And He summoned the crowd together with His disciples, and said to them, "If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.
verses.textEn: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我和福音牺牲生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我和福音牺牲生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，凡要救自己生命 的，必丧掉生命；凡为我和福音丧掉生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake and the gospel’s will save it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and the gospel’s will save it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake and for the sake of the Good News, you will save it.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and the gospel’s will save it.
verses.textEn: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人就是赚得全世界，却赔上自己的生命，有甚么好处呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人就是赚得全世界，却赔上自己的生命，有甚么好处呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人就是赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul?
verses.textEnNlt: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but lose your own soul?
verses.textEnNasb: For what does it benefit a person to gain the whole world, and forfeit his soul?
verses.textEn: <red>What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人还能用甚么换回自己的生命呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人还能用甚么换回自己的生命呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人还能拿什么换生命呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For what can a man give in return for his soul?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.textEnNlt: Is anything worth more than your soul?
verses.textEnNasb: For what could a person give in exchange for his soul?
verses.textEn: <red>Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在淫乱罪恶的世代，凡把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，和圣天使一起降临的时候，也必把他当作可耻的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在淫乱罪恶的世代，凡把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，和圣天使一起降临的时候，也必把他当作可耻的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡在这淫乱罪恶的世代，把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，同圣天使降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever is ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of him will the Son of Man also be ashamed when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, of him the Son of Man also will be ashamed when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels."
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone is ashamed of me and my message in these adulterous and sinful days, the Son of Man will be ashamed of that person when he returns in the glory of his Father with the holy angels."
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels."
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前，必定看见神的国带着能力降临。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前，必定看见神的国带着能力降临。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又对他们说：「<red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必要看见神的国大有能力临到。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to them, <red>“Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see that the kingdom of God has come with power.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Truly, I say to you, there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God after it has come with power."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that there are some standing here who will not taste death till they see the kingdom of God present with power."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus went on to say, "I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Kingdom of God arrive in great power!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus was saying to them, "Truly I say to you, there are some of those who are standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God when it has come with power."
verses.textEn: And he said to them, <red>“Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see that the kingdom of God has come with power.”</red>

verses.textZh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各、约翰，领他们悄悄地上了高山，在他们面前改变了形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各、约翰，领他们悄悄地上了高山，在他们面前改变了形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各、约翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他们面前变了形象，
verses.textEnNiv: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.
verses.textEnEsv: And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. And he was transfigured before them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after six days Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and led them up on a high mountain apart by themselves; and He was transfigured before them.
verses.textEnNlt: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain to be alone. As the men watched, Jesus’ appearance was transformed,
verses.textEnNasb: And six days later Jesus *took with Him Peter, James, and John, and *brought them up on a high mountain by themselves. And He was transfigured before them;
verses.textEn: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.

verses.textZh: 他的衣服闪耀发光，极其洁白，地上漂布的没有能漂得这样白的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的衣服闪耀发光，极其洁白，地上漂布的没有能漂得这样白的。
verses.textZhCuv: 衣服放光，极其洁白，地上漂布的，没有一个能漂得那样白。
verses.textEnNiv: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.
verses.textEnEsv: and his clothes became radiant, intensely white, as no one on earth could bleach them.
verses.textEnNkjv: His clothes became shining, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
verses.textEnNlt: and his clothes became dazzling white, far whiter than any earthly bleach could ever make them.
verses.textEnNasb: and His garments became radiant and exceedingly white, as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
verses.textEn: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.

verses.textZh: 又有以利亚和摩西向他们显现，并且跟耶稣谈话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有以利亚和摩西向他们显现，并且跟耶稣谈话。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，有以利亚同摩西向他们显现，并且和耶稣说话。
verses.textEnNiv: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah appeared to them with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and began talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And Elijah appeared to them along with Moses; and they were talking with Jesus.
verses.textEn: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.

verses.textZh: 彼得对耶稣说："拉比，我们在这里真好！我们可以搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对耶稣说："拉比，我们在这里真好！我们可以搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得对耶稣说：「拉比 ，我们在这里真好！可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good that we are here. Let us make three tents, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter answered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"—
verses.textEnNlt: Peter exclaimed, "Rabbi, it’s wonderful for us to be here! Let’s make three shelters as memorials —one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter responded and *said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good that we are here; let’s make three tabernacles, one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEn: Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."

verses.textZh: 彼得不知道该说甚么才好，因为他们都非常害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得不知道该说甚么才好，因为他们都非常害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得不知道说什么才好，因为他们甚是惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)
verses.textEnEsv: For he did not know what to say, for they were terrified.
verses.textEnNkjv: because he did not know what to say, for they were greatly afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: He said this because he didn’t really know what else to say, for they were all terrified.
verses.textEnNasb: For he did not know how to reply; for they became terrified.
verses.textEn: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)

verses.textZh: 有一片云彩来，笼罩他们，又有声音从云中出来："这是我的爱子，你们要听他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一片云彩来，笼罩他们，又有声音从云中出来："这是我的爱子，你们要听他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一朵云彩来遮盖他们；也有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，你们要听他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: "This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!"
verses.textEnEsv: And a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice came out of the cloud, "This is my beloved Son; listen to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a cloud came and overshadowed them; and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my dearly loved Son. Listen to him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then a cloud formed, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud: "This is My beloved Son; listen to Him!"
verses.textEn: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: "This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!"

verses.textZh: 门徒立刻周围观看，再也看不见别的人，只见耶稣单独和他们在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒立刻周围观看，再也看不见别的人，只见耶稣单独和他们在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒忽然周围一看，不再见一人，只见耶稣同他们在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And suddenly, looking around, they no longer saw anyone with them but Jesus only.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly, when they had looked around, they saw no one anymore, but only Jesus with themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, when they looked around, Moses and Elijah were gone, and they saw only Jesus with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And suddenly they looked around and saw no one with them anymore, except Jesus alone.
verses.textEn: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们，人子从死人中复活之前，不要把所看见的告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们，人子从死人中复活之前，不要把所看见的告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 下山的时候，耶稣嘱咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were coming down the mountain, he charged them to tell no one what they had seen, until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they came down from the mountain, He commanded them that they should tell no one the things they had seen, till the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: As they went back down the mountain, he told them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: As they were coming down from the mountain, He gave them orders not to relate to anyone what they had seen, until the Son of Man rose from the dead.
verses.textEn: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

verses.textZh: 门徒把这句话记在心里，又彼此讨论从死人中复活是甚么意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒把这句话记在心里，又彼此讨论从死人中复活是甚么意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒将这话存记在心，彼此议论「从死里复活」是什么意思。
verses.textEnNiv: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what "rising from the dead" meant.
verses.textEnEsv: So they kept the matter to themselves, questioning what this rising from the dead might mean.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they kept this word to themselves, questioning what the rising from the dead meant.
verses.textEnNlt: So they kept it to themselves, but they often asked each other what he meant by "rising from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: They seized upon that statement, discussing with one another what rising from the dead meant.
verses.textEn: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what "rising from the dead" meant.

verses.textZh: 他们就问耶稣："经学家为甚么说以利亚必须先来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就问耶稣："经学家为甚么说以利亚必须先来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」
verses.textEnNiv: And they asked him, "Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they asked him, "Why do the scribes say that first Elijah must come?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they asked Him, saying, "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then they asked him, "Why do the teachers of religious law insist that Elijah must return before the Messiah comes? "
verses.textEnNasb: And they asked Him, saying, "Why is it that the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"
verses.textEn: And they asked him, "Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>以利亚固然要先来复兴一切，但圣经为甚么又记载人子要受许多苦，被人藐视呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>以利亚固然要先来复兴一切，但圣经为甚么又记载人子要受许多苦，被人藐视呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「以利亚固然先来复兴万事；经上不是指着人子说，他要受许多的苦被人轻慢呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Elijah does come first to restore all things. And how is it written of the Son of Man that he should suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He answered and told them, "Indeed, Elijah is coming first and restores all things. And how is it written concerning the Son of Man, that He must suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "Elijah is indeed coming first to get everything ready. Yet why do the Scriptures say that the Son of Man must suffer greatly and be treated with utter contempt?
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Elijah does come first and he restores all things. And yet how is it written of the Son of Man that He will suffer many things and be treated with contempt?
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>其实我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们却任意待他，正如经上指着他所说的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>其实我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们却任意待他，正如经上指着他所说的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们也任意待他，正如经上所指着他的话。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they did to him whatever they pleased, as it is written of him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that Elijah has also come, and they did to him whatever they wished, as it is written of him."
verses.textEnNlt: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they chose to abuse him, just as the Scriptures predicted."
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you that Elijah has indeed come, and they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written of him."
verses.textEn: <red>But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回到门徒那里，看见一大群人围着他们，又有经学家和他们辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回到门徒那里，看见一大群人围着他们，又有经学家和他们辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了门徒那里，看见有许多人围着他们，又有文士和他们辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great crowd around them, and scribes arguing with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He came to the disciples, He saw a great multitude around them, and scribes disputing with them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd surrounding them, and some teachers of religious law were arguing with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they came back to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and some scribes arguing with them.
verses.textEn: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.

verses.textZh: 众人看见了耶稣，都很惊奇，就跑上前去向他问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见了耶稣，都很惊奇，就跑上前去向他问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人一见耶稣，都甚希奇，就跑上去问他的安。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately all the crowd, when they saw him, were greatly amazed and ran up to him and greeted him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately, when they saw Him, all the people were greatly amazed, and running to Him, greeted Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowd saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with awe, and they ran to greet him.
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately, when the entire crowd saw Him, they were amazed and began running up to greet Him.
verses.textEn: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.

verses.textZh: <red>他问他们："你们和他们辩论甚么？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他问他们："你们和他们辩论甚么？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问他们说：「<red>你们和他们辩论的是什么？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp are you arguing with them about?”</red> he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And he asked them, "What are you arguing about with them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He asked the scribes, "What are you discussing with them?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What is all this arguing about?" Jesus asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And He asked them, "What are you disputing with them?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp are you arguing with them about?”</red> he asked.

verses.textZh: 群众当中有一个回答他："老师，我把我的儿子带到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众当中有一个回答他："老师，我把我的儿子带到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人中间有一个人回答说：「夫子，我带了我的儿子到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。
verses.textEnNiv: A man in the crowd answered, "Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.
verses.textEnEsv: And someone from the crowd answered him, "Teacher, I brought my son to you, for he has a spirit that makes him mute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the crowd answered and said, "Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a mute spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the men in the crowd spoke up and said, "Teacher, I brought my son so you could heal him. He is possessed by an evil spirit that won’t let him talk.
verses.textEnNasb: And one person from the crowd answered Him, "Teacher, I brought You my son, because he has a spirit that makes him unable to speak;
verses.textEn: A man in the crowd answered, "Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.

verses.textZh: 无论在哪里，鬼抓住他，把他摔倒，他就口吐白沫，咬牙切齿，浑身僵硬。我请你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却办不到。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论在哪里，鬼抓住他，把他摔倒，他就口吐白沫，咬牙切齿，浑身僵硬。我请你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却办不到。"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论在哪里，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齿，身体枯干。我请过你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to drive out the spirit, but they could not."
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams and grinds his teeth and becomes rigid. So I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they were not able."
verses.textEnNkjv: And wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; he foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. So I spoke to Your disciples, that they should cast it out, but they could not."
verses.textEnNlt: And whenever this spirit seizes him, it throws him violently to the ground. Then he foams at the mouth and grinds his teeth and becomes rigid. So I asked your disciples to cast out the evil spirit, but they couldn’t do it."
verses.textEnNasb: and whenever it seizes him, it slams him to the ground, and he foams at the mouth and grinds his teeth and becomes stiff. And I told Your disciples so that they would cast it out, but they could not do it."
verses.textEn: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to drive out the spirit, but they could not."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答他们："唉！不信的世代啊！我跟你们在一起到几时呢？我要忍受你们到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答他们："唉！不信的世代啊！我跟你们在一起到几时呢？我要忍受你们到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>嗳！不信的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp unbelieving generation,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, "O faithless generation, how long am I to be with you? How long am I to bear with you? Bring him to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered him and said, "O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said to them, "You faithless people! How long must I be with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to me."
verses.textEnNasb: And He answered them and *said, "O unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring him to Me!"
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp unbelieving generation,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就把孩子带到他跟前。那鬼一见耶稣，就立刻使孩子抽了一阵疯，倒在地上，流着唾沫打滚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把孩子带到他跟前。那鬼一见耶稣，就立刻使孩子抽了一阵疯，倒在地上，流着唾沫打滚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就带了他来。他一见耶稣，鬼便叫他重重地抽风，倒在地上，翻来覆去，口中流沫。
verses.textEnNiv: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought the boy to him. And when the spirit saw him, immediately it convulsed the boy, and he fell on the ground and rolled about, foaming at the mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought him to Him. And when he saw Him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground and wallowed, foaming at the mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: So they brought the boy. But when the evil spirit saw Jesus, it threw the child into a violent convulsion, and he fell to the ground, writhing and foaming at the mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought the boy to Him. When he saw Him, the spirit immediately threw him into convulsions, and falling to the ground, he began rolling around and foaming at the mouth.
verses.textEn: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

verses.textZh: 耶稣问他父亲："这事临到他有多久了？"他说："<red>从小就是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣问他父亲："这事临到他有多久了？"他说："<red>从小就是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问他父亲说：「<red>他得这病有多少日子呢？</red>」回答说：「从小的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus asked the boy’s father, <red>“How long has he been like this?”</red> “From childhood,” he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus asked his father, "How long has this been happening to him?" And he said, "From childhood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He asked his father, "How long has this been happening to him?" And he said, "From childhood.
verses.textEnNlt: "How long has this been happening?" Jesus asked the boy’s father. He replied, "Since he was a little boy.
verses.textEnNasb: And He asked his father, "How long has this been happening to him?" And he said, "From childhood.
verses.textEn: Jesus asked the boy’s father, <red>“How long has he been like this?”</red> “From childhood,” he answered.

verses.textZh: 鬼常常把他扔在火里水中，要毁灭他。如果你能作甚么，求你可怜我们，帮助我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 鬼常常把他扔在火里水中，要毁灭他。如果你能作甚么，求你可怜我们，帮助我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼屡次把他扔在火里、水里，要灭他。你若能做什么，求你怜悯我们，帮助我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us."
verses.textEnEsv: And it has often cast him into fire and into water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And often he has thrown him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us."
verses.textEnNlt: The spirit often throws him into the fire or into water, trying to kill him. Have mercy on us and help us, if you can."
verses.textEnNasb: It has often thrown him both into the fire and into the water to kill him. But if You can do anything, take pity on us and help us!"
verses.textEn: "It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："‘如果你能’ —对于信的人，甚么都能！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："‘如果你能’ —对于信的人，甚么都能！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>你若能信，在信的人，凡事都能。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Ifp you can’?”</red> said Jesus. <red>“Everything is possible for one who believes.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "‘If you can’! All things are possible for one who believes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes."
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you mean, ‘If I can’?" Jesus asked. "Anything is possible if a person believes."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, " ‘If You can’? All things are possible for the one who believes."
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Ifp you can’?”</red> said Jesus. <red>“Everything is possible for one who believes.”</red>

verses.textZh: 孩子的父亲立刻喊着说："我信！但我的信心不够，求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子的父亲立刻喊着说："我信！但我的信心不够，求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子的父亲立时喊着说 ：「我信！但我信不足，求主帮助。」
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, "I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!"
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately the father of the child cried out and said, "I believe; help my unbelief!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately the father of the child cried out and said with tears, "Lord, I believe; help my unbelief!"
verses.textEnNlt: The father instantly cried out, "I do believe, but help me overcome my unbelief!"
verses.textEnNasb: Immediately the boy’s father cried out and said, "I do believe; help my unbelief!"
verses.textEn: Immediately the boy’s father exclaimed, "I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见群众围拢了来，就斥责那污鬼说："<red>聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他身上出来，不要再进去。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见群众围拢了来，就斥责那污鬼说："<red>聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他身上出来，不要再进去。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见众人都跑上来，就斥责那污鬼，说：「<red>你这聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他里头出来，再不要进去！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the impure spirit. <red>“You deaf and mute spirit,”</red> he said, <red>“I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus saw that a crowd came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, "You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him and never enter him again."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, He rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it: "Deaf and dumb spirit, I command you, come out of him and enter him no more!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw that the crowd of onlookers was growing, he rebuked the evil spirit. "Listen, you spirit that makes this boy unable to hear and speak," he said. "I command you to come out of this child and never enter him again!"
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus saw that a crowd was rapidly gathering, He rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, "You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him and do not enter him again!"
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the impure spirit. <red>“You deaf and mute spirit,”</red> he said, <red>“I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那鬼大声喊叫，使孩子重重地抽了一阵疯，就出来了。孩子好象死了一样，所以许多人都说："他死了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那鬼大声喊叫，使孩子重重地抽了一阵疯，就出来了。孩子好象死了一样，所以许多人都说："他死了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一阵风，就出来了。孩子好像死了一般，以致众人多半说：「他是死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, "He’s dead."
verses.textEnEsv: And after crying out and convulsing him terribly, it came out, and the boy was like a corpse, so that most of them said, "He is dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then thespirit cried out, convulsed him greatly, and came out of him. And he became as one dead, so that many said, "He is dead."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the spirit screamed and threw the boy into another violent convulsion and left him. The boy appeared to be dead. A murmur ran through the crowd as people said, "He’s dead."
verses.textEnNasb: And after crying out and throwing him into terrible convulsions, it came out; and the boy became so much like a corpse that most of them said, "He is dead!"
verses.textEn: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, "He’s dead."

verses.textZh: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him up, and he arose.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him up, and he arose.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him, and he got up.
verses.textEn: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒私下问他说："为甚么我们不能把那污鬼赶出去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒私下问他说："为甚么我们不能把那污鬼赶出去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒就暗暗地问他说：「我们为什么不能赶出他去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, "Why couldn’t we drive it out?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had entered the house, his disciples asked him privately, "Why could we not cast it out?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had come into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, "Why could we not cast it out?"
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward, when Jesus was alone in the house with his disciples, they asked him, "Why couldn’t we cast out that evil spirit?"
verses.textEnNasb: When He came into the house, His disciples began asking Him privately, "Why is it that we could not cast it out?"
verses.textEn: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, "Why couldn’t we drive it out?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>这一类的鬼，非用祷告是赶不出去的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>这一类的鬼，非用祷告是赶不出去的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>非用祷告 ，这一类的鬼总不能出来 。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“This kind can come out only by prayer.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "This kind cannot be driven out by anything but prayer."
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "This kind can come out by nothing but prayer and fasting."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "This kind can be cast out only by prayer. "
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "This kind cannot come out by anything except prayer."
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“This kind can come out only by prayer.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们从那里出去，经过加利利，耶稣不想让人知道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从那里出去，经过加利利，耶稣不想让人知道，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离开那地方，经过加利利；耶稣不愿意人知道。
verses.textEnNiv: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,
verses.textEnEsv: They went on from there and passed through Galilee. And he did not want anyone to know,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they departed from there and passed through Galilee, and He did not want anyone to know it.
verses.textEnNlt: Leaving that region, they traveled through Galilee. Jesus didn’t want anyone to know he was there,
verses.textEnNasb: And from there they went out and began to go through Galilee, and He did not want anyone to know about it.
verses.textEn: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,

verses.textZh: 因为他正在教导门徒。他又对他们说："<red>人子将要被交在人的手里，他们要杀害他，死后三天他要复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他正在教导门徒。他又对他们说："<red>人子将要被交在人的手里，他们要杀害他，死后三天他要复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是教训门徒，说：「<red>人子将要被交在人手里，他们要杀害他；被杀以后，过三天他要复活。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, <red>“The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for he was teaching his disciples, saying to them, "The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men, and they will kill him. And when he is killed, after three days he will rise."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He taught His disciples and said to them, "The Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of men, and they will kill Him. And after He is killed, He will rise the third day."
verses.textEnNlt: for he wanted to spend more time with his disciples and teach them. He said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies. He will be killed, but three days later he will rise from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: For He was teaching His disciples and telling them, "The Son of Man is to be handed over to men, and they will kill Him; and when He has been killed, He will rise three days later."
verses.textEn: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, <red>“The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒不明白这话，又不敢问他。

verses.textEnNiv: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not understand this saying, and were afraid to ask Him.
