verses.textZh: 他们来到迦百农。在屋里的时候，耶稣问他们："<red>你们在路上争论甚么？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到迦百农。在屋里的时候，耶稣问他们："<red>你们在路上争论甚么？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到迦百农。耶稣在屋里问门徒说：「<red>你们在路上议论的是什么？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, <red>“What were you arguing about on the road?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Capernaum. And when he was in the house he asked them, "What were you discussing on the way?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came to Capernaum. And when He was in the house He asked them, "What was it you disputed among yourselves on the road?"
verses.textEnNlt: After they arrived at Capernaum and settled in a house, Jesus asked his disciples, "What were you discussing out on the road?"
verses.textEnNasb: They came to Capernaum; and when He was in the house, He began to question them: "What were you discussing on the way?"
verses.textEn: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, <red>“What were you arguing about on the road?”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒一声不响，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒一声不响，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒不作声，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。
verses.textEnNiv: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.
verses.textEnEsv: But they kept silent, for on the way they had argued with one another about who was the greatest.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they kept silent, for on the road they had disputed among themselves who wouldbethe greatest.
verses.textEnNlt: But they didn’t answer, because they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.
verses.textEnNasb: But they kept silent, for on the way they had discussed with one another which of them was the greatest.
verses.textEn: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.

verses.textZh: 耶稣坐下，叫十二门徒来，对他们说："<red>谁想为首，就该作众人中最末的一个，作众人的仆人。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣坐下，叫十二门徒来，对他们说："<red>谁想为首，就该作众人中最末的一个，作众人的仆人。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣坐下，叫十二个门徒来，说：「<red>若有人愿意作首先的，他必作众人末后的，作众人的用人。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, <red>“Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sat down and called the twelve. And he said to them, "If anyone would be first, he must be last of all and servant of all."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He sat down, called the twelve, and said to them, "If anyone desires to be first, he shall be last of all and servant of all."
verses.textEnNlt: He sat down, called the twelve disciples over to him, and said, "Whoever wants to be first must take last place and be the servant of everyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: And sitting down, He called the twelve and *said to them, "If anyone wants to be first, he shall be last of all and servant of all."
verses.textEn: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, <red>“Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.”</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"凡因我的名接待一个这样的小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，而是接待那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"凡因我的名接待一个这样的小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，而是接待那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>凡为我名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我来的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever receives one such child in my name receives me, and whoever receives me, receives not me but him who sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever receives one of these little children in My name receives Me; and whoever receives Me, receives not Me but Him who sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who welcomes a little child like this on my behalf welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes not only me but also my Father who sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: "Whoever receives one child like this in My name receives Me; and whoever receives Me does not receive Me, but Him who sent Me."
verses.textEn: <red>“Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 约翰对耶稣说："老师，我们看见有一个人奉你的名赶鬼，就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰对耶稣说："老师，我们看见有一个人奉你的名赶鬼，就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰对耶稣说：「夫子，我们看见一个人奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher," said John, "we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us."
verses.textEnEsv: John said to him, "Teacher, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we tried to stop him, because he was not following us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now John answered Him, saying, "Teacher, we saw someone who does not follow us casting out demons in Your name, and we forbade him because he does not follow us."
verses.textEnNlt: John said to Jesus, "Teacher, we saw someone using your name to cast out demons, but we told him to stop because he wasn’t in our group."
verses.textEnNasb: John said to Him, "Teacher, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we tried to prevent him because he was not following us."
verses.textEn: "Teacher," said John, "we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us."

verses.textZh: <red>无论谁因你们有属基督的名分，给你们一杯水喝的，我实在告诉你们，他决不会失掉赏赐。</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣从那里动身，来到约旦河东的犹太境内。许多人又聚集到他那里，他像平常一样教导他们。

verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣从那里起身，来到犹太的境界并约旦河外。众人又聚集到他那里，他又照常教训他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he left there and went to the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan, and crowds gathered to him again. And again, as was his custom, he taught them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He arose from there and came to the region of Judea by the other side of the Jordan. And multitudes gathered to Him again, and as He was accustomed, He taught them again.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus left Capernaum and went down to the region of Judea and into the area east of the Jordan River. Once again crowds gathered around him, and as usual he was teaching them.
verses.textEnNasb: Setting out from there, Jesus *went to the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan; crowds *gathered to Him again, and, as He was accustomed, He once more began to teach them.
verses.textEn: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.

verses.textZh: 有法利赛人前来试探耶稣，问他："丈夫可以休妻吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有法利赛人前来试探耶稣，问他："丈夫可以休妻吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有法利赛人来问他说：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要试探他。
verses.textEnNiv: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharisees came up and in order to test him asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The Pharisees came and asked Him, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?" testing Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some Pharisees came and tried to trap him with this question: "Should a man be allowed to divorce his wife?"
verses.textEnNasb: And some Pharisees came up to Jesus, testing Him, and began questioning Him whether it was lawful for a man to divorce his wife.
verses.textEn: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："摩西吩咐你们的是甚么呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："摩西吩咐你们的是甚么呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>摩西吩咐你们的是什么？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp did Moses command you?”</red> he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: He answered them, "What did Moses command you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He answered and said to them, "What did Moses command you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered them with a question: "What did Moses say in the law about divorce?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He answered and said to them, "What did Moses command you?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp did Moses command you?”</red> he replied.

verses.textZh: 他们说："摩西准许‘人写了休书就可以休妻’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："摩西准许‘人写了休书就可以休妻’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「摩西许人写了休书便可以休妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said, "Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away."
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of divorce and to send her away."
verses.textEnNkjv: They said, "Moses permitted aman to write a certificate of divorce, and to dismiss her."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, he permitted it," they replied. "He said a man can give his wife a written notice of divorce and send her away."
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send his wife away."
verses.textEn: They said, "Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："因为你们的心硬，摩西才写这条例给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："因为你们的心硬，摩西才写这条例给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「摩西因为你们的心硬，所以写这条例给你们；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Itp was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Because of the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus responded, "He wrote this commandment only as a concession to your hard hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to them, " Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.
verses.textEn: <red>“Itp was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: <red>但从起初创造的时候，神是‘造男造女’。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但从起初创造的时候，神是‘造男造女’。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但从起初创造的时候，神造人是造男造女。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But from the beginning of the creation, God ‘made them male and female.’
verses.textEnNlt: But ‘God made them male and female’ from the beginning of creation.
verses.textEnNasb: But from the beginning of creation, Godcreated them male and female.
verses.textEn: <red>“But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>‘因此人要离开父母，与妻子连合，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>‘因此人要离开父母，与妻子连合，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife,
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This explains why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife,
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother ,
verses.textEn: <red>‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>二人成为一体了。’这样，他们不再是两个人，而是一体的了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>二人成为一体了。’这样，他们不再是两个人，而是一体的了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and the two shall become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two but one flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the two shall become one flesh’; so then they are no longer two, but one flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: and the two are united into one.’ Since they are no longer two but one,
verses.textEnNasb: and the two shall become one flesh; so they are no longer two, but one flesh.
verses.textEn: <red>and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以神所配合的，人不可分开。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以神所配合的，人不可分开。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，神配合的，人不可分开。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: What therefore God has joined together, let not man separate."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."
verses.textEnNlt: let no one split apart what God has joined together."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, what God has joined together, no person is to separate."
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”</red>

verses.textZh: 回到屋子里，门徒再提起这件事来问他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 回到屋子里，门徒再提起这件事来问他。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了屋里，门徒就问他这事。
verses.textEnNiv: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the house the disciples asked him again about this matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the house His disciples also asked Him again about the same matter.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when he was alone with his disciples in the house, they brought up the subject again.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the house the disciples again began questioning Him about this.
verses.textEn: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.

verses.textZh: 他对他们说："<red>谁休妻另娶，谁就是犯奸淫，得罪了妻子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对他们说："<red>谁休妻另娶，谁就是犯奸淫，得罪了妻子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯奸淫，辜负他的妻子；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, <red>“Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her,
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery against her.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her;
verses.textEn: He answered, <red>“Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果妻子弃夫另嫁，也是犯了奸淫。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果妻子弃夫另嫁，也是犯了奸淫。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>妻子若离弃丈夫另嫁，也是犯奸淫了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and if she divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery."
verses.textEnNlt: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries someone else, she commits adultery."
verses.textEnNasb: and if she herself divorces her husband and marries another man, she is committing adultery."
verses.textEn: <red>And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有人带着小孩子到耶稣跟前，要他触摸他们；门徒却责备那些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人带着小孩子到耶稣跟前，要他触摸他们；门徒却责备那些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣摸他们，门徒便责备那些人。
verses.textEnNiv: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were bringing children to him that he might touch them, and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought little children to Him, that He might touch them; but the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
verses.textEnNlt: One day some parents brought their children to Jesus so he could touch and bless them. But the disciples scolded the parents for bothering him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were bringing children to Him so that He would touch them; but the disciples rebuked them.
verses.textEn: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见了就生气，对门徒说："<red>让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为神的国是属于这样的人的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见了就生气，对门徒说："<red>让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为神的国是属于这样的人的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看见就恼怒，对门徒说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在神国的，正是这样的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, <red>“Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when Jesus saw it, he was indignant and said to them, "Let the children come to me; do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jesus saw it, He was greatly displeased and said to them, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw what was happening, he was angry with his disciples. He said to them, "Let the children come to me. Don’t stop them! For the Kingdom of God belongs to those who are like these children.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and said to them, "Allow the children to come to Me; do not forbid them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, <red>“Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡是不像小孩子一样接受神的国的，绝对不能进去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡是不像小孩子一样接受神的国的，绝对不能进去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡要承受神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child shall not enter it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will by no means enter it."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, anyone who doesn’t receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child will not enter it at all."
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣把小孩子抱起来，为他们按手祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣把小孩子抱起来，为他们按手祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是抱着小孩子，给他们按手，为他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took them up in His arms, laid His hands on them, and blessed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took the children in his arms and placed his hands on their heads and blessed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He took them in His arms and began blessing them, laying His hands on them.
verses.textEn: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.

verses.textZh: 耶稣又开始他的行程。那时，有一个人跑过来，跪在他面前，问他说："良善的老师，我当作甚么，才可以承受永生？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又开始他的行程。那时，有一个人跑过来，跪在他面前，问他说："良善的老师，我当作甚么，才可以承受永生？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出来行路的时候，有一个人跑来，跪在他面前，问他说：「良善的夫子，我当做什么事才可以承受永生？」
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. "Good teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnEsv: And as he was setting out on his journey, a man ran up and knelt before him and asked him, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as He was going out on the road, one came running, knelt before Him, and asked Him, "Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was starting out on his way to Jerusalem, a man came running up to him, knelt down, and asked, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNasb: As He was setting out on a journey, a man ran up to Him and knelt before Him, and asked Him, "Good Teacher, what shall I do so that I may inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEn: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. "Good teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："你为甚么称我是良善的？除了神一位以外，没有良善的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："你为甚么称我是良善的？除了神一位以外，没有良善的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了神一位之外，再没有良善的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp do you call me good?”</red> Jesus answered. <red>“No one is good—except God alone.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus asked. "Only God is truly good.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good except God alone.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp do you call me good?”</red> Jesus answered. <red>“No one is good—except God alone.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>诫命你是知道的：不可杀人，不可奸淫，不可偷盗，不可作假证供，不可欺诈，当孝敬父母。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>诫命你是知道的：不可杀人，不可奸淫，不可偷盗，不可作假证供，不可欺诈，当孝敬父母。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>诫命你是晓得的：不可杀人；不可奸淫；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；不可亏负人；当孝敬父母。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Do not defraud, Honor your father and mother.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not bear false witness,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But to answer your question, you know the commandments: ‘You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely. You must not cheat anyone. Honor your father and mother.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, Do not commit adultery, Do not steal, Do not give false testimony, Do not defraud, Honor your father and mother.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 他对耶稣说："老师，这一切我从小都遵守了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对耶稣说："老师，这一切我从小都遵守了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对耶稣说：「夫子，这一切我从小都遵守了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher," he declared, "all these I have kept since I was a boy."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Teacher, all these I have kept from my youth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he answered and said to Him, "Teacher, all these things I have kept from my youth."
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher," the man replied, "I’ve obeyed all these commandments since I was young."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to Him, "Teacher, I have kept all these things from my youth."
verses.textEn: "Teacher," he declared, "all these I have kept since I was a boy."

verses.textZh: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说："<red>你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必定有财宝在天上，而且你要来跟从我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说："<red>你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必定有财宝在天上，而且你要来跟从我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说：「<red>你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus looked at him and loved him. <red>“One thing you lack,”</red> he said. <red>“Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus, looking at him, loved him, and said to him, "You lack one thing: go, sell all that you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus, looking at him, loved him, and said to him, "One thing you lack: Go your way, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, take up the cross, and follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Looking at the man, Jesus felt genuine love for him. "There is still one thing you haven’t done," he told him. "Go and sell all your possessions and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
verses.textEnNasb: Looking at him, Jesus showed love to him and said to him, "One thing you lack: go and sell all you possess and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."
verses.textEn: Jesus looked at him and loved him. <red>“One thing you lack,”</red> he said. <red>“Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人听见这话，就变了脸色，忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的财产很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人听见这话，就变了脸色，忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的财产很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见这话，脸上就变了色，忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的产业很多。
verses.textEnNiv: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.
verses.textEnEsv: Disheartened by the saying, he went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he was sad at this word, and went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: At this the man’s face fell, and he went away sad, for he had many possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: But he was deeply dismayed by these words, and he went away grieving; for he was one who owned much property.
verses.textEn: At this the man’s face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.

verses.textZh: 耶稣周围观看，对门徒说："<red>富有的人要进神的国，是多么难哪！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣周围观看，对门徒说："<red>富有的人要进神的国，是多么难哪！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说：「<red>有钱财的人进神的国是何等地难哪！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, <red>“How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How difficult it will be for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God!"

verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus called them to him and said to them, "You know that those who are considered rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus called them to Himself and said to them, "You know that those who are considered rulers over the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers in this world lord it over their people, and officials flaunt their authority over those under them.
verses.textEnNasb: Calling them to Himself, Jesus *said to them, "You know that those who are recognized as rulers of the Gentiles domineer over them; and their people in high position exercise authority over them.
verses.textEn: Jesus called them together and said, <red>“You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你们中间却不要这样；谁想在你们中间为大的，就要作你们的仆役，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你们中间却不要这样；谁想在你们中间为大的，就要作你们的仆役，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是在你们中间，不是这样。你们中间，谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But it shall not be so among you. But whoever would be great among you must be your servant,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet it shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: But among you it will be different. Whoever wants to be a leader among you must be your servant,
verses.textEnNasb: But it is not this way among you; rather, whoever wants to become prominent among you shall be your servant;
verses.textEn: <red>Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>谁想在你们中间为首的，就要作大家的奴仆。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>谁想在你们中间为首的，就要作大家的奴仆。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在你们中间，谁愿为首，就必作众人的仆人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and whoever would be first among you must be slave of all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever of you desires to be first shall be slave of all.
verses.textEnNlt: and whoever wants to be first among you must be the slave of everyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: and whoever wants to be first among you shall be slave of all.
verses.textEn: <red>and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为人子来，不是要受人服事，而是要服事人，并且要舍命，作许多人的赎价。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为人子来，不是要受人服事，而是要服事人，并且要舍命，作许多人的赎价。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为人子来，并不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命作多人的赎价。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNkjv: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNlt: For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEnNasb: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many."
verses.textEn: <red>For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们进了耶利哥。耶稣、门徒和一大群人从耶利哥出来的时候，有一个瞎眼的人，是底买的儿子，名叫巴底买，坐在路旁讨饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进了耶利哥。耶稣、门徒和一大群人从耶利哥出来的时候，有一个瞎眼的人，是底买的儿子，名叫巴底买，坐在路旁讨饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了耶利哥；耶稣同门徒并许多人出耶利哥的时候，有一个讨饭的瞎子，是底买的儿子巴底买，坐在路旁。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means "son of Timaeus"), was sitting by the roadside begging.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Jericho. And as he was leaving Jericho with his disciples and a great crowd, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the roadside.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they came to Jericho. As He went out of Jericho with His disciples and a great multitude, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the road begging.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they reached Jericho, and as Jesus and his disciples left town, a large crowd followed him. A blind beggar named Bartimaeus (son of Timaeus) was sitting beside the road.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they *came to Jericho. And later, as He was leaving Jericho with His disciples and a large crowd, a beggar who was blind named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the road.
verses.textEn: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means "son of Timaeus"), was sitting by the roadside begging.

verses.textZh: 他听见是拿撒勒人耶稣，就喊叫，说："大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听见是拿撒勒人耶稣，就喊叫，说："大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见是拿撒勒的耶稣，就喊着说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊！可怜我吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and say, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out and say, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Bartimaeus heard that Jesus of Nazareth was nearby, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNasb: And when he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEn: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.textZh: 许多人斥责他，叫他不要出声；他却更加放声喊叫："大卫的子孙啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人斥责他，叫他不要出声；他却更加放声喊叫："大卫的子孙啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人责备他，不许他作声。他却越发大声喊着说：「大卫的子孙哪，可怜我吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And many rebuked him, telling him to be silent. But he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then many warned him to be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Be quiet!" many of the people yelled at him. But he only shouted louder, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Many were sternly telling him to be quiet, but he kept crying out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEn: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣就站住，说："<red>把他叫过来。</red>"他们就叫那瞎眼的人，对他说："<red>放心吧，起来，他叫你了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就站住，说："<red>把他叫过来。</red>"他们就叫那瞎眼的人，对他说："<red>放心吧，起来，他叫你了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就站住，说：「<red>叫过他来。</red>」他们就叫那瞎子，对他说：「<red>放心，起来！他叫你啦。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus stopped and said, <red>“Call him.”</red> So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you.”
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." And they called the blind man, saying to him, "Take heart. Get up; he is calling you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus stood still and commanded him to be called. Then they called the blind man, saying to him, "Be of good cheer. Rise, He is calling you."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard him, he stopped and said, "Tell him to come here." So they called the blind man. "Cheer up," they said. "Come on, he’s calling you!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus stopped and said, "Call him here." So they *called the man who was blind, saying to him, "Take courage, stand up! He is calling for you."
verses.textEn: Jesus stopped and said, <red>“Call him.”</red> So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! He’s calling you.”

verses.textZh: 他就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 瞎子就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And throwing off his cloak, he sprang up and came to Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And throwing aside his garment, he rose and came to Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Bartimaeus threw aside his coat, jumped up, and came to Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And throwing off his cloak, he jumped up and came to Jesus.
verses.textEn: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："你要我为你作甚么呢？"瞎眼的人对他说："拉波尼，我要能看见。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："你要我为你作甚么呢？"瞎眼的人对他说："拉波尼，我要能看见。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>要我为你做什么？</red>」瞎子说：「<red>拉波尼 ，我要能看见。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp do you want me to do for you?”</red> Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "What do you want me to do for you?" And the blind man said to him, "Rabbi, let me recover my sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus answered and said to him, "What do you want Me to do for you?" The blind man said to Him, "Rabboni, that I may receive my sight."
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you want me to do for you?" Jesus asked. "My Rabbi, " the blind man said, "I want to see!"
verses.textEnNasb: And replying to him, Jesus said, "What do you want Me to do for you?" And the man who was blind said to Him, " Rabboni, I want to regain my sight!"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp do you want me to do for you?”</red> Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："去吧，你的信使你痊愈了。"他立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："去吧，你的信使你痊愈了。"他立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你去吧！你的信救了你了。</red>」瞎子立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Go,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“your faith has healed you.”</red> Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your faith has made you well." And immediately he recovered his sight and followed him on the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your faith has made you well." And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the road.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus said to him, "Go, for your faith has healed you." Instantly the man could see, and he followed Jesus down the road.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "Go; your faith has made you well." And immediately he regained his sight and began following Him on the road.
verses.textEn: <red>“Go,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“your faith has healed you.”</red> Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

verses.textZh: 他们走近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，来到橄榄山那里，耶稣派了两个门徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，来到橄榄山那里，耶稣派了两个门徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里；耶稣就打发两个门徒，
verses.textEnNiv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they drew near Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples;
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem, they came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives. Jesus sent two of them on ahead.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they *approached Jerusalem, at Bethphage and Bethany, near the Mount of Olives, He *sent two of His disciples,
verses.textEn: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,

verses.textZh: 对他们说："<red>你们往对面的村子里去，一进去，就会看见一头小驴拴在那里，是没有人骑过的，把牠解开牵来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："<red>你们往对面的村子里去，一进去，就会看见一头小驴拴在那里，是没有人骑过的，把牠解开牵来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，一进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开，牵来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: saying to them, <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "Go into the village in front of you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it.
verses.textEnNkjv: and He said to them, "Go into the village opposite you; and as soon as you have entered it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has sat. Loose it and bring it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go into that village over there," he told them. "As soon as you enter it, you will see a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
verses.textEnNasb: and *said to them, "Go into the village opposite you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat; untie it and bring it here.
verses.textEn: saying to them, <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果有人问你们：‘为甚么这样作？’你们就说：‘主需要牠，并且很快会送还到这里来。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果有人问你们：‘为甚么这样作？’你们就说：‘主需要牠，并且很快会送还到这里来。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人对你们说：『为什么做这事？』你们就说：『主要用它。』那人必立时让你们牵来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it and will send it back here immediately.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it,’ and immediately he will send it here."
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone asks, ‘What are you doing?’ just say, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it soon.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it’; and immediately he will send it back here."
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒去了，就发现一头小驴，拴在门外的街上，就把牠解开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒去了，就发现一头小驴，拴在门外的街上，就把牠解开。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们去了，便看见一匹驴驹拴在门外街道上，就把它解开。
verses.textEnNiv: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,
verses.textEnEsv: And they went away and found a colt tied at a door outside in the street, and they untied it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door outside on the street, and they loosed it.
verses.textEnNlt: The two disciples left and found the colt standing in the street, tied outside the front door.
verses.textEnNasb: They went away and found a colt tied at the door, outside in the street; and they *untied it.
verses.textEn: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,

verses.textZh: 站在那里的人有的问他们说："你们为甚么解牠？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在那里的人有的问他们说："你们为甚么解牠？"
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里站着的人，有几个说：「你们解驴驹做什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: some people standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"
verses.textEnEsv: And some of those standing there said to them, "What are you doing, untying the colt?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But some of those who stood there said to them, "What are you doing, loosing the colt?"
verses.textEnNlt: As they were untying it, some bystanders demanded, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"
verses.textEnNasb: And some of the bystanders were saying to them, "What are you doing, untying the colt?"
verses.textEn: some people standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"

verses.textZh: 门徒照着耶稣所说的话回答他们，那些人就让他们牵走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒照着耶稣所说的话回答他们，那些人就让他们牵走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒照着耶稣所说的回答，那些人就任凭他们牵去了。
verses.textEnNiv: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: And they told them what Jesus had said, and they let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they spoke to them just as Jesus had commanded. So they let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: They said what Jesus had told them to say, and they were permitted to take it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they told them just as Jesus had said, and they gave them permission.
verses.textEn: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.

verses.textZh: 门徒把小驴牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑了上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒把小驴牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑了上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把驴驹牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。
verses.textEnNiv: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks on it, and he sat on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their clothes on it, and He sat on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it, and he sat on it.
verses.textEnNasb: They *brought the colt to Jesus and *put their cloaks on it; and He sat on it.
verses.textEn: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.

verses.textZh: 许多人把衣服铺在路上，还有人从田野里砍了些树枝也铺在路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人把衣服铺在路上，还有人从田野里砍了些树枝也铺在路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人把衣服铺在路上，也有人把田间的树枝砍下来，铺在路上。
verses.textEnNiv: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: And many spread their cloaks on the road, and others spread leafy branches that they had cut from the fields.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many spread their clothes on the road, and others cut down leafy branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.textEnNlt: Many in the crowd spread their garments on the road ahead of him, and others spread leafy branches they had cut in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: And many people spread their cloaks on the road, and others spread leafy branches which they had cut from the fields.
verses.textEn: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.

verses.textZh: 前行后随的人都喊着说： "‘和散那’， 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！
verses.textZhCnvs: 前行后随的人都喊着说： "‘和散那’， 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！
verses.textZhCuv: 前行后随的人都喊着说： 和散那 ！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！
verses.textEnNiv: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, "Hosanna! " "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
verses.textEnEsv: And those who went before and those who followed were shouting, "Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna! ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was in the center of the procession, and the people all around him were shouting, "Praise God! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: And those who went in front and those who followed were shouting: " Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord;
verses.textEn: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, "Hosanna! " "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"

verses.textZh: 那将要来临的， 我们祖先大卫的国是应当称颂的！ 高天之上当唱‘和散那’！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那将要来临的， 我们祖先大卫的国是应当称颂的！ 高天之上当唱‘和散那’！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那将要来的我祖大卫之国是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！
verses.textEnNiv: "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David That comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEnNlt: Blessings on the coming Kingdom of our ancestor David! Praise God in highest heaven!"
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David; Hosanna in the highest!"
verses.textEn: "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!" "Hosanna in the highest heaven!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣到了耶路撒冷，进入圣殿，察看了一切，因为时候已经不早，就和十二门徒出城往伯大尼去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣到了耶路撒冷，进入圣殿，察看了一切，因为时候已经不早，就和十二门徒出城往伯大尼去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了圣殿，周围看了各样物件。天色已晚，就和十二个门徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: And he entered Jerusalem and went into the temple. And when he had looked around at everything, as it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus went into Jerusalem and into the temple. So when He had looked around at all things, as the hour was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus came to Jerusalem and went into the Temple. After looking around carefully at everything, he left because it was late in the afternoon. Then he returned to Bethany with the twelve disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus entered Jerusalem and came into the temple area; and after looking around at everything, He left for Bethany with the twelve, since it was already late.
verses.textEn: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

verses.textZh: 第二天他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
verses.textEnEsv: On the following day, when they came from Bethany, he was hungry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the next day, when they had come out from Bethany, He was hungry.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day, when they had left Bethany, He became hungry.
verses.textEn: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

verses.textZh: 他远远看见一棵长满了叶子的无花果树，就走过去，看看是否可以在树上找到甚么。到了树下，除了叶子甚么也找不着，因为这不是收无花果的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他远远看见一棵长满了叶子的无花果树，就走过去，看看是否可以在树上找到甚么。到了树下，除了叶子甚么也找不着，因为这不是收无花果的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就往那里去，或者在树上可以找着什么。到了树下，竟找不着什么，不过有叶子，因为不是收无花果的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
verses.textEnEsv: And seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to see if he could find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seeing from afar a fig tree having leaves, He went to see if perhaps He would find something on it. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.textEnNlt: He noticed a fig tree in full leaf a little way off, so he went over to see if he could find any figs. But there were only leaves because it was too early in the season for fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: Seeing from a distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if perhaps He would find anything on it; and when He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
verses.textEn: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对树说："<red>永远再没有人吃你的果子了！</red>"他的门徒也听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对树说："<red>永远再没有人吃你的果子了！</red>"他的门徒也听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就对树说：「<red>从今以后，永没有人吃你的果子。</red>」他的门徒也听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to the tree, <red>“May no one ever eat fruit from you again.”</red> And his disciples heard him say it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again." And his disciples heard it.
verses.textEnNkjv: In response Jesus said to it, "Let no one eat fruit from you ever again." And His disciples heard it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the tree, "May no one ever eat your fruit again!" And the disciples heard him say it.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again!" And His disciples were listening.
verses.textEn: Then he said to the tree, <red>“May no one ever eat fruit from you again.”</red> And his disciples heard him say it.

verses.textZh: 他们来到耶路撒冷。耶稣进了圣殿，就把殿里作买卖的人赶走，又推倒找换银钱的人的桌子，和卖鸽子的人的凳子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到耶路撒冷。耶稣进了圣殿，就把殿里作买卖的人赶走，又推倒找换银钱的人的桌子，和卖鸽子的人的凳子；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到耶路撒冷。耶稣进入圣殿，赶出殿里做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子和卖鸽子之人的凳子；
verses.textEnNiv: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Jerusalem. And he entered the temple and began to drive out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they came to Jerusalem. Then Jesus went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived back in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out the people buying and selling animals for sacrifices. He knocked over the tables of the money changers and the chairs of those selling doves,
verses.textEnNasb: Then they *came to Jerusalem. And He entered the temple area and began to drive out those who were selling and buying on the temple grounds, and He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves;
verses.textEn: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,

verses.textZh: 不许人拿着器皿穿过圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不许人拿着器皿穿过圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不许人拿着器具从殿里经过；
verses.textEnNiv: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
verses.textEnEsv: And he would not allow anyone to carry anything through the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He would not allow anyone to carry wares through the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: and he stopped everyone from using the Temple as a marketplace.
verses.textEnNasb: and He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple grounds.
verses.textEn: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.

verses.textZh: 他又教训众人说："<red>经上不是写着 ‘我的殿要称为万国祷告的殿’吗？ 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又教训众人说："<red>经上不是写着 ‘我的殿要称为万国祷告的殿’吗？ 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 便教训他们说：「<red>经上不是记着说： 我的殿必称为万国祷告的殿吗？ 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And as he taught them, he said, <red>“Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he was teaching them and saying to them, "Is it not written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He taught, saying to them, "Is it not written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’"
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, ‘My Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations,’ but you have turned it into a den of thieves."
verses.textEnNasb: And He began to teach and say to them, "Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers."
verses.textEn: And as he taught them, he said, <red>“Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 祭司长和经学家听见了，就想办法怎样除掉耶稣，却又怕他，因为群众都希奇他的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和经学家听见了，就想办法怎样除掉耶稣，却又怕他，因为群众都希奇他的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和文士听见这话，就想法子要除灭耶稣，却又怕他，因为众人都希奇他的教训。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chief priests and the scribes heard it and were seeking a way to destroy him, for they feared him, because all the crowd was astonished at his teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it and sought how they might destroy Him; for they feared Him, because all the people were astonished at His teaching.
verses.textEnNlt: When the leading priests and teachers of religious law heard what Jesus had done, they began planning how to kill him. But they were afraid of him because the people were so amazed at his teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: And the chief priests and the scribes heard this, and they began seeking how to put Him to death; for they were afraid of Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.
verses.textEn: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，他们就到城外去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，他们就到城外去。
verses.textZhCuv: 每天晚上，耶稣出城去。
verses.textEnNiv: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And when evening came they went out of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: When evening had come, He went out of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening Jesus and the disciples left the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And whenever evening came, they would leave the city.
verses.textEn: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.

verses.textZh: 早晨，他们经过的时候，看见那棵无花果树连根都枯萎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 早晨，他们经过的时候，看见那棵无花果树连根都枯萎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见无花果树连根都枯干了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
verses.textEnEsv: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away to its roots.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning as they passed by the fig tree he had cursed, the disciples noticed it had withered from the roots up.
verses.textEnNasb: As they were passing by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots up.
verses.textEn: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.

verses.textZh: 彼得想起来就对耶稣说："拉比，请看，你所咒诅的无花果树，已经枯萎了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得想起来就对耶稣说："拉比，请看，你所咒诅的无花果树，已经枯萎了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得想起耶稣的话来，就对他说：「拉比，请看！你所咒诅的无花果树已经枯干了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter remembered and said to him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree that you cursed has withered."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Peter, remembering, said to Him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree which You cursed has withered away."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter remembered what Jesus had said to the tree on the previous day and exclaimed, "Look, Rabbi! The fig tree you cursed has withered and died!"
verses.textEnNasb: And being reminded, Peter *said to Him, "Rabbi, look, the fig tree that You cursed has withered."
verses.textEn: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答他们："你们对神要有信心 。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答他们："你们对神要有信心 。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「你们当信服神。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Havep faith in God,”</red> Jesus answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered them, "Have faith in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Have faith in God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the disciples, "Have faith in God.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered and *said to them, "Have faith in God.
verses.textEn: <red>“Havep faith in God,”</red> Jesus answered.

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，无论甚么人对这座山说‘移开，投到海里’，只要他心里不怀疑，相信他所说的一定能够成就，就必给他成就。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，无论甚么人对这座山说‘移开，投到海里’，只要他心里不怀疑，相信他所说的一定能够成就，就必给他成就。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，无论何人对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』他若心里不疑惑，只信他所说的必成，就必给他成了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will come to pass, it will be done for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be removed and be cast into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, you can say to this mountain, ‘May you be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and it will happen. But you must really believe it will happen and have no doubt in your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is going to happen, it will be granted to him.
verses.textEn: <red>“Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以我告诉你们，凡是你们祷告祈求的，只要相信能够得到，就必得到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以我告诉你们，凡是你们祷告祈求的，只要相信能够得到，就必得到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信是得着的，就必得着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I say to you, whatever things you ask when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you will have them.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, you can pray for anything, and if you believe that you’ve received it, it will be yours.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I say to you, all things for which you pray and ask, believe that you have received them, and they will be granted to you.
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们站着祷告的时候，如果有谁得罪了你们，就该饶恕他，好使你们的天父也饶恕你们的过犯。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们站着祷告的时候，如果有谁得罪了你们，就该饶恕他，好使你们的天父也饶恕你们的过犯。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们站着祷告的时候，若想起有人得罪你们，就当饶恕他，好叫你们在天上的父也饶恕你们的过犯。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you are praying, first forgive anyone you are holding a grudge against, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your sins, too. "
verses.textEnNasb: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who is in heaven will also forgive you for your offenses.
verses.textEn: <red>And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长、经学家和长老来到他跟前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长、经学家和长老来到他跟前，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不饶恕人，你们在天上的父也不饶恕你们的过犯。 」
verses.textEnNiv: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came again to Jerusalem. And as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders came to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses."
verses.textEnNlt: Again they entered Jerusalem. As Jesus was walking through the Temple area, the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders came up to him.
verses.textEnNasb: [ But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your offenses."]
verses.textEn: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.

verses.textZh: 问他："你凭甚么权柄作这些事？谁给你权柄作这些事？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 问他："你凭甚么权柄作这些事？谁给你权柄作这些事？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长和文士并长老进前来，
verses.textEnNiv: "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you authority to do this?"
verses.textEnEsv: and they said to him, "By what authority are you doing these things, or who gave you this authority to do them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right to do them?"
verses.textEnNasb: And they *came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple area, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders *came to Him,
verses.textEn: "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you authority to do this?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："我要问你们一句话，你们回答了我，我就告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："我要问你们一句话，你们回答了我，我就告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。
verses.textZhCuv: 问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question; answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to Him, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority to do these things?"
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll tell you by what authority I do these things if you answer one question," Jesus replied.
verses.textEnNasb: and began saying to Him, "By what authority are You doing these things, or who gave You this authority to do these things?"
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

verses.textZh: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？你们回答我吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？你们回答我吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Was the baptism of John from heaven or from man? Answer me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one question; then answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things:
verses.textEnNlt: "Did John’s authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human? Answer me!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question, and you answer Me, and then I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们就彼此议论："如果我们说‘是从天上来的’，他就会说‘那你们为甚么不信他呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们就彼此议论："如果我们说‘是从天上来的’，他就会说‘那你们为甚么不信他呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？你们可以回答我。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they discussed it with one another, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNkjv: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me."
verses.textEnNlt: They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask why we didn’t believe John.
verses.textEnNasb: Was the baptism of John from heaven, or from men? Answer Me."
verses.textEn: <red>John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”</red>

verses.textZh: 如果我们说‘是从人来的’……"他们害怕群众，因为众人都认为约翰的确是先知。

verses.textEnNiv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …" (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)
verses.textEnEsv: But shall we say, ‘From man’?"— they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John really was a prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNlt: But do we dare say it was merely human?" For they were afraid of what the people would do, because everyone believed that John was a prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began considering the implications among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Then why did you not believe him?’
verses.textEn: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …" (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)

verses.textZh: 于是他们回答耶稣："我们不知道。"耶稣对他们说："我也不告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们回答耶稣："我们不知道。"耶稣对他们说："我也不告诉你们我凭甚么权柄作这些事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若说『从人间来』，却又怕百姓，因为众人真以约翰为先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: So they answered Jesus, "We don’t know." Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."
verses.textEnEsv: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know." And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if we say, ‘From men’ "—they feared the people, for all counted John to have been a prophet indeed.
verses.textEnNlt: So they finally replied, "We don’t know." And Jesus responded, "Then I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNasb: But should we say, ‘From men’?"—they were afraid of the people, for they all considered John to have been a real prophet.
verses.textEn: So they answered Jesus, "We don’t know." Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."

verses.textZh: 于是回答耶稣说：「<red>我们不知道。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>」
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是回答耶稣说：「<red>我们不知道。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>」
verses.textZhCuv: 于是回答耶稣说：「<red>我们不知道。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”</red>
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered and said to Jesus, "We do not know." And Jesus answered and said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNasb: Answering Jesus, they *said, "We do not know." And Jesus *said to them, "Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEn: So they answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说："<red>有一个人栽种了一个葡萄园，四面围上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座瞭望台，然后租给佃户，就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说："<red>有一个人栽种了一个葡萄园，四面围上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座瞭望台，然后租给佃户，就远行去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就用比喻对他们说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: <red>“A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he began to speak to them in parables. "A man planted a vineyard and put a fence around it and dug a pit for the winepress and built a tower, and leased it to tenants and went into another country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard and set a hedge around it, dug a place for the wine vat and built a tower. And he leased it to vinedressers and went into a far country.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus began teaching them with stories: "A man planted a vineyard. He built a wall around it, dug a pit for pressing out the grape juice, and built a lookout tower. Then he leased the vineyard to tenant farmers and moved to another country.
verses.textEnNasb: And He began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard and put a fence around it, and dug a vat under the wine press and built a tower, and leased it to vine-growers and went on a journey.
verses.textEn: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: <red>“A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了时候，园主派了一个仆人到佃户那里，向佃户收取葡萄园一部分的果子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了时候，园主派了一个仆人到佃户那里，向佃户收取葡萄园一部分的果子。</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When the season came, he sent a servant to the tenants to get from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that he might receive some of the fruit of the vineyard from the vinedressers.
verses.textEnNlt: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent one of his servants to collect his share of the crop.
verses.textEnNasb: And at the harvest time he sent a slave to the vine-growers, in order to receive his share of the produce of the vineyard from the vine-growers.

verses.textZh: <red>佃户抓住他，打了他，放他空手回去。</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they took him and beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took him and beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: But the farmers grabbed the servant, beat him up, and sent him back empty-handed.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Again he sent to them another servant, and they struck him on the head and treated him shamefully.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again he sent them another servant, and at him they threw stones, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
verses.textEnNlt: The owner then sent another servant, but they insulted him and beat him over the head.
verses.textEnNasb: And again he sent them another slave, and they wounded him in the head, and treated him shamefully.
verses.textEn: <red>Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>园主又派另一个去，他们就把他杀了。后来又派去许多仆人，有的给他们打了，有的给他们杀了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>园主又派另一个去，他们就把他杀了。后来又派去许多仆人，有的给他们打了，有的给他们杀了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又打发一个仆人去，他们就杀了他。后又打发好些仆人去，有被他们打的，有被他们杀的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent another, and him they killed. And so with many others: some they beat, and some they killed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And again he sent another, and him they killed; and many others, beating some and killing some.
verses.textEnNlt: The next servant he sent was killed. Others he sent were either beaten or killed,
verses.textEnNasb: And he sent another, and that one they killed; and so with many others, beating some and killing others.
verses.textEn: <red>He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>还有一个，就是园主的爱子，最后园主派他到那里去，说：‘他们必尊敬我的儿子。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>还有一个，就是园主的爱子，最后园主派他到那里去，说：‘他们必尊敬我的儿子。’</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hep had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He had still one other, a beloved son. Finally he sent him to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore still having one son, his beloved, he also sent him to them last, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNlt: until there was only one left—his son whom he loved dearly. The owner finally sent him, thinking, ‘Surely they will respect my son.’
verses.textEnNasb: He had one more man to send, a beloved son; he sent him to them last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Hep had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那些佃户却彼此说：‘这是继承产业的；来，我们杀了他，产业就是我们的了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那些佃户却彼此说：‘这是继承产业的；来，我们杀了他，产业就是我们的了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不料，那些园户彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，产业就归我们了！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But those tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But those vinedressers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But the tenant farmers said to one another, ‘Here comes the heir to this estate. Let’s kill him and get the estate for ourselves!’
verses.textEnNasb: But those vine-growers said to one another, ‘This is the heir; come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours!’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是抓住他，把他杀了，扔在葡萄园外。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是抓住他，把他杀了，扔在葡萄园外。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是拿住他，杀了他，把他丢在园外。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they took him and killed him and threw him out of the vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took him and killed him and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: So they grabbed him and murdered him and threw his body out of the vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
verses.textEn: <red>So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，葡萄园的主人要怎么办呢？他要来除掉那些佃户，把葡萄园租给别人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，葡萄园的主人要怎么办呢？他要来除掉那些佃户，把葡萄园租给别人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，葡萄园的主人要怎么办呢？他要来除灭那些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: What will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the tenants and give the vineyard to others.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the vinedressers, and give the vineyard to others.
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you suppose the owner of the vineyard will do?" Jesus asked. "I’ll tell you—he will come and kill those farmers and lease the vineyard to others.
verses.textEnNasb: What will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and put the vine-growers to death, and give the vineyard to others.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.</red>
