verses.textZh: 他们知道他这比喻是针对他们说的，就想要捉拿他，但因为害怕群众，只好离开他走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们知道他这比喻是针对他们说的，就想要捉拿他，但因为害怕群众，只好离开他走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看出这比喻是指着他们说的，就想要捉拿他，只是惧怕百姓，于是离开他走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were seeking to arrest him but feared the people, for they perceived that he had told the parable against them. So they left him and went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they sought to lay hands on Him, but feared the multitude, for they knew He had spoken the parable against them. So they left Him and went away.
verses.textEnNlt: The religious leaders wanted to arrest Jesus because they realized he was telling the story against them—they were the wicked farmers. But they were afraid of the crowd, so they left him and went away.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were seeking to seize Him, and yet they feared the people, for they understood that He told the parable against them. And so they left Him and went away.
verses.textEn: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.

verses.textZh: 后来，他们派了几个法利赛人和希律党的人到耶稣那里去，要找他的把柄来陷害他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，他们派了几个法利赛人和希律党的人到耶稣那里去，要找他的把柄来陷害他。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，他们打发几个法利赛人和几个希律党的人到耶稣那里，要就着他的话陷害他。
verses.textEnNiv: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent to him some of the Pharisees and some of the Herodians, to trap him in his talk.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sent to Him some of the Pharisees and the Herodians, to catch Him in His words.
verses.textEnNlt: Later the leaders sent some Pharisees and supporters of Herod to trap Jesus into saying something for which he could be arrested.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they *sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Him in order to trap Him in a statement.
verses.textEn: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.

verses.textZh: 他们来到了，就对他说："老师，我们知道你为人诚实，不顾忌任何人，因为你不徇情面，只照着真理把神的道教导人。请问纳税给凯撒可以不可以？我们该纳不该纳呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到了，就对他说："老师，我们知道你为人诚实，不顾忌任何人，因为你不徇情面，只照着真理把神的道教导人。请问纳税给凯撒可以不可以？我们该纳不该纳呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来了，就对他说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实的，什么人你都不徇情面；因为你不看人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传神的道。纳税给凯撒可以不可以？
verses.textEnNiv: They came to him and said, "Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?
verses.textEnEsv: And they came and said to him, "Teacher, we know that you are true and do not care about anyone’s opinion. For you are not swayed by appearances, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not? Should we pay them, or should we not?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had come, they said to Him, "Teacher, we know that You are true, and care about no one; for You do not regard the person of men, but teach the way of God in truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher," they said, "we know how honest you are. You are impartial and don’t play favorites. You teach the way of God truthfully. Now tell us—is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?
verses.textEnNasb: They came and *said to Him, "Teacher, we know that You are truthful and do not care what anyone thinks; for You are not partial to anyone, but You teach the way of God in truth. Is it permissible to pay a poll-tax to Caesar, or not?
verses.textEn: They came to him and said, "Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You aren’t swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?

verses.textZh: 耶稣看出他们的假意，就对他们说："<red>你们为甚么试探我呢？拿一个银币来给我，让我看看。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看出他们的假意，就对他们说："<red>你们为甚么试探我呢？拿一个银币来给我，让我看看。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们该纳不该纳？」耶稣知道他们的假意，就对他们说：「<red>你们为什么试探我？拿一个银钱来给我看！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. <red>“Why are you trying to trap me?”</red> he asked. <red>“Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But, knowing their hypocrisy, he said to them, "Why put me to the test? Bring me a denarius and let me look at it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall we pay, or shall we not pay?" But He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, "Why do you test Me? Bring Me a denarius that I may see it."
verses.textEnNlt: Should we pay them, or shouldn’t we?" Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, "Why are you trying to trap me? Show me a Roman coin, and I’ll tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: Are we to pay, or not pay?" But He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, "Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to look at."
verses.textEn: Should we pay or shouldn’t we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. <red>“Why are you trying to trap me?”</red> he asked. <red>“Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就拿来了。耶稣问他们："<red>这是谁的像，谁的名号？</red>"他们回答他："<red>凯撒的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就拿来了。耶稣问他们："<red>这是谁的像，谁的名号？</red>"他们回答他："<red>凯撒的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就拿了来。耶稣说：「<red>这像和这号是谁的？</red>」他们说：「<red>是凯撒的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the coin, and he asked them, <red>“Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”</red> “Caesar’s,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought one. And he said to them, "Whose likeness and inscription is this?" They said to him, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they brought it. And He said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?" They said to Him, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEnNlt: When they handed it to him, he asked, "Whose picture and title are stamped on it?" "Caesar’s," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought one. And He *said to them, "Whose image and inscription is this?" And they said to Him, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEn: They brought the coin, and he asked them, <red>“Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”</red> “Caesar’s,” they replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"他们就对他十分惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"他们就对他十分惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>凯撒的物当归给凯撒，神的物当归给神。</red>」他们就很希奇他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s.”</red> And they were amazed at him.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s." And they marveled at him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s." And they marveled at Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, then," Jesus said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God." His reply completely amazed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s." And they were utterly amazed at Him.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s and to God what is God’s.”</red> And they were amazed at him.

verses.textZh: 撒都该人向来认为没有复活的事，他们来到耶稣那里，问他：
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒都该人向来认为没有复活的事，他们来到耶稣那里，问他：
verses.textZhCuv: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。他们来问耶稣说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sadducees came to him, who say that there is no resurrection. And they asked him a question, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him; and they asked Him, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus was approached by some Sadducees—religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead. They posed this question:
verses.textEnNasb: Some Sadducees (who say that there is no resurrection) *came to Jesus, and began questioning Him, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

verses.textZh: "老师，摩西曾写给我们说：‘如果一个人死了，留下妻子，没有儿女，他的弟弟就应当娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "老师，摩西曾写给我们说：‘如果一个人死了，留下妻子，没有儿女，他的弟弟就应当娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「夫子，摩西为我们写着说：『人若死了，撇下妻子，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife, but leaves no child, the man must take the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies, and leaves his wife behind, and leaves no children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher, Moses gave us a law that if a man dies, leaving a wife without children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother’s name.
verses.textEnNasb: "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves behind a wife and does not leave a child, his brother is to marry the wife and raise up children for his brother.
verses.textEn: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.

verses.textZh: 从前有兄弟七人，头一个娶了妻子，死了，没有留下孩子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前有兄弟七人，头一个娶了妻子，死了，没有留下孩子；
verses.textZhCuv: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有留下孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.
verses.textEnEsv: There were seven brothers; the first took a wife, and when he died left no offspring.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were seven brothers. The first took a wife; and dying, he left no offspring.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children.
verses.textEnNasb: There were seven brothers; and the first took a wife, and died leaving no children.
verses.textEn: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.

verses.textZh: 第二个娶了她，也没有留下孩子，就死了；第三个也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二个娶了她，也没有留下孩子，就死了；第三个也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二个娶了她，也死了，没有留下孩子。第三个也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.
verses.textEnEsv: And the second took her, and died, leaving no offspring. And the third likewise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the second took her, and he died; nor did he leave any offspring. And the third likewise.
verses.textEnNlt: So the second brother married the widow, but he also died without children. Then the third brother married her.
verses.textEnNasb: The second one married her, and died leaving behind no children; and the third likewise;
verses.textEn: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.

verses.textZh: 那七个人都没有留下孩子，最后那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那七个人都没有留下孩子，最后那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那七个人都没有留下孩子；末了，那妇人也死了。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.
verses.textEnEsv: And the seven left no offspring. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the seven had her and left no offspring. Last of all the woman died also.
verses.textEnNlt: This continued with all seven of them, and still there were no children. Last of all, the woman also died.
verses.textEnNasb: and so the seven together left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
verses.textEn: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.

verses.textZh: 到了复活的时候，他们都要复活，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为七个人都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了复活的时候，他们都要复活，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为七个人都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」
verses.textEnNiv: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"
verses.textEnEsv: In the resurrection, when they rise again, whose wife will she be? For the seven had her as wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be? For all seven had her as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her."
verses.textEnNasb: In the resurrection, which one’s wife will she be? For each of the seven had her as his wife."
verses.textEn: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们错了，不正是因为你们不明白圣经，也不晓得神的能力吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们错了，不正是因为你们不明白圣经，也不晓得神的能力吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们所以错了，岂不是因为不明白圣经，不晓得神的大能吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to them, "Is this not the reason you are wrong, because you know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Are you not therefore mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Your mistake is that you don’t know the Scriptures, and you don’t know the power of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "Is this not the reason you are mistaken, that you do not understand the Scriptures nor the power of God?
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为人从死里复活以后，也不娶，也不嫁，而是像天上的天使一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为人从死里复活以后，也不娶，也不嫁，而是像天上的天使一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人从死里复活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: For when the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. In this respect they will be like the angels in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>关于死人复活的事，摩西的经卷中荆棘篇上，神怎样对他说：‘我是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神’，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>关于死人复活的事，摩西的经卷中荆棘篇上，神怎样对他说：‘我是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神’，你们没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>论到死人复活，你们没有念过摩西的书荆棘篇上所载的吗？神对摩西说：『我是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the dead being raised, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.textEnNkjv: But concerning the dead, that they rise, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the burning bush passage, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘Iamthe God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.textEnNlt: "But now, as to whether the dead will be raised—haven’t you ever read about this in the writings of Moses, in the story of the burning bush? Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, God said to Moses, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.textEnNasb: But regarding the fact that the dead rise, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the burning bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
verses.textEn: <red>Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他不是死人的神，而是活人的神。你们是大错特错了！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他不是死人的神，而是活人的神。你们是大错特错了！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神不是死人的神，乃是活人的神。你们是大错了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He is not God of the dead, but of the living. You are quite wrong."
verses.textEnNkjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living. You are therefore greatly mistaken."
verses.textEnNlt: So he is the God of the living, not the dead. You have made a serious error."
verses.textEnNasb: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living; you are greatly mistaken."
verses.textEn: <red>He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个经学家，听到他们的辩论，觉得耶稣回答得好，就来问他："诫命中哪一条是第一重要的呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个经学家，听到他们的辩论，觉得耶稣回答得好，就来问他："诫命中哪一条是第一重要的呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个文士来，听见他们辩论，晓得耶稣回答的好，就问他说：「诫命中哪是第一要紧的呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"
verses.textEnEsv: And one of the scribes came up and heard them disputing with one another, and seeing that he answered them well, asked him, "Which commandment is the most important of all?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, perceiving that He had answered them well, asked Him, "Which is the first commandment of all?"
verses.textEnNlt: One of the teachers of religious law was standing there listening to the debate. He realized that Jesus had answered well, so he asked, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"
verses.textEnNasb: One of the scribes came up and heard them arguing, and recognizing that He had answered them well, asked Him, "What commandment is the foremost of all?"
verses.textEn: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣回答："第一重要的是：‘以色列啊，你要听！主我们的神是独一的主。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣回答："第一重要的是：‘以色列啊，你要听！主我们的神是独一的主。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「第一要紧的就是说：『以色列啊，你要听，主－我们神是独一的主。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep most important one,”</red> answered Jesus, <red>“is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "The most important is, ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered him, "The first of all the commandments is: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "The most important commandment is this: ‘Listen, O Israel! The Lord our God is the one and only Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus answered, "The foremost is, ‘Hear, Israel! The Lord is our God, the Lord is one;
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep most important one,”</red> answered Jesus, <red>“is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你要全心、全性、全意、全力，爱主你的神。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你要全心、全性、全意、全力，爱主你的神。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你要尽心、尽性、尽意、尽力爱主－你的神。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’This is the first commandment.
verses.textEnNlt: And you must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength.’
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’
verses.textEn: <red>Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>其次是：‘要爱人如己。’再没有别的诫命比这两条更重要的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>其次是：‘要爱人如己。’再没有别的诫命比这两条更重要的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>其次就是说：『要爱人如己。』再没有比这两条诫命更大的了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The second is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the second, like it, is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these."
verses.textEnNlt: The second is equally important: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these."
verses.textEnNasb: The second is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these."
verses.textEn: <red>The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那经学家对耶稣说："老师，是的，你说的很对，神是独一的，除了他以外再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那经学家对耶稣说："老师，是的，你说的很对，神是独一的，除了他以外再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那文士对耶稣说：「夫子说，神是一位，实在不错；除了他以外，再没有别的神；
verses.textEnNiv: "Well said, teacher," the man replied. "You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribe said to him, "You are right, Teacher. You have truly said that he is one, and there is no other besides him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the scribe said to Him, "Well said, Teacher. You have spoken the truth, for there is one God, and there is no other but He.
verses.textEnNlt: The teacher of religious law replied, "Well said, Teacher. You have spoken the truth by saying that there is only one God and no other.
verses.textEnNasb: And the scribe said to Him, "Well said, Teacher; You have truly stated that He is One, and there is no other besides Him;
verses.textEn: "Well said, teacher," the man replied. "You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.

verses.textZh: 我们要用全心、全意、全力去爱他，并且要爱人如己，这就比一切燔祭和各样祭物好得多了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要用全心、全意、全力去爱他，并且要爱人如己，这就比一切燔祭和各样祭物好得多了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且尽心、尽智、尽力爱他，又爱人如己，就比一切燔祭和各样祭祀好的多。」
verses.textEnNiv: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices."
verses.textEnEsv: And to love him with all the heart and with all the understanding and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is much more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."
verses.textEnNkjv: And to love Him with all the heart, with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is more than all the whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."
verses.textEnNlt: And I know it is important to love him with all my heart and all my understanding and all my strength, and to love my neighbor as myself. This is more important than to offer all of the burnt offerings and sacrifices required in the law."
verses.textEnNasb: and to love Him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is much more than all the burnt offerings and sacrifices."
verses.textEn: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices."

verses.textZh: 耶稣见他回答得有智慧，就对他说："<red>你距离神的国不远了。</red>"从此再也没有人敢问他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣见他回答得有智慧，就对他说："<red>你距离神的国不远了。</red>"从此再也没有人敢问他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见他回答的有智慧，就对他说：「<red>你离神的国不远了。</red>」从此以后，没有人敢再问他什么。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, <red>“You are not far from the kingdom of God.”</red> And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." And after that no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对银库坐着，看众人怎样投钱入库。有好些财主往里投了若干的钱。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sat down opposite the treasury and watched the people putting money into the offering box. Many rich people put in large sums.

verses.textEn: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.

verses.textZh: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说："老师，请看，这是多么美好的石头！多么美好的建筑！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说："老师，请看，这是多么美好的石头！多么美好的建筑！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说：「夫子，请看，这是何等的石头！何等的殿宇！」
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!"
verses.textEnEsv: And as he came out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher, what wonderful stones and what wonderful buildings!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then as He went out of the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, "Teacher, see what manner of stones and what buildings arehere!"
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was leaving the Temple that day, one of his disciples said, "Teacher, look at these magnificent buildings! Look at the impressive stones in the walls."
verses.textEnNasb: As He was going out of the temple, one of His disciples *said to Him, "Teacher, look! What wonderful stones and what wonderful buildings!"
verses.textEn: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："你看见这些伟大的建筑吗？将来必没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，每一块都要拆下来。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："你看见这些伟大的建筑吗？将来必没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，每一块都要拆下来。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>你看见这大殿宇吗？将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop you see all these great buildings?”</red> replied Jesus. <red>“Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone shall be left upon another, that shall not be thrown down."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Yes, look at these great buildings. But they will be completely demolished. Not one stone will be left on top of another!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left upon another, which will not be torn down."
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop you see all these great buildings?”</red> replied Jesus. <red>“Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”</red>

verses.textZh: "请告诉我们，甚么时候会有这些事呢？这一切事将要成就的时候有甚么预兆呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "请告诉我们，甚么时候会有这些事呢？这一切事将要成就的时候有甚么预兆呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事呢？这一切事将成的时候有什么预兆呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Tell us, when will these things be, and what will be the sign when all these things are about to be accomplished?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Tell us, when will these things be? And what willbe the sign when all these things will be fulfilled?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell us, when will all this happen? What sign will show us that these things are about to be fulfilled?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell us, when will these things come about, and what will be the sign when all these things are going to be fulfilled?"
verses.textEn: "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣就告诉他们说："<red>你们要小心，不要被人迷惑。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就告诉他们说："<red>你们要小心，不要被人迷惑。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them: <red>“Watch out that no one deceives you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus began to say to them, "See that no one leads you astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, answering them, began to say: "Take heed that no one deceives you.

verses.textZhCuv: <red>将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是基督』，并且要迷惑许多人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
verses.textEnNlt: for many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah.’ They will deceive many.

verses.textEn: <red>Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们听见战争和战争的风声，也不要惊慌，这是免不了的，不过，结局还没有到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们听见战争和战争的风声，也不要惊慌，这是免不了的，不过，结局还没有到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们听见打仗和打仗的风声，不要惊慌。这些事是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. This must take place, but the end is not yet.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be troubled; for such things must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.textEnNlt: And you will hear of wars and threats of wars, but don’t panic. Yes, these things must take place, but the end won’t follow immediately.
verses.textEnNasb: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed; those things must take place; but that is not yet the end.
verses.textEn: <red>When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一个民族要起来攻打另一个民族，一个国家要起来攻打另一个国家，到处要有地震，有饥荒，这些不过是痛苦的开始。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一个民族要起来攻打另一个民族，一个国家要起来攻打另一个国家，到处要有地震，有饥荒，这些不过是痛苦的开始。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有地震、饥荒。这都是灾难 的起头。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These are but the beginning of the birth pains.
verses.textEnNkjv: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. And there will be earthquakes in various places, and there will be famines and troubles. These are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.textEnNlt: Nation will go to war against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in many parts of the world, as well as famines. But this is only the first of the birth pains, with more to come.
verses.textEnNasb: For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in various places; there will also be famines. These things are only the beginning of birth pains.
verses.textEn: <red>Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你们要小心！因为人要把你们交给公议会，你们要在会堂里被鞭打，又要为我的缘故站在总督和君王面前，向他们作见证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你们要小心！因为人要把你们交给公议会，你们要在会堂里被鞭打，又要为我的缘故站在总督和君王面前，向他们作见证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你们要谨慎；因为人要把你们交给公会，并且你们在会堂里要受鞭打，又为我的缘故站在诸侯与君王面前，对他们作见证。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But be on your guard. For they will deliver you over to councils, and you will be beaten in synagogues, and you will stand before governors and kings for my sake, to bear witness before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But watch out for yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils, and you will be beaten in the synagogues. You will be brought before rulers and kings for My sake, for a testimony to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "When these things begin to happen, watch out! You will be handed over to the local councils and beaten in the synagogues. You will stand trial before governors and kings because you are my followers. But this will be your opportunity to tell them about me.
verses.textEnNasb: "But be on your guard; for they will hand you over to the courts, and you will be flogged in the synagogues, and you will stand before governors and kings for My sake, as a testimony to them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而福音必须先传给万民。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而福音必须先传给万民。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，福音必须先传给万民。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gospel must first be preached to all the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Good News must first be preached to all nations.
verses.textEnNasb: And the gospel must first be preached to all the nations.
verses.textEn: <red>And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人把你们捉去送官的时候，用不着预先思虑要说甚么，到那时候赐给你们甚么话，你们就说甚么，因为说话的不是你们，而是圣灵。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人把你们捉去送官的时候，用不着预先思虑要说甚么，到那时候赐给你们甚么话，你们就说甚么，因为说话的不是你们，而是圣灵。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人把你们拉去交官的时候，不要预先思虑说什么；到那时候，赐给你们什么话，你们就说什么；因为说话的不是你们，乃是圣灵。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when they bring you to trial and deliver you over, do not be anxious beforehand what you are to say, but say whatever is given you in that hour, for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they arrest you and deliver you up, do not worry beforehand, or premeditate what you will speak. But whatever is given you in that hour, speak that; for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you are arrested and stand trial, don’t worry in advance about what to say. Just say what God tells you at that time, for it is not you who will be speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand about what you are to say, but say whatever is given you at that time; for you are not the ones speaking, but it is the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: <red>Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>弟兄要出卖弟兄，父亲要出卖儿子，甚至把他们置于死地；儿女要悖逆父母，害死他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>弟兄要出卖弟兄，父亲要出卖儿子，甚至把他们置于死地；儿女要悖逆父母，害死他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地；儿女要起来与父母为敌，害死他们；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Brotherp will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And brother will deliver brother over to death, and the father his child, and children will rise against parents and have them put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; and children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "A brother will betray his brother to death, a father will betray his own child, and children will rebel against their parents and cause them to be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: And brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; and children will rise up against parents and have them put to death.
verses.textEn: <red>“Brotherp will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们为我的名，要被众人恨恶，然而坚忍到底的必然得救。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们为我的名，要被众人恨恶，然而坚忍到底的必然得救。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并且你们要为我的名被众人恨恶。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you will be hated by all for my name’s sake. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will be hated by all for My name’s sake. But he who endures to the end shall be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: And everyone will hate you because you are my followers. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name, but it is the one who has endured to the end who will be saved.
verses.textEn: <red>Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"当你们看见‘那造成荒凉的可憎者’，站在不该站的地方 ，那时，住在犹太的应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"当你们看见‘那造成荒凉的可憎者’，站在不该站的地方 ，那时，住在犹太的应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们看见那行毁坏可憎的，站在不当站的地方（读这经的人须要会意）。那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’ standing where it does not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But when you see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not to be ( let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So when you see the ‘abomination of desolation,’spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not" (let the reader understand), "then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is coming when you will see the sacrilegious object that causes desecration standing where he should not be." (Reader, pay attention!) "Then those in Judea must flee to the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be— let the reader understand—then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’ standing where it does not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在房顶的不要下来，也不要进到屋子里拿甚么东西；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在房顶的不要下来，也不要进到屋子里拿甚么东西；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在房上的，不要下来，也不要进去拿家里的东西；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Let the one who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter his house, to take anything out,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him who is on the housetop not go down into the house, nor enter to take anything out of his house.
verses.textEnNlt: A person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever is on the housetop must not go down, nor go in to get anything out of his house.
verses.textEn: <red>Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在田里的也不要回去取衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在田里的也不要回去取衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and let the one who is in the field not turn back to take his cloak.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let him who is in the field not go back to get his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: A person out in the field must not return even to get a coat.
verses.textEnNasb: And whoever is in the field must not turn back to get his cloak.
verses.textEn: <red>Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And alas for women who are pregnant and for those who are nursing infants in those days!
verses.textEnNkjv: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days!
verses.textEnNlt: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days.
verses.textEnNasb: But woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days!
verses.textEn: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应当祈求，不要让这些事在冬天发生。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应当祈求，不要让这些事在冬天发生。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们应当祈求，叫这些事不在冬天临到。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Pray that this will not take place in winter,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Pray that it may not happen in winter.
verses.textEnNkjv: And pray that your flight may not be in winter.
verses.textEnNlt: And pray that your flight will not be in winter.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, pray that it will not happen in winter.
verses.textEn: <red>Pray that this will not take place in winter,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为那些日子必有灾难，这是从神创世的开始到现在未曾有过的，以后也必不会再有。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为那些日子必有灾难，这是从神创世的开始到现在未曾有过的，以后也必不会再有。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为在那些日子必有灾难，自从神创造万物直到如今，并没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For in those days there will be such tribulation as has not been from the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in those days there will be tribulation, such as has not been since the beginning of the creation which God created until this time, nor ever shall be.
verses.textEnNlt: For there will be greater anguish in those days than at any time since God created the world. And it will never be so great again.
verses.textEnNasb: For those days will be such a time of tribulation as has not occurred since the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will again.
verses.textEn: <red>because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果不是主减少那些日子，没有一个人可以存活；但是为了自己的选民，他必使那些日子减少。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果不是主减少那些日子，没有一个人可以存活；但是为了自己的选民，他必使那些日子减少。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若不是主减少那日子，凡有血气的，总没有一个得救的；只是为主的选民，他将那日子减少了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ifp the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if the Lord had not cut short the days, no human being would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he shortened the days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And unless the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh would be saved; but for the elect’s sake, whom He chose, He shortened the days.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, unless the Lord shortens that time of calamity, not a single person will survive. But for the sake of his chosen ones he has shortened those days.
verses.textEnNasb: And if the Lord had not shortened those days, no life would have been saved; but for the sake of the elect, whom He chose, He shortened the days.
verses.textEn: <red>“Ifp the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，如果有人对你们说：‘看哪，基督在这里！看哪，他在那里！’你们不要信。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，如果有人对你们说：‘看哪，基督在这里！看哪，他在那里！’你们不要信。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, He is there!’ do not believe it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah,’ or ‘There he is,’ don’t believe it.
verses.textEnNasb: And then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ’; or, ‘Look, there He is’; do not believe it;
verses.textEn: <red>At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为必有假基督和假先知出现，行神迹和奇事，如果可以的话，连选民也要迷惑了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为必有假基督和假先知出现，行神迹和奇事，如果可以的话，连选民也要迷惑了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显神迹奇事，倘若能行，就把选民迷惑了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For false christs and false prophets will arise and perform signs and wonders, to lead astray, if possible, the elect.
verses.textEnNkjv: For false christs and false prophets will rise and show signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
verses.textEnNlt: For false messiahs and false prophets will rise up and perform signs and wonders so as to deceive, if possible, even God’s chosen ones.
verses.textEnNasb: for false christs and false prophets will arise, and will provide signs and wonders, in order to mislead, if possible, the elect.
verses.textEn: <red>For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们应当小心！我已经事先把一切都告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们应当小心！我已经事先把一切都告诉你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要谨慎。看哪，凡事我都预先告诉你们了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But be on guard; I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But take heed; see, I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch out! I have warned you about this ahead of time!
verses.textEnNasb: But beware; I have told you everything in advance.
verses.textEn: <red>So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"当那些日子，在那灾难以后， 太阳就变黑了， 月亮也不发光，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"当那些日子，在那灾难以后， 太阳就变黑了， 月亮也不发光，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「在那些日子，那灾难以后， 日头要变黑了， 月亮也不放光，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp in those days, following that distress, “ ‘thepn sun will be darkened, andld the moon will not give its light;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time, after the anguish of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will give no light,
verses.textEnNasb: "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light,
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp in those days, following that distress, “ ‘thepn sun will be darkened, andld the moon will not give its light;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>众星从天坠落， 天上的万象震动。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>众星从天坠落， 天上的万象震动。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>theln stars will fall from the sky, andld the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: the stars of heaven will fall, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNlt: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: and the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEn: <red>theln stars will fall from the sky, andld the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，他们要看见人子，满有能力和荣耀，驾着云降临；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，他们要看见人子，满有能力和荣耀，驾着云降临；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，他们 要看见人子有大能力、大荣耀，驾云降临。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Atp that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.textEnNasb: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.textEn: <red>“Atp that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他要差派天使，把他的选民从四方，从地极直到天边，都招聚来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他要差派天使，把他的选民从四方，从地极直到天边，都招聚来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他要差遣天使，把他的选民，从四方 ，从地极直到天边，都招聚了来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then he will send out the angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And then He will send His angels, and gather together His elect from the four winds, from the farthest part of earth to the farthest part of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: And he will send out his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the world —from the farthest ends of the earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: And then He will send forth the angels, and will gather together His elect from the four winds, from the end of the earth to the end of heaven.
verses.textEn: <red>And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们应该从无花果树学个功课：树枝发出嫩芽长出叶子的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们应该从无花果树学个功课：树枝发出嫩芽长出叶子的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nowp learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now learn this parable from the fig tree: When its branch has already become tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now learn a lesson from the fig tree. When its branches bud and its leaves begin to sprout, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch has become tender and sprouts its leaves, you know that summer is near.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nowp learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>同样，你们甚么时候看见这些事发生，就知道他已经近在门口了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>同样，你们甚么时候看见这些事发生，就知道他已经近在门口了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，你们几时看见这些事成就，也该知道人子 近了，正在门口了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also, when you see these things taking place, you know that he is near, at the very gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you also, when you see these things happening, know that it is near—at the doors!
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, when you see all these things taking place, you can know that his return is very near, right at the door.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, when you see these things happening, recognize that He is near, right at the door.
verses.textEn: <red>Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必会发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必会发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all these things take place.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene before all these things take place.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>天地都要过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>天地都要过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
verses.textEnNlt: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.
verses.textEn: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"至于那日子和时间，没有人知道，连天上的天使和子也不知道，只有父知道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"至于那日子和时间，没有人知道，连天上的天使和子也不知道，只有父知道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But concerning that day or that hour, no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But of that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, no one knows the day or hour when these things will happen, not even the angels in heaven or the Son himself. Only the Father knows.
verses.textEnNasb: But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but the Father alone.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要小心，要警醒，因为你们不知道那日期甚么时候来到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要小心，要警醒，因为你们不知道那日期甚么时候来到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要谨慎，警醒祈祷，因为你们不晓得那日期几时来到。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Be on guard, keep awake. For you do not know when the time will come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed, watch and pray; for you do not know when the time is.
verses.textEnNlt: And since you don’t know when that time will come, be on guard! Stay alert !
verses.textEnNasb: "Watch out, stay alert; for you do not know when the appointed time is.
verses.textEn: <red>Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这就像一个人出外远行，把责任 一一地交给他的仆人，又吩咐看门的要警醒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这就像一个人出外远行，把责任 一一地交给他的仆人，又吩咐看门的要警醒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这事正如一个人离开本家，寄居外邦，把权柄交给仆人，分派各人当做的工，又吩咐看门的警醒。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It’s like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is like a man going on a journey, when he leaves home and puts his servants in charge, each with his work, and commands the doorkeeper to stay awake.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is like a man going to a far country, who left his house and gave authority to his servants, and to each his work, and commanded the doorkeeper to watch.
verses.textEnNlt: "The coming of the Son of Man can be illustrated by the story of a man going on a long trip. When he left home, he gave each of his slaves instructions about the work they were to do, and he told the gatekeeper to watch for his return.
verses.textEnNasb: It is like a man away on a journey, who upon leaving his house and putting his slaves in charge, assigning to each one his task, also commanded the doorkeeper to stay alert.
verses.textEn: <red>It’s like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们要警醒，因为你们不知道家主甚么时候来到，也许在黄昏，也许在半夜，也许在鸡叫时，也许在清晨。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们要警醒，因为你们不知道家主甚么时候来到，也许在黄昏，也许在半夜，也许在鸡叫时，也许在清晨。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们要警醒；因为你们不知道家主什么时候来，或晚上，或半夜，或鸡叫，或早晨；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thereforep keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore stay awake—for you do not know when the master of the house will come, in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning—
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch therefore, for you do not know when the master of the house is coming—in the evening, at midnight, at the crowing of the rooster, or in the morning—
verses.textEnNlt: You, too, must keep watch! For you don’t know when the master of the household will return—in the evening, at midnight, before dawn, or at daybreak.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, stay alert—for you do not know when the master of the house is coming, whether in the evening, at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning—
verses.textEn: <red>“Thereforep keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>恐怕他忽然来到，发现你们正在睡觉。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>恐怕他忽然来到，发现你们正在睡觉。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>恐怕他忽然来到，看见你们睡着了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: lest he come suddenly and find you asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest, coming suddenly, he find you sleeping.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let him find you sleeping when he arrives without warning.
verses.textEnNasb: so that he does not come suddenly and find you asleep.
verses.textEn: <red>If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说的，‘你们要警醒’。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说的，‘你们要警醒’。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说：要警醒！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And what I say to you I say to all: Stay awake."
verses.textEnNkjv: And what I say to you, I say to all: Watch!"
verses.textEnNlt: I say to you what I say to everyone: Watch for him!"
verses.textEnNasb: What I say to you I say to all: ‘Stay alert!’ "
verses.textEn: <red>What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 过两天，就是逾越节和除酵节了，祭司长和经学家设法怎样用诡计逮捕耶稣，把他杀害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过两天，就是逾越节和除酵节了，祭司长和经学家设法怎样用诡计逮捕耶稣，把他杀害。
verses.textZhCuv: 过两天是逾越节，又是除酵节，祭司长和文士想法子怎么用诡计捉拿耶稣，杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread. And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to arrest him by stealth and kill him,
verses.textEnNkjv: After two days it was the Passover and theFeast of Unleavened Bread. And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take Him by trickery and put Him to death.
verses.textEnNlt: It was now two days before Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread. The leading priests and the teachers of religious law were still looking for an opportunity to capture Jesus secretly and kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Passover and Festival of Unleavened Bread were two days away; and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to arrest Him covertly and kill Him;
verses.textEn: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.

verses.textZh: 不过他们说："不可在节期下手，免得引起民众暴动。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过他们说："不可在节期下手，免得引起民众暴动。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是说：「当节的日子不可，恐怕百姓生乱。」
verses.textEnNiv: "But not during the festival," they said, "or the people may riot."
verses.textEnEsv: for they said, "Not during the feast, lest there be an uproar from the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "Not during the feast, lest there be an uproar of the people."
verses.textEnNlt: "But not during the Passover celebration," they agreed, "or the people may riot."
verses.textEnNasb: for they were saying, "Not during the festival, otherwise there will be a riot of the people."
verses.textEn: "But not during the festival," they said, "or the people may riot."

verses.textZh: 耶稣在伯大尼，在患痲风的西门家里吃饭的时候，有一个女人来了，拿着一瓶珍贵的纯哪哒香膏。她打破了瓶，把香膏浇在耶稣的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣在伯大尼，在患痲风的西门家里吃饭的时候，有一个女人来了，拿着一瓶珍贵的纯哪哒香膏。她打破了瓶，把香膏浇在耶稣的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在伯大尼长大麻风的西门家里坐席的时候，有一个女人拿着一玉瓶至贵的真哪哒香膏来，打破玉瓶，把膏浇在耶稣的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: And while he was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he was reclining at table, a woman came with an alabaster flask of ointment of pure nard, very costly, and she broke the flask and poured it over his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: And being in Bethany at the house of Simon the leper, as He sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster flask of very costly oil of spikenard. Then she broke the flask and poured it on His head.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Jesus was in Bethany at the home of Simon, a man who had previously had leprosy. While he was eating, a woman came in with a beautiful alabaster jar of expensive perfume made from essence of nard. She broke open the jar and poured the perfume over his head.
verses.textEnNasb: While He was in Bethany at the home of Simon the Leper, He was reclining at the table, and a woman came with an alabaster vial of very expensive perfume of pure nard. She broke the vial and poured the perfume over His head.
verses.textEn: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.

verses.textZh: 有几个人很生气，彼此说："为甚么这样浪费香膏呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个人很生气，彼此说："为甚么这样浪费香膏呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个人心中很不喜悦，说：「何用这样枉费香膏呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?
verses.textEnEsv: There were some who said to themselves indignantly, "Why was the ointment wasted like that?
verses.textEnNkjv: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, and said, "Why was this fragrant oil wasted?
verses.textEnNlt: Some of those at the table were indignant. "Why waste such expensive perfume?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: But there were some indignantly remarking to one another, "Why has this perfume been wasted?
verses.textEn: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?

verses.textZh: 这香膏可以卖三百多个银币，用来赒济穷人。"他们就向她发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这香膏可以卖三百多个银币，用来赒济穷人。"他们就向她发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 这香膏可以卖三十多两银子周济穷人。」他们就向那女人生气。
verses.textEnNiv: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor." And they rebuked her harshly.
verses.textEnEsv: For this ointment could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor." And they scolded her.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor." And they criticized her sharply.
verses.textEnNlt: "It could have been sold for a year’s wages and the money given to the poor!" So they scolded her harshly.
verses.textEnNasb: For this perfume could have been sold for over three hundred denarii, and the money given to the poor." And they were scolding her.
verses.textEn: It could have been sold for more than a year’s wages and the money given to the poor." And they rebuked her harshly.

verses.textZh: <red>但耶稣说："由她吧！为甚么难为她呢？她在我身上作的是一件美事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但耶稣说："由她吧！为甚么难为她呢？她在我身上作的是一件美事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「由她吧！为什么难为她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Leavep her alone,”</red> said Jesus. <red>“Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said, "Let her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for Me.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "Leave her alone. Why criticize her for doing such a good thing to me?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone! Why are you bothering her? She has done a good deed for Me.
verses.textEn: <red>“Leavep her alone,”</red> said Jesus. <red>“Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们常常有穷人跟你们在一起，只要你们愿意，随时都可以向他们行善，然而你们却不常有我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们常常有穷人跟你们在一起，只要你们愿意，随时都可以向他们行善，然而你们却不常有我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为常有穷人和你们同在，要向他们行善随时都可以；只是你们不常有我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want, you can do good for them. But you will not always have me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have the poor with you always, and whenever you wish you may do them good; but Me you do not have always.
verses.textEnNlt: You will always have the poor among you, and you can help them whenever you want to. But you will not always have me.
verses.textEnNasb: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want, you can do good to them; but you do not always have Me.
verses.textEn: <red>The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>她已经尽她所能的作了。她预先用香膏膏了我的身体，是为了我的安葬。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>她已经尽她所能的作了。她预先用香膏膏了我的身体，是为了我的安葬。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>她所做的，是尽她所能的；她是为我安葬的事把香膏预先浇在我身上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: She has done what she could; she has anointed my body beforehand for burial.
verses.textEnNkjv: She has done what she could. She has come beforehand to anoint My body for burial.
verses.textEnNlt: She has done what she could and has anointed my body for burial ahead of time.
verses.textEnNasb: She has done what she could; she has anointed My body beforehand for the burial.
verses.textEn: <red>She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，福音无论传到世界上甚么地方，都要传讲这女人所作的来记念她。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，福音无论传到世界上甚么地方，都要传讲这女人所作的来记念她。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所做的，以为记念。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And truly, I say to you, wherever the gospel is proclaimed in the whole world, what she has done will be told in memory of her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, wherever this gospel is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be told as a memorial to her."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, wherever the Good News is preached throughout the world, this woman’s deed will be remembered and discussed."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, wherever the gospel is preached in the entire world, what this woman has done will also be told in memory of her."
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”</red>

verses.textZh: 十二门徒中的一个，就是加略人犹大，去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 十二门徒中的一个，就是加略人犹大，去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 十二门徒之中，有一个加略人犹大去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray him to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Him to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went to the leading priests to arrange to betray Jesus to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went off to the chief priests in order to betray Him to them.
verses.textEn: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

verses.textZh: 他们听见了就很欢喜，答应给他银子。于是犹大就找机会出卖耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见了就很欢喜，答应给他银子。于是犹大就找机会出卖耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见就欢喜，又应许给他银子；他就寻思如何得便把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they heard it, they were glad and promised to give him money. And he sought an opportunity to betray him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. So he sought how he might conveniently betray Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They were delighted when they heard why he had come, and they promised to give him money. So he began looking for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: They were delighted when they heard this, and promised to give him money. And he began seeking how to betray Him at an opportune time.
verses.textEn: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

verses.textZh: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰杀逾越节羊羔的那一天，门徒问耶稣："你要我们到哪里去，为你预备逾越节的晚餐呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰杀逾越节羊羔的那一天，门徒问耶稣："你要我们到哪里去，为你预备逾越节的晚餐呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰逾越羊羔的那一天，门徒对耶稣说：「你吃逾越节的筵席要我们往哪里去预备呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus’ disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"
verses.textEnEsv: And on the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they sacrificed the Passover lamb, his disciples said to him, "Where will you have us go and prepare for you to eat the Passover?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the first day of Unleavened Bread, when they killed the Passover lamb, His disciples said to Him, "Where do You want us to go and prepare, that You may eat the Passover?"
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb is sacrificed, Jesus’ disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go to prepare the Passover meal for you?"
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was being sacrificed, His disciples *said to Him, "Where do You want us to go and prepare for You to eat the Passover?"
verses.textEn: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus’ disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"
