verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们进城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, <red>“Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent two of his disciples and said to them, "Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He sent out two of His disciples and said to them, "Go into the city, and a man will meet you carrying a pitcher of water; follow him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus sent two of them into Jerusalem with these instructions: "As you go into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *sent two of His disciples and *said to them, "Go into the city, and a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him;
verses.textEn: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, <red>“Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论他进入哪一家，你们要对那家主说，老师说：‘我的客厅在哪里？我和门徒好在那里吃逾越节的晚餐。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论他进入哪一家，你们要对那家主说，老师说：‘我的客厅在哪里？我和门徒好在那里吃逾越节的晚餐。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他进哪家去，你们就对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越节的筵席。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and wherever he enters, say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever he goes in, say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, "Where is the guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: At the house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples?’
verses.textEnNasb: and wherever he enters, say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says, "Where is My guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
verses.textEn: <red>Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他必指给你们楼上一间布置整齐、预备妥当的大房间，你们就在那里为我们预备。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他必指给你们楼上一间布置整齐、预备妥当的大房间，你们就在那里为我们预备。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里为我们预备。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he will show you a large upper room furnished and ready; there prepare for us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he will show you a large upper room, furnished and prepared; there make ready for us."
verses.textEnNlt: He will take you upstairs to a large room that is already set up. That is where you should prepare our meal."
verses.textEnNasb: And he himself will show you a large upstairs room furnished and ready; prepare for us there."
verses.textEn: <red>He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的，就预备好了逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的，就预备好了逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。他们就预备了逾越节的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: And the disciples set out and went to the city and found it just as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: So His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found it just as He had said to them; and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: So the two disciples went into the city and found everything just as Jesus had said, and they prepared the Passover meal there.
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples left and came to the city, and found everything just as He had told them; and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEn: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二门徒来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二门徒来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒都来了。
verses.textEnNiv: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was evening, he came with the twelve.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the evening He came with the twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: In the evening Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
verses.textEnNasb: When it was evening He *came with the twelve.
verses.textEn: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.

verses.textZh: 他们坐着吃饭的时候，耶稣说："<red>我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个跟我一起吃饭的人要出卖我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们坐着吃饭的时候，耶稣说："<red>我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个跟我一起吃饭的人要出卖我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们坐席正吃的时候，耶稣说：「<red>我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个与我同吃的人要卖我了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, <red>“Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were reclining at table and eating, Jesus said, "Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me, one who is eating with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they sat and ate, Jesus said, "Assuredly, I say to you, one of you who eats with Me will betray Me."
verses.textEnNlt: As they were at the table eating, Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, one of you eating with me here will betray me."
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were reclining at the table and eating, Jesus said, "Truly I say to you that one of you will betray Me— one who is eating with Me."
verses.textEn: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, <red>“Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就很忧愁，一个一个地问他："是我吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就很忧愁，一个一个地问他："是我吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就忧愁起来，一个一个地问他说：「是我吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, "Surely you don’t mean me?"
verses.textEnEsv: They began to be sorrowful and to say to him one after another, "Is it I?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say to Him one by one, "Is it I?" And another said, "Is it I?"
verses.textEnNlt: Greatly distressed, each one asked in turn, "Am I the one?"
verses.textEnNasb: They began to be grieved and to say to Him one by one, "Surely not I?"
verses.textEn: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, "Surely you don’t mean me?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他们说："他是十二门徒里的一个，和我一同把手蘸在盘子里的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他们说："他是十二门徒里的一个，和我一同把手蘸在盘子里的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「是十二个门徒中同我蘸手在盘子里的那个人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Itp is one of the Twelve,”</red> he replied, <red>“one who dips bread into the bowl with me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "It is one of the twelve, one who is dipping bread into the dish with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them, "It is one of the twelve, who dips with Me in the dish.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "It is one of you twelve who is eating from this bowl with me.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "It is one of the twelve, the one who dips bread with Me in the bowl.
verses.textEn: <red>“Itp is one of the Twelve,”</red> he replied, <red>“one who dips bread into the bowl with me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如经上指着人子所说的，他固然要离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！他没有生下来还好。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如经上指着人子所说的，他固然要离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！他没有生下来还好。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子必要去世，正如经上指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of Man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Son of Man indeed goes just as it is written of Him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had never been born."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Son of Man must die, as the Scriptures declared long ago. But how terrible it will be for the one who betrays him. It would be far better for that man if he had never been born!"
verses.textEnNasb: For the Son of Man is going away just as it is written about Him; but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good for that man if he had not been born."
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给门徒，说："<red>你们拿去吃吧，这是我的身体。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给门徒，说："<red>你们拿去吃吧，这是我的身体。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝了福，就擘开，递给他们，说：「<red>你们拿着吃，这是我的身体</red>」；
verses.textEnNiv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, <red>“Take it; this is my body.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were eating, he took bread, and after blessing it broke it and gave it to them, and said, "Take; this is my body."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them and said, "Take, eat; this is My body."
verses.textEnNlt: As they were eating, Jesus took some bread and blessed it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "Take it, for this is my body."
verses.textEnNasb: While they were eating, He took some bread, and after a blessing He broke it, and gave it to them, and said, "Take it; this is My body."
verses.textEn: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, <red>“Take it; this is my body.”</red>

verses.textZh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了就递给门徒，他们都喝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了就递给门徒，他们都喝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们；他们都喝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks he gave it to them, and they all drank of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the cup, and when He had given thanks He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
verses.textEnNlt: And he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
verses.textEn: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："这是我的血，是为立约的，为许多人流出来的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："这是我的血，是为立约的，为许多人流出来的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「这是我立约的血，为多人流出来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thisp is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,”</red> he said to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "This is My blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many.
verses.textEnNlt: And he said to them, "This is my blood, which confirms the covenant between God and his people. It is poured out as a sacrifice for many.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "This is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thisp is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,”</red> he said to them.

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，我决不再喝这葡萄酒，直到我在神的国里喝新酒的那一天。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，我决不再喝这葡萄酒，直到我在神的国里喝新酒的那一天。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在神的国里喝新的那日子。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, I will not drink wine again until the day I drink it new in the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine again, until that day when I drink it, new, in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: <red>“Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们唱完了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们唱完了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们唱了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNasb: And after singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEn: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to them, "You will all fall away, because it is written: ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

verses.textZh: <red>但我复活以后，要比你们先到加利利去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我复活以后，要比你们先到加利利去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Butp after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”</red>

verses.textEnNasb: But after I am raised, I will go ahead of you to Galilee."
verses.textEn: <red>Butp after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："就算所有的人都后退，我却不会。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："就算所有的人都后退，我却不会。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「众人虽然跌倒，我总不能。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter declared, "Even if all fall away, I will not."
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said to him, "Even though they all fall away, I will not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter said to Him, "Even if all are made to stumble, yet I will not be."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter said to him, "Even if everyone else deserts you, I never will."
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said to Him, "Even if they all fall away, yet I will not!"
verses.textEn: Peter declared, "Even if all fall away, I will not."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，就在今天晚上，鸡叫两遍以前，你会三次不认我。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，就在今天晚上，鸡叫两遍以前，你会三次不认我。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>我实在告诉你，就在今天夜里，鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Truly, I tell you, this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you that today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, Peter—this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny three times that you even know me."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus *said to him, "Truly I say to you, that this very night, before a rooster crows twice, you yourself will deny Me three times."
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus answered, <red>“today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得更坚决地说："就算必须与你一同死，我也决不会不认你！"众人也都这样说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得更坚决地说："就算必须与你一同死，我也决不会不认你！"众人也都这样说。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却极力地说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。
verses.textEnNiv: But Peter insisted emphatically, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the others said the same.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said emphatically, "If I must die with you, I will not deny you." And they all said the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he spoke more vehemently, "If I have to die with You, I will not deny You!" And they all said likewise.
verses.textEnNlt: "No!" Peter declared emphatically. "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you!" And all the others vowed the same.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter repeatedly said insistently, "Even if I have to die with You, I will not deny You!" And they all were saying the same thing as well.
verses.textEn: But Peter insisted emphatically, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the others said the same.

verses.textZh: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼；耶稣对门徒说："<red>你们坐在这里，我去祷告。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼；耶稣对门徒说："<red>你们坐在这里，我去祷告。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼。耶稣对门徒说：「<red>你们坐在这里，等我祷告。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Sit here while I pray.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they went to a place called Gethsemane. And he said to his disciples, "Sit here while I pray."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to a place which was named Gethsemane; and He said to His disciples, "Sit here while I pray."
verses.textEnNlt: They went to the olive grove called Gethsemane, and Jesus said, "Sit here while I go and pray."
verses.textEnNasb: They *came to a place named Gethsemane; and He *said to His disciples, "Sit here until I have prayed."
verses.textEn: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Sit here while I pray.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他带了彼得、雅各、约翰一起去，就惊惧起来，非常难过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带了彼得、雅各、约翰一起去，就惊惧起来，非常难过。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是带着彼得、雅各、约翰同去，就惊恐起来，极其难过，
verses.textEnNiv: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly distressed and troubled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took Peter, James, and John with Him, and He began to be troubled and deeply distressed.
verses.textEnNlt: He took Peter, James, and John with him, and he became deeply troubled and distressed.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *took with Him Peter, James, and John, and began to be very distressed and troubled.
verses.textEn: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.

verses.textZh: <red>于是对他们说："我的心灵痛苦得快要死了；你们要留在这里，也要警醒。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是对他们说："我的心灵痛苦得快要死了；你们要留在这里，也要警醒。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「<red>我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，警醒。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,”</red> he said to them. <red>“Stay here and keep watch.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "My soul is very sorrowful, even to death. Remain here and watch."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "My soul is crushed with grief to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."
verses.textEnNasb: And He *said to them, "My soul is deeply grieved, to the point of death; remain here and keep watch."
verses.textEn: <red>“My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,”</red> he said to them. <red>“Stay here and keep watch.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣稍往前走，俯伏在地上祷告：如果可能的话，使那时刻不要临到他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣稍往前走，俯伏在地上祷告：如果可能的话，使那时刻不要临到他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「倘若可行，便叫那时候过去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.
verses.textEnEsv: And going a little farther, he fell on the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He went a little farther, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass from Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He went on a little farther and fell to the ground. He prayed that, if it were possible, the awful hour awaiting him might pass him by.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went a little beyond them, and fell to the ground and began praying that if it were possible, the hour might pass Him by.
verses.textEn: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>阿爸、父啊，你凡事都能作，求你叫这杯离开我。但不要照我的意思，只要照你的旨意。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>阿爸、父啊，你凡事都能作，求你叫这杯离开我。但不要照我的意思，只要照你的旨意。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「<red>阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你将这杯撤去。然而，不要从我的意思，只要从你的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “Abba,*ir <red>Father,”</red> he said, <red>“everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible for you. Remove this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible for You. Take this cup away from Me; nevertheless, not what I will, but what You will."
verses.textEnNlt: "Abba, Father," he cried out, "everything is possible for you. Please take this cup of suffering away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying, "Abba! Father! All things are possible for You; remove this cup from Me; yet not what I will, but what You will."
verses.textEn: “Abba,*ir <red>Father,”</red> he said, <red>“everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣回来，看见门徒睡着了，就对彼得说："<red>西门，你睡觉吗？你连一个小时也不能警醒吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回来，看见门徒睡着了，就对彼得说："<red>西门，你睡觉吗？你连一个小时也不能警醒吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回来，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「西门，你睡觉吗？不能警醒片时吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. <red>“Simon,”</red> he said to Peter, <red>“are you asleep? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he came and found them sleeping, and he said to Peter, "Simon, are you asleep? Could you not watch one hour?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, "Simon, are you sleeping? Could you not watch one hour?
verses.textEnNlt: Then he returned and found the disciples asleep. He said to Peter, "Simon, are you asleep? Couldn’t you watch with me even one hour?
verses.textEnNasb: And He *came and *found them sleeping, and *said to Peter, "Simon, are you asleep? Could you not keep watch for one hour?
verses.textEn: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. <red>“Simon,”</red> he said to Peter, <red>“are you asleep? Couldn’t you keep watch for one hour?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>应当警醒、祷告，免得陷入试探；你们心灵虽然愿意，肉体却是软弱的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>应当警醒、祷告，免得陷入试探；你们心灵虽然愿意，肉体却是软弱的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEnNlt: Keep watch and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak."
verses.textEnNasb: Keep watching and praying, so that you will not come into temptation; the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak."
verses.textEn: <red>Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又去祷告，说的也是同样的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又去祷告，说的也是同样的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又去祷告，说的话还是与先前一样，
verses.textEnNiv: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.
verses.textEnEsv: And again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again He went away and prayed, and spoke the same words.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus left them again and prayed the same prayer as before.
verses.textEnNasb: And again He went away and prayed, saying the same words.
verses.textEn: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.

verses.textZh: 他再回来的时候，看见门徒睡着了；因为他们十分疲倦，不知道该怎样回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再回来的时候，看见门徒睡着了；因为他们十分疲倦，不知道该怎样回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又来见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛甚是困倦；他们也不知道怎么回答。
verses.textEnNiv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And again he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they did not know what to answer him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He returned, He found them asleep again, for their eyes were heavy; and they did not know what to answer Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When he returned to them again, he found them sleeping, for they couldn’t keep their eyes open. And they didn’t know what to say.
verses.textEnNasb: And again He came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy; and they did not know what to say in reply to Him.
verses.textEn: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣第三次回来，对他们说："<red>你们还在睡觉休息吗？够了，时候到了，看哪，人子要被交在罪人手里了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣第三次回来，对他们说："<red>你们还在睡觉休息吗？够了，时候到了，看哪，人子要被交在罪人手里了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>第三次来，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧 ！够了，时候到了。看哪，人子被卖在罪人手里了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Returning the third time, he said to them, <red>“Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he came the third time and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and taking your rest? It is enough; the hour has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He came the third time and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? It is enough! The hour has come; behold, the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNlt: When he returned to them the third time, he said, "Go ahead and sleep. Have your rest. But no—the time has come. The Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: And He *came the third time, and *said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough. The hour has come; behold, the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.textEn: Returning the third time, he said to them, <red>“Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>起来，我们走吧！出卖我的人来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>起来，我们走吧！出卖我的人来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>起来！我们走吧。看哪，那卖我的人近了！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Rise, let us be going; see, my betrayer is at hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Rise, let us be going. See, My betrayer is at hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Up, let’s be going. Look, my betrayer is here!"
verses.textEnNasb: Get up, let’s go; behold, the one who is betraying Me is near!"
verses.textEn: <red>Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在说话的时候，十二门徒中的犹大和一群拿着刀棒的人来到了；他们是祭司长、经学家和长老派来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在说话的时候，十二门徒中的犹大和一群拿着刀棒的人来到了；他们是祭司长、经学家和长老派来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说话之间，忽然那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和文士并长老那里与他同来。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas came, one of the twelve, and with him a crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately, while He was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, with a great multitude with swords and clubs, came from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: And immediately, even as Jesus said this, Judas, one of the twelve disciples, arrived with a crowd of men armed with swords and clubs. They had been sent by the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately, while He was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, *came up, accompanied by a crowd with swords and clubs who were from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
verses.textEn: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.

verses.textZh: 出卖耶稣的人给他们一个暗号，说："我跟谁亲吻，谁就是他。你们把他逮捕，小心带去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 出卖耶稣的人给他们一个暗号，说："我跟谁亲吻，谁就是他。你们把他逮捕，小心带去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 卖耶稣的人曾给他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地带去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, "The one I will kiss is the man. Seize him and lead him away under guard."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now His betrayer had given them a signal, saying, "Whomever I kiss, He is the One; seize Him and lead Him away safely."
verses.textEnNlt: The traitor, Judas, had given them a prearranged signal: "You will know which one to arrest when I greet him with a kiss. Then you can take him away under guard."
verses.textEnNasb: Now he who was betraying Him had given them a signal, saying, "Whomever I kiss, He is the one; arrest Him and lead Him away under guard."
verses.textEn: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: "The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard."

verses.textZh: 犹大来到，立刻上前对耶稣说："拉比！"就跟他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大来到，立刻上前对耶稣说："拉比！"就跟他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大来了，随即到耶稣跟前，说：「拉比」，便与他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Rabbi!" and kissed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came, he went up to him at once and said, "Rabbi!" And he kissed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as he had come, immediately he went up to Him and said to Him, "Rabbi, Rabbi!" and kissed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as they arrived, Judas walked up to Jesus. "Rabbi!" he exclaimed, and gave him the kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: And after coming, Judas immediately went to Him and *said, "Rabbi!" and kissed Him.
verses.textEn: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Rabbi!" and kissed him.

verses.textZh: 他们就动手拿住耶稣，逮捕了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就动手拿住耶稣，逮捕了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就下手拿住他。
verses.textEnNiv: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they laid hands on him and seized him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they laid their hands on Him and took Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the others grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they laid hands on Him and arrested Him.
verses.textEn: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.

verses.textZh: 站在旁边的人中有一个拔出刀来，砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉了他的一只耳朵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在旁边的人中有一个拔出刀来，砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉了他的一只耳朵。
verses.textZhCuv: 旁边站着的人，有一个拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
verses.textEnEsv: But one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.textEnNlt: But one of the men with Jesus pulled out his sword and struck the high priest’s slave, slashing off his ear.
verses.textEnNasb: But one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his ear.
verses.textEn: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Amp I leading a rebellion,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs to capture me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to take Me?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked them, "Am I some dangerous revolutionary, that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me, as you would against a man inciting a revolt?
verses.textEn: <red>“Amp I leading a rebellion,”</red> said Jesus, <red>“that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我天天在殿里教导人，跟你们在一起，你们却没有捉拿我；但这是为了要应验经上的话。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我天天在殿里教导人，跟你们在一起，你们却没有捉拿我；但这是为了要应验经上的话。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我天天教训人，同你们在殿里，你们并没有拿我。但这事成就，为要应验经上的话。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Day after day I was with you in the temple teaching, and you did not seize me. But let the Scriptures be fulfilled."
verses.textEnNkjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you did not seize Me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled."
verses.textEnNlt: Why didn’t you arrest me in the Temple? I was there among you teaching every day. But these things are happening to fulfill what the Scriptures say about me."
verses.textEnNasb: Every day I was with you within the temple grounds teaching, and you did not arrest Me; but this has taken place so that the Scriptures will be fulfilled."
verses.textEn: <red>Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒都离开他逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒都离开他逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒都离开他，逃走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then everyone deserted him and fled.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all left him and fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they all forsook Him and fled.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all his disciples deserted him and ran away.
verses.textEnNasb: And His disciples all left Him and fled.
verses.textEn: Then everyone deserted him and fled.

verses.textZh: 有一个青年，赤身披着一块麻布，跟着耶稣。众人捉住他的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个青年，赤身披着一块麻布，跟着耶稣。众人捉住他的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个少年人，赤身披着一块麻布，跟随耶稣，众人就捉拿他。
verses.textEnNiv: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,
verses.textEnEsv: And a young man followed him, with nothing but a linen cloth about his body. And they seized him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain young man followed Him, having a linen cloth thrown around his naked body. And the young men laid hold of him,
verses.textEnNlt: One young man following behind was clothed only in a long linen shirt. When the mob tried to grab him,
verses.textEnNasb: A young man was following Him, wearing nothing but a linen sheet over his naked body; and they *seized him.
verses.textEn: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,

verses.textZh: 他就丢掉麻布，赤身逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就丢掉麻布，赤身逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却丢了麻布，赤身逃走了。
verses.textEnNiv: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.
verses.textEnEsv: but he left the linen cloth and ran away naked.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
verses.textEnNlt: he slipped out of his shirt and ran away naked.
verses.textEnNasb: But he pulled free of the linen sheet and escaped naked.
verses.textEn: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.

verses.textZh: 他们把耶稣押到大祭司那里，所有的祭司长、长老和经学家都聚集在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把耶稣押到大祭司那里，所有的祭司长、长老和经学家都聚集在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把耶稣带到大祭司那里，又有众祭司长和长老并文士都来和大祭司一同聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.
verses.textEnEsv: And they led Jesus to the high priest. And all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes came together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest; and with him were assembled all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes.
verses.textEnNlt: They took Jesus to the high priest’s home where the leading priests, the elders, and the teachers of religious law had gathered.
verses.textEnNasb: They led Jesus away to the high priest; and all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes *gathered together.
verses.textEn: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.

verses.textZh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的官邸，和差役一同坐着烤火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的官邸，和差役一同坐着烤火。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，一直进入大祭司的院里，和差役一同坐在火光里烤火。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter had followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he was sitting with the guards and warming himself at the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the servants and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Peter followed him at a distance and went right into the high priest’s courtyard. There he sat with the guards, warming himself by the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And Peter had followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest; and he was sitting with the officers and warming himself at the fire.
verses.textEn: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.

verses.textZh: 祭司长和公议会全体都寻找证据控告耶稣，要把他处死，却没有找着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和公议会全体都寻找证据控告耶稣，要把他处死，却没有找着。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和全公会寻找见证控告耶稣，要治死他，却寻不着。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the chief priests and the whole council were seeking testimony against Jesus to put him to death, but they found none.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the chief priests and all the council sought testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but found none.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside, the leading priests and the entire high council were trying to find evidence against Jesus, so they could put him to death. But they couldn’t find any.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the chief priests and the entire Council were trying to obtain testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, and they were not finding any.
verses.textEn: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.

verses.textZh: 有许多人作假证供控告他，但他们的证供各不相符。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多人作假证供控告他，但他们的证供各不相符。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有好些人作假见证告他，只是他们的见证各不相合。
verses.textEnNiv: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.
verses.textEnEsv: For many bore false witness against him, but their testimony did not agree.
verses.textEnNkjv: For many bore false witness against Him, but their testimonies did not agree.
verses.textEnNlt: Many false witnesses spoke against him, but they contradicted each other.
verses.textEnNasb: For many people were giving false testimony against Him, and so their testimonies were not consistent.
verses.textEn: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.

verses.textZh: 有几个人站起来，作假证供控告他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个人站起来，作假证供控告他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 又有几个人站起来作假见证告他，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:
verses.textEnEsv: And some stood up and bore false witness against him, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some rose up and bore false witness against Him, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, some men stood up and gave this false testimony:
verses.textEnNasb: And then some stood up and began giving false testimony against Him, saying,
verses.textEn: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:

verses.textZh: "我们听他说过：‘我要拆毁这座人手所造的圣所，三日之内要另建一座不是人手所造的圣所。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们听他说过：‘我要拆毁这座人手所造的圣所，三日之内要另建一座不是人手所造的圣所。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们听见他说：『我要拆毁这人手所造的殿，三日内就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another, not made with hands.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this Temple made with human hands, and in three days I will build another, made without human hands.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that was made by hands, and in three days I will build another, made without hands.’ "
verses.textEn: "We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ "

verses.textZh: 就是这样的见证，他们也不一致。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是这样的见证，他们也不一致。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就是这么作见证，也是各不相合。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet even about this their testimony did not agree.
verses.textEnNkjv: But not even then did their testimony agree.
verses.textEnNlt: But even then they didn’t get their stories straight!
verses.textEnNasb: And not even in this respect was their testimony consistent.
verses.textEn: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.

verses.textZh: 大祭司站起来，走到中间，问耶稣："这些人作证控告你的是甚么呢？你怎么不回答呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司站起来，走到中间，问耶稣："这些人作证控告你的是甚么呢？你怎么不回答呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司起来站在中间，问耶稣说：「你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the high priest stood up in the midst and asked Jesus, "Have you no answer to make? What is it that these men testify against you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst and asked Jesus, saying, "Do You answer nothing? What isit these men testify against You?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the high priest stood up before the others and asked Jesus, "Well, aren’t you going to answer these charges? What do you have to say for yourself?"
verses.textEnNasb: And then the high priest stood up and came forward and questioned Jesus, saying, "Do You not offer any answer for what these men are testifying against You?"
verses.textEn: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣却不作声，甚么也不回答。大祭司又问他："你是那受称颂者的儿子基督吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却不作声，甚么也不回答。大祭司又问他："你是那受称颂者的儿子基督吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却不言语，一句也不回答。大祭司又问他说：「你是那当称颂者的儿子基督不是？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"
verses.textEnEsv: But he remained silent and made no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He kept silent and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked Him, saying to Him, "Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus was silent and made no reply. Then the high priest asked him, "Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"
verses.textEnNasb: But He kept silent and did not offer any answer. Again the high priest was questioning Him, and *said to Him, "Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?"
verses.textEn: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："我是。你们要看见人子，坐在权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："我是。你们要看见人子，坐在权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我是。你们必看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip am,”</red> said Jesus. <red>“And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said, "I am, and you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said, "I am. And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, " I Am . And you will see the Son of Man seated in the place of power at God’s right hand and coming on the clouds of heaven. "
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said, "I am; and you shall see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming with the clouds of heaven."
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip am,”</red> said Jesus. <red>“And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 大祭司就撕开自己的衣服，说："我们还要甚么证人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司就撕开自己的衣服，说："我们还要甚么证人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说：「我们何必再用见证人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The high priest tore his clothes. "Why do we need any more witnesses?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And the high priest tore his garments and said, "What further witnesses do we need?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, "What further need do we have of witnesses?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the high priest tore his clothing to show his horror and said, "Why do we need other witnesses?
verses.textEnNasb: Tearing his clothes, the high priest *said, "What further need do we have of witnesses?
verses.textEn: The high priest tore his clothes. "Why do we need any more witnesses?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 你们都听见这亵渎的话了。你们认为怎么样？"众人都定他该死的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都听见这亵渎的话了。你们认为怎么样？"众人都定他该死的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们已经听见他这僭妄的话了。你们的意见如何？」他们都定他该死的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.
verses.textEnEsv: You have heard his blasphemy. What is your decision?" And they all condemned him as deserving death.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?" And they all condemned Him to be deserving of death.
verses.textEnNlt: You have all heard his blasphemy. What is your verdict?" "Guilty!" they all cried. "He deserves to die!"
verses.textEnNasb: You have heard the blasphemy; how does it seem to you?" And they all condemned Him as deserving of death.
verses.textEn: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.

verses.textZh: 于是有些人就向他吐唾沫，蒙住他的脸。用拳头打他，对他说："你说预言吧！"差役把他拉去，用手掌打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有些人就向他吐唾沫，蒙住他的脸。用拳头打他，对他说："你说预言吧！"差役把他拉去，用手掌打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 就有人吐唾沫在他脸上，又蒙着他的脸，用拳头打他，对他说：「你说预言吧！」差役接过他来，用手掌打他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, "Prophesy!" And the guards took him and beat him.
verses.textEnEsv: And some began to spit on him and to cover his face and to strike him, saying to him, "Prophesy!" And the guards received him with blows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some began to spit on Him, and to blindfold Him, and to beat Him, and to say to Him, "Prophesy!" And the officers struck Him with the palms of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Then some of them began to spit at him, and they blindfolded him and beat him with their fists. "Prophesy to us," they jeered. And the guards slapped him as they took him away.
verses.textEnNasb: And some began to spit on Him, and to blindfold Him, and to beat Him with their fists and say to Him, "Prophesy!" Then the officers took custody of Him and slapped Him in the face.
verses.textEn: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, "Prophesy!" And the guards took him and beat him.

verses.textZh: 彼得在下边院子的时候，大祭司的一个婢女来了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得在下边院子的时候，大祭司的一个婢女来了，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得在下边院子里；来了大祭司的一个使女，
verses.textEnNiv: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.
verses.textEnEsv: And as Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Peter was in the courtyard below. One of the servant girls who worked for the high priest came by
verses.textEnNasb: And while Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the slave women of the high priest *came,
verses.textEn: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

verses.textZh: 看见彼得烤火，就瞪着他说："你也是和拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见彼得烤火，就瞪着他说："你也是和拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 见彼得烤火，就看着他，说：「你素来也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。」
verses.textEnNiv: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, "You also were with the Nazarene, Jesus."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, "You also were with Jesus of Nazareth."
verses.textEnNlt: and noticed Peter warming himself at the fire. She looked at him closely and said, "You were one of those with Jesus of Nazareth. "
verses.textEnNasb: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and *said, "You were with Jesus the Nazarene as well."
verses.textEn: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus," she said.

verses.textZh: 彼得却否认说："我不知道，也不明白你在说甚么！"他就走出去，到了前院，鸡就叫了 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得却否认说："我不知道，也不明白你在说甚么！"他就走出去，到了前院，鸡就叫了 。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却不承认，说：「我不知道，也不明白你说的是什么。」于是出来，到了前院，鸡就叫了。
verses.textEnNiv: But he denied it. "I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about," he said, and went out into the entryway.
verses.textEnEsv: But he denied it, saying, "I neither know nor understand what you mean." And he went out into the gateway and the rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he denied it, saying, "I neither know nor understand what you are saying." And he went out on the porch, and a rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter denied it. "I don’t know what you’re talking about," he said, and he went out into the entryway. Just then, a rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNasb: But he denied it, saying, "I neither know nor understand what you are talking about." And he went out onto the porch.
verses.textEn: But he denied it. "I don’t know or understand what you’re talking about," he said, and went out into the entryway.

verses.textZh: 那婢女看见他，又对站在旁边的人说："这个人也是他们一伙的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那婢女看见他，又对站在旁边的人说："这个人也是他们一伙的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那使女看见他，又对旁边站着的人说：「这也是他们一党的。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, "This fellow is one of them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the servant girl saw him and began again to say to the bystanders, "This man is one of them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant girl saw him again, and began to say to those who stood by, "This is one of them."
verses.textEnNlt: When the servant girl saw him standing there, she began telling the others, "This man is definitely one of them!"
verses.textEnNasb: The slave woman saw him, and began once more to say to the bystanders, "This man is one of them!"
verses.textEn: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, "This fellow is one of them."

verses.textZh: 彼得还是不承认。过了一会，站在旁边的人也对彼得说："你真是他们一伙的，因为你也是加利利人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得还是不承认。过了一会，站在旁边的人也对彼得说："你真是他们一伙的，因为你也是加利利人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得又不承认。过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人又对彼得说：「你真是他们一党的！因为你是加利利人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."
verses.textEnEsv: But again he denied it. And after a little while the bystanders again said to Peter, "Certainly you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he denied it again. And a little later those who stood by said to Peter again, "Surely you are one of them; for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it."
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter denied it again. A little later some of the other bystanders confronted Peter and said, "You must be one of them, because you are a Galilean."
verses.textEnNasb: But again he denied it. And after a little while the bystanders were again saying to Peter, "You really are one of them, for you are a Galilean as well."
verses.textEn: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."

verses.textZh: 彼得就发咒起誓说："我不认得你们说的这个人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就发咒起誓说："我不认得你们说的这个人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就发咒起誓地说：「我不认得你们说的这个人。」
verses.textEnNiv: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, "I don’t know this man you’re talking about."
verses.textEnEsv: But he began to invoke a curse on himself and to swear, "I do not know this man of whom you speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he began to curse and swear, "I do not know this Man of whom you speak!"
verses.textEnNlt: Peter swore, "A curse on me if I’m lying—I don’t know this man you’re talking about!"
verses.textEnNasb: But he began to curse himself and to swear, "I do not know this Man of whom you speak!"
verses.textEn: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, "I don’t know this man you’re talking about."

verses.textZh: 立刻鸡就叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他说过的话："<red>鸡叫两遍以前，你要三次不认我。</red>"他一想起来，就哭了 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 立刻鸡就叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他说过的话："<red>鸡叫两遍以前，你要三次不认我。</red>"他一想起来，就哭了 。
verses.textZhCuv: 立时鸡叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他所说的话：「<red>鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。</red>」思想起来，就哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: <red>“Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times.”</red> And he broke down and wept.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time. And Peter remembered how Jesus had said to him, "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times." And he broke down and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: A second time the rooster crowed. Then Peter called to mind the word that Jesus had said to him, "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times." And when he thought about it, he wept.
verses.textEnNlt: And immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Suddenly, Jesus’ words flashed through Peter’s mind: "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny three times that you even know me." And he broke down and wept.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately a rooster crowed a second time. And Peter remembered how Jesus had made the remark to him, "Before a rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times." And he hurried on and began to weep.
verses.textEn: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: <red>“Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times.”</red> And he broke down and wept.

verses.textZh: 一到清晨，祭司长和长老、经学家以及公议会全体一致议决，把耶稣绑起来，押去交给彼拉多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一到清晨，祭司长和长老、经学家以及公议会全体一致议决，把耶稣绑起来，押去交给彼拉多。
verses.textZhCuv: 一到早晨，祭司长和长老、文士、全公会的人大家商议，就把耶稣捆绑，解去交给彼拉多。
verses.textEnNiv: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as it was morning, the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council. And they bound Jesus and led him away and delivered him over to Pilate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately, in the morning, the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council; and they bound Jesus, led Him away, and delivered Him to Pilate.
verses.textEnNlt: Very early in the morning the leading priests, the elders, and the teachers of religious law—the entire high council —met to discuss their next step. They bound Jesus, led him away, and took him to Pilate, the Roman governor.
verses.textEnNasb: Early in the morning the chief priests with the elders, scribes, and the entire Council immediately held a consultation; and they bound Jesus and led Him away, and turned Him over to Pilate.
verses.textEn: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你已经说了 。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你已经说了 。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多问他说：「<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>你说的是。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" And he answered him, "You have said so."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate asked Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered and said to him, "It is as you say."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?" Jesus replied, "You have said it."
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate questioned Him: "So You are the King of the Jews?" And He answered him, "It is as you say."
verses.textEn: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: 祭司长控告了他许多事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长控告了他许多事。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长告他许多的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chief priests accused him of many things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the chief priests accused Him of many things, but He answered nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leading priests kept accusing him of many crimes,
verses.textEnNasb: And the chief priests started accusing Him of many things.
verses.textEn: The chief priests accused him of many things.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多又问他："你看，他们控告你这么多的事！你甚么都不回答吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多又问他："你看，他们控告你这么多的事！你甚么都不回答吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多又问他说：「你看，他们告你这么多的事，你什么都不回答吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: So again Pilate asked him, "Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of."
verses.textEnEsv: And Pilate again asked him, "Have you no answer to make? See how many charges they bring against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate asked Him again, saying, "Do You answer nothing? See how many things they testify against You!"
verses.textEnNlt: and Pilate asked him, "Aren’t you going to answer them? What about all these charges they are bringing against you?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Pilate questioned Him again, saying, "Do You offer nothing in answer? See how many charges they are bringing against You!"
verses.textEn: So again Pilate asked him, "Aren’t you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of."

verses.textZh: 耶稣还是一言不答，使彼拉多非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还是一言不答，使彼拉多非常惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣仍不回答，以致彼拉多觉得希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate was amazed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate marveled.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said nothing, much to Pilate’s surprise.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said nothing further in answer, so Pilate was amazed.
verses.textEn: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.

verses.textZh: 每逢这节期，彼拉多按着众人所要求的，照例给他们释放一个囚犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢这节期，彼拉多按着众人所要求的，照例给他们释放一个囚犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢这节期，巡抚照众人所求的，释放一个囚犯给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.
verses.textEnEsv: Now at the feast he used to release for them one prisoner for whom they asked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at the feast he was accustomed to releasing one prisoner to them, whomever they requested.
verses.textEnNlt: Now it was the governor’s custom each year during the Passover celebration to release one prisoner—anyone the people requested.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the Passover Feast he used to release for them any one prisoner whom they requested.
verses.textEn: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.

verses.textZh: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人囚禁在一起，他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人囚禁在一起，他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人一同捆绑。他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。
verses.textEnNiv: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.
verses.textEnEsv: And among the rebels in prison, who had committed murder in the insurrection, there was a man called Barabbas.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was one named Barabbas, whowas chained with his fellow rebels; they had committed murder in the rebellion.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the prisoners at that time was Barabbas, a revolutionary who had committed murder in an uprising.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one named Barabbas had been imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder in the revolt.
verses.textEn: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.

verses.textZh: 群众上去，要求彼拉多援例给他们办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众上去，要求彼拉多援例给他们办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人上去求巡抚，照常例给他们办。
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.
verses.textEnEsv: And the crowd came up and began to ask Pilate to do as he usually did for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the multitude, crying aloud, began to ask himtodo just as he had always done for them.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd went to Pilate and asked him to release a prisoner as usual.
verses.textEnNasb: And the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to do as he had been accustomed to do for them.
verses.textEn: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多回答他们："你们要我给你们释放这个犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多回答他们："你们要我给你们释放这个犹太人的王吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「你们要我释放犹太人的王给你们吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate,
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Would you like me to release to you this ‘King of the Jews’?" Pilate asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Pilate answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEn: "Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate,

verses.textZh: 他知道祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣交了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他知道祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣交了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他原晓得，祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣解了来。
verses.textEnNiv: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.
verses.textEnEsv: For he perceived that it was out of envy that the chief priests had delivered him up.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he knew that the chief priests had handed Him over because of envy.
verses.textEnNlt: (For he realized by now that the leading priests had arrested Jesus out of envy.)
verses.textEnNasb: For he was aware that the chief priests had handed Him over because of envy.
verses.textEn: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.

verses.textZh: 祭司长却煽动群众，宁可要总督释放巴拉巴给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长却煽动群众，宁可要总督释放巴拉巴给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是祭司长挑唆众人，宁可释放巴拉巴给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.
verses.textEnEsv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release for them Barabbas instead.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd, so that he should rather release Barabbas to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But at this point the leading priests stirred up the crowd to demand the release of Barabbas instead of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to ask him to release Barabbas for them instead.
verses.textEn: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多又对他们说："那么，你们称为犹太人的王的，你们要我怎样处置他呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多又对他们说："那么，你们称为犹太人的王的，你们要我怎样处置他呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多又说：「那么样，你们所称为犹太人的王，我怎么办他呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?" Pilate asked them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pilate again said to them, "Then what shall I do with the man you call the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate answered and said to them again, "What then do you want me to do withHim whom you call the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate asked them, "Then what should I do with this man you call the king of the Jews?"
verses.textEnNasb: And responding again, Pilate said to them, "Then what shall I do with Him whom you call the King of the Jews?"
verses.textEn: "What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?" Pilate asked them.

verses.textZh: 他们就喊着说："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就喊着说："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Crucify him!" they shouted.
verses.textEnEsv: And they cried out again, "Crucify him."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they cried out again, "Crucify Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: They shouted back, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnNasb: They shouted back, "Crucify Him!"
verses.textEn: "Crucify him!" they shouted.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多说："他作了甚么恶事呢？"众人却更加大声喊叫："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多说："他作了甚么恶事呢？"众人却更加大声喊叫："把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Pilate said to them, "Why? What evil has he done?" But they shouted all the more, "Crucify him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they cried out all the more, "Crucify Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why?" Pilate demanded. "What crime has he committed?" But the mob roared even louder, "Crucify him!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has He done?" But they shouted all the more, "Crucify Him!"
verses.textEn: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

verses.textZh: 彼拉多有意讨好群众，就释放了巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给他们钉十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多有意讨好群众，就释放了巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给他们钉十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多要叫众人喜悦，就释放巴拉巴给他们，将耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
verses.textEnEsv: So Pilate, wishing to satisfy the crowd, released for them Barabbas, and having scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pilate, wanting to gratify the crowd, released Barabbas to them; and he delivered Jesus, after he had scourged Him, to be crucified.
verses.textEnNlt: So to pacify the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He ordered Jesus flogged with a lead-tipped whip, then turned him over to the Roman soldiers to be crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: Intent on satisfying the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas for them, and after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified.
verses.textEn: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

verses.textZh: 士兵把耶稣带进总督府的院子里，召集了全队士兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵把耶稣带进总督府的院子里，召集了全队士兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁把耶稣带进衙门院里，叫齐了全营的兵。
verses.textEnNiv: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.
verses.textEnEsv: And the soldiers led him away inside the palace (that is, the governor’s headquarters), and they called together the whole battalion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the soldiers led Him away into the hall called Praetorium, and they called together the whole garrison.
verses.textEnNlt: The soldiers took Jesus into the courtyard of the governor’s headquarters (called the Praetorium) and called out the entire regiment.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the soldiers took Him away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium), and they *called together the whole Roman cohort.
verses.textEn: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.

verses.textZh: 他们给他披上紫色的外袍，又用荆棘编成冠冕给他戴上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们给他披上紫色的外袍，又用荆棘编成冠冕给他戴上；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们给他穿上紫袍，又用荆棘编做冠冕给他戴上，
verses.textEnNiv: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they clothed him in a purple cloak, and twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they clothed Him with purple; and they twisted a crown of thorns, put it on His head,
verses.textEnNlt: They dressed him in a purple robe, and they wove thorn branches into a crown and put it on his head.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *dressed Him in purple, and after twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on Him;
verses.textEn: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.

verses.textZh: 就向他祝贺说："犹太人的王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就向他祝贺说："犹太人的王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 就庆贺他说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: And they began to call out to him, "Hail, king of the Jews!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they began to salute him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNkjv: and began to salute Him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then they saluted him and taunted, "Hail! King of the Jews!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they began saluting Him: "Hail, King of the Jews!"
verses.textEn: And they began to call out to him, "Hail, king of the Jews!"

verses.textZh: 又用一根芦苇打他的头，向他吐唾沫，并且跪下来拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用一根芦苇打他的头，向他吐唾沫，并且跪下来拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿一根苇子打他的头，吐唾沫在他脸上，屈膝拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were striking his head with a reed and spitting on him and kneeling down in homage to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they struck Him on the head with a reed and spat on Him; and bowing the knee, they worshiped Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And they struck him on the head with a reed stick, spit on him, and dropped to their knees in mock worship.
verses.textEnNasb: And they repeatedly beat His head with a reed and spit on Him, and kneeling, they bowed down before Him.
verses.textEn: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.

verses.textZh: 他们戏弄完了，就把他的紫色的外袍脱下，给他穿回自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们戏弄完了，就把他的紫色的外袍脱下，给他穿回自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had mocked him, they stripped him of the purple cloak and put his own clothes on him. And they led him out to crucify him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had mocked Him, they took the purple off Him, put His own clothes on Him, and led Him out to crucify Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they were finally tired of mocking him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him again. Then they led him away to be crucified.
verses.textEnNasb: And after they had mocked Him, they took the purple cloak off Him and put His own garments on Him. And they *led Him out to crucify Him.
verses.textEn: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

verses.textZh: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚历山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来到，经过那里，士兵就强迫他背着耶稣的十字架。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚历山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来到，经过那里，士兵就强迫他背着耶稣的十字架。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚历山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来，经过那地方，他们就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。
verses.textEnNiv: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: And they compelled a passerby, Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to carry his cross.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they compelled a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, the father of Alexander and Rufus, as he was coming out of the country and passing by, to bear His cross.
verses.textEnNlt: A passerby named Simon, who was from Cyrene, was coming in from the countryside just then, and the soldiers forced him to carry Jesus’ cross. (Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus.)
verses.textEnNasb: And they *compelled a passer-by coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene (the father of Alexander and Rufus), to carry His cross.
verses.textEn: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.

verses.textZh: 他们把耶稣带到各各他地方 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把耶稣带到各各他地方 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们带耶稣到了各各他地方（各各他翻出来就是髑髅地），
verses.textEnNiv: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought him to the place called Golgotha (which means Place of a Skull).
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought Him to the place Golgotha, which is translated, Place of a Skull.
verses.textEnNlt: And they brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha (which means "Place of the Skull").
verses.textEnNasb: Then they *brought Him to the place Golgotha, which is translated, Place of a Skull.
verses.textEn: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means "the place of the skull").

verses.textZh: 拿没药调和的酒给他，他却不接受。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿没药调和的酒给他，他却不接受。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿没药调和的酒给耶稣，他却不受。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they gave Him wine mingled with myrrh to drink, but He did not take it.
verses.textEnNlt: They offered him wine drugged with myrrh, but he refused it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they tried to give Him wine mixed with myrrh; but He did not take it.
verses.textEn: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.

verses.textZh: 他们就把他钉了十字架；又抽签分他的衣服，看谁得着甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把他钉了十字架；又抽签分他的衣服，看谁得着甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是将他钉在十字架上，拈阄分他的衣服，看是谁得什么。
verses.textEnNiv: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.
verses.textEnEsv: And they crucified him and divided his garments among them, casting lots for them, to decide what each should take.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots for them todetermine what every man should take.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the soldiers nailed him to the cross. They divided his clothes and threw dice to decide who would get each piece.
verses.textEnNasb: And they *crucified Him, and *divided up His garments among themselves, casting lots for them to decide what each man would take.

verses.textZhCnvs: 下午三点的时候，耶稣大声呼号："以罗伊，以罗伊，拉马撒巴各大尼？"这句话译出来就是："我的神，我的神，你为甚么离弃我？"
verses.textZhCuv: 申初的时候，耶稣大声喊着说：「以罗伊！以罗伊！拉马撒巴各大尼？」（翻出来就是：我的神！我的神！为什么离弃我？）
verses.textEnNiv: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" (which means "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?").
verses.textEnEsv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" which means, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

verses.textZh: 有一个人跑去拿海绵浸满了酸酒，绑在芦苇上，递给他喝，说："等一等，我们看看以利亚来不来救他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人跑去拿海绵浸满了酸酒，绑在芦苇上，递给他喝，说："等一等，我们看看以利亚来不来救他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人跑去，把海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝，说：「且等着，看以利亚来不来把他取下。」
verses.textEnNiv: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to take him down," he said.

verses.textEnNasb: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, put it on a reed, and gave Him a drink, saying, " Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down."
verses.textEn: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. "Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to take him down," he said.

verses.textEn: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died, he said, "Surely this man was the Son of God!"

verses.textEnNiv: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body.
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council, who was also himself looking for the kingdom of God, took courage and went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when evening had come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph of Arimathea took a risk and went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. (Joseph was an honored member of the high council, and he was waiting for the Kingdom of God to come.)
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph of Arimathea came, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself also waiting for the kingdom of God; and he gathered up courage and went in before Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
verses.textEn: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多惊讶耶稣已经死了，就叫百夫长前来，问他耶稣是不是死了很久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多惊讶耶稣已经死了，就叫百夫长前来，问他耶稣是不是死了很久。

verses.textEnNiv: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate was surprised to hear that he should have already died. And summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he was already dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent council member, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, coming and taking courage, went in to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

verses.textEn: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.

verses.textEnNasb: And after learning this from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
verses.textEn: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.

verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟买了细麻布，把耶稣取下，用细麻布裹好，安放在一个从盘石凿出来的坟墓里，又辊过一块石头来挡住墓门。
