verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph bought a linen shroud, and taking him down, wrapped him in the linen shroud and laid him in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. And he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph bought a long sheet of linen cloth. Then he took Jesus’ body down from the cross, wrapped it in the cloth, and laid it in a tomb that had been carved out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone in front of the entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph bought a linen cloth, took Him down, wrapped Him in the linen cloth, and laid Him in a tomb which had been cut out in the rock; and he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
verses.textEn: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.

verses.textZh: 抹大拉的马利亚和约西的母亲马利亚都看见安放他的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抹大拉的马利亚和约西的母亲马利亚都看见安放他的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 抹大拉的马利亚和约西的母亲马利亚都看见安放他的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.
verses.textEnEsv: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was laid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he bought fine linen, took Him down, and wrapped Him in the linen. And he laid Him in a tomb which had been hewn out of the rock, and rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where Jesus’ body was laid.
verses.textEnNasb: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses were watching to see where He was laid.
verses.textEn: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.

verses.textZh: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚、雅各的母亲马利亚和撒罗米，买了香膏，要去膏耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚、雅各的母亲马利亚和撒罗米，买了香膏，要去膏耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚和雅各的母亲马利亚并撒罗米，买了香膏要去膏耶稣的身体。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, so that they might go and anoint him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, Mary themother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Saturday evening, when the Sabbath ended, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome went out and purchased burial spices so they could anoint Jesus’ body.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might come and anoint Him.
verses.textEn: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus’ body.

verses.textZh: 礼拜日的大清早，出太阳的时候，她们就来到坟墓那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 礼拜日的大清早，出太阳的时候，她们就来到坟墓那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 七日的第一日清早，出太阳的时候，她们来到坟墓那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb
verses.textEnEsv: And very early on the first day of the week, when the sun had risen, they went to the tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Very early in the morning, on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
verses.textEnNlt: Very early on Sunday morning, just at sunrise, they went to the tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: And very early on the first day of the week, they *came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
verses.textEn: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb

verses.textZh: 彼此说："谁可以给我们辊开墓门的石头呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼此说："谁可以给我们辊开墓门的石头呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼此说：「谁给我们把石头从墓门滚开呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: and they asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they were saying to one another, "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance of the tomb?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"
verses.textEnNlt: On the way they were asking each other, "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb?"
verses.textEnNasb: They were saying to one another, "Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb for us?"
verses.textEn: and they asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"

verses.textZh: 原来那块石头非常大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经辊开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来那块石头非常大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经辊开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那石头原来很大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经滚开了。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.
verses.textEnEsv: And looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled back— it was very large.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away—for it was very large.
verses.textEnNlt: But as they arrived, they looked up and saw that the stone, which was very large, had already been rolled aside.
verses.textEnNasb: And looking up, they *noticed that the stone had been rolled away; for it was extremely large.
verses.textEn: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.

verses.textZh: 她们进了坟墓，看见一位身穿白袍的青年，坐在右边，就非常惊恐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们进了坟墓，看见一位身穿白袍的青年，坐在右边，就非常惊恐。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们进了坟墓，看见一个少年人坐在右边，穿着白袍，就甚惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
verses.textEnEsv: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man clothed in a long white robe sitting on the right side; and they were alarmed.
verses.textEnNlt: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man clothed in a white robe sitting on the right side. The women were shocked,
verses.textEnNasb: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting at the right, wearing a white robe; and they were amazed.
verses.textEn: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

verses.textZh: 那青年对她们说："不要惊慌！你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣，他不在这里，已经复活了；请看他们安放他的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那青年对她们说："不要惊慌！你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣，他不在这里，已经复活了；请看他们安放他的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 那少年人对她们说：「不要惊恐！你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣，他已经复活了，不在这里。请看安放他的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen; he is not here. See the place where they laid him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to them, "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid Him.
verses.textEnNlt: but the angel said, "Don’t be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He isn’t here! He is risen from the dead! Look, this is where they laid his body.
verses.textEnNasb: But he *said to them, "Do not be amazed; you are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen; He is not here; see, here is the place where they laid Him.
verses.textEn: "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.

verses.textZh: 你们去告诉他的门徒和彼得：他要比你们先到加利利去，你们在那里必定看见他，正如他从前告诉你们的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们去告诉他的门徒和彼得：他要比你们先到加利利去，你们在那里必定看见他，正如他从前告诉你们的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们可以去告诉他的门徒和彼得，说：『他在你们以先往加利利去。在那里你们要见他，正如他从前所告诉你们的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he is going before you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But go, tell His disciples—and Peter—that He is going before you into Galilee; there you will see Him, as He said to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Now go and tell his disciples, including Peter, that Jesus is going ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you before he died."
verses.textEnNasb: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you to Galilee; there you will see Him, just as He told you.’ "
verses.textEn: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ "

verses.textZh: 因为惊恐战栗，她们一从坟墓出来就逃跑；由于害怕，她们甚么也没有告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为惊恐战栗，她们一从坟墓出来就逃跑；由于害怕，她们甚么也没有告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们就出来，从坟墓那里逃跑，又发抖又惊奇，什么也不告诉人，因为她们害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. [The earliest manuscripts and some other ancient witnesses do not have verses 9–20.]
verses.textEnEsv: And they went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had seized them, and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid. [Some of the earliest manuscripts do not include 16:9–20.] [[
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out quickly and fled from the tomb, for they trembled and were amazed. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: The women fled from the tomb, trembling and bewildered, and they said nothing to anyone because they were too frightened. ---------- [The most ancient manuscripts of Mark conclude with verse 16:8. Later manuscripts add one or both of the following endings.] [Shorter Ending of Mark] Then they briefly reported all this to Peter and his companions. Afterward Jesus himself sent them out from east to west with the sacred and unfailing message of salvation that gives eternal life. Amen. [Longer Ending of Mark]
verses.textEnNasb: And they went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had gripped them; and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
verses.textEn: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. [The earliest manuscripts and some other ancient witnesses do not have verses 9–20.]

verses.textZh: 礼拜日的清早，耶稣复活了，先向抹大拉的马利亚显现，耶稣曾经从她身上赶出七个鬼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 礼拜日的清早，耶稣复活了，先向抹大拉的马利亚显现，耶稣曾经从她身上赶出七个鬼。
verses.textZhCuv: 在七日的第一日清早，耶稣复活了，就先向抹大拉的马利亚显现（耶稣从她身上曾赶出七个鬼）。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when he rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He rose early on the first day of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven demons.
verses.textEnNlt: After Jesus rose from the dead early on Sunday morning, the first person who saw him was Mary Magdalene, the woman from whom he had cast out seven demons.
verses.textEnNasb: [[ Now after He had risen early on the first day of the week, He first appeared to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had cast out seven demons.
verses.textEn: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.

verses.textZh: 她就去告诉那些向来和耶稣在一起的人，那时他们正在悲哀哭泣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就去告诉那些向来和耶稣在一起的人，那时他们正在悲哀哭泣。
verses.textZhCuv: 她去告诉那向来跟随耶稣的人；那时他们正哀恸哭泣。
verses.textEnNiv: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.
verses.textEnEsv: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: She went and told those who had been with Him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: She went to the disciples, who were grieving and weeping, and told them what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: She went and reported to those who had been with Him, while they were mourning and weeping.
verses.textEn: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.

verses.textZh: 他们听见耶稣活了，又被马利亚看见了，却不相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见耶稣活了，又被马利亚看见了，却不相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见耶稣活了，被马利亚看见，却是不信。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they would not believe it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they did not believe.
verses.textEnNlt: But when she told them that Jesus was alive and she had seen him, they didn’t believe her.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they refused to believe it.
verses.textEn: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，门徒中有两个人往乡下去，正走路的时候，耶稣用另外的形象，向他们显现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，门徒中有两个人往乡下去，正走路的时候，耶稣用另外的形象，向他们显现，
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，门徒中间有两个人往乡下去。走路的时候，耶稣变了形象，向他们显现。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things he appeared in another form to two of them, as they were walking into the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that, He appeared in another form to two of them as they walked and went into the country.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward he appeared in a different form to two of his followers who were walking from Jerusalem into the country.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after that, He appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking along on their way to the country.
verses.textEn: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.

verses.textZh: 他们就去告诉其他的人，那些人也不相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就去告诉其他的人，那些人也不相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就去告诉其余的门徒；其余的门徒也是不信。
verses.textEnNiv: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went back and told the rest, but they did not believe them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went and told it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
verses.textEnNlt: They rushed back to tell the others, but no one believed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went away and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them, either.
verses.textEn: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.

verses.textZh: 后来，十一个门徒吃饭的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们的不信和心硬，因为他们不信那些在他复活以后见过他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，十一个门徒吃饭的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们的不信和心硬，因为他们不信那些在他复活以后见过他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，十一个门徒坐席的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们不信，心里刚硬，因为他们不信那些在他复活以后看见他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward he appeared to the eleven themselves as they were reclining at table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Later He appeared to the eleven as they sat at the table; and He rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.
verses.textEnNlt: Still later he appeared to the eleven disciples as they were eating together. He rebuked them for their stubborn unbelief because they refused to believe those who had seen him after he had been raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Later He appeared to the eleven disciples themselves as they were reclining at the table; and He reprimanded them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who had seen Him after He had risen from the dead.
verses.textEn: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

verses.textZh: 他又对他们说："你们到全世界去，向所有的人传福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对他们说："你们到全世界去，向所有的人传福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对他们说：「你们往普天下去，传福音给万民 听。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.textEnNlt: And then he told them, "Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
verses.textEn: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.

verses.textZh: 信而受洗的必定得救，不信的必被定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信而受洗的必定得救，不信的必被定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who believes and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe will be condemned.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who has believed and has been baptized will be saved; but the one who has not believed will be condemned.
verses.textEn: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.

verses.textZh: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼，用新方言说话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼，用新方言说话，
verses.textZhCuv: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼；说新方言；
verses.textEnNiv: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
verses.textEnEsv: And these signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
verses.textEnNkjv: And these signs will follow those who believe: In My name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new tongues;
verses.textEnNlt: These miraculous signs will accompany those who believe: They will cast out demons in my name, and they will speak in new languages.
verses.textEnNasb: These signs will accompany those who have believed: in My name they will cast out demons, they will speak with new tongues;
verses.textEn: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

verses.textZh: 用手握蛇，喝了甚么毒物也不受害，手按病人就必好了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 用手握蛇，喝了甚么毒物也不受害，手按病人就必好了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 手能拿蛇；若喝了什么毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」
verses.textEnNiv: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."
verses.textEnEsv: they will pick up serpents with their hands; and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not hurt them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will recover."
verses.textEnNkjv: they will take up serpents; and if they drink anything deadly, it will by no means hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover."
verses.textEnNlt: They will be able to handle snakes with safety, and if they drink anything poisonous, it won’t hurt them. They will be able to place their hands on the sick, and they will be healed."
verses.textEnNasb: they will pick up serpents, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover."
verses.textEn: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."

verses.textZh: 主耶稣向门徒讲完了话，就被接到天上，坐在神的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶稣向门徒讲完了话，就被接到天上，坐在神的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶稣和他们说完了话，后来被接到天上，坐在神的右边。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnEsv: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then, after the Lord had spoken to them, He was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord Jesus had finished talking with them, he was taken up into heaven and sat down in the place of honor at God’s right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, when the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.textEn: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

verses.textZh: 门徒出去，到处传扬福音，主和他们同工，借着相随的神迹，证实所传的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒出去，到处传扬福音，主和他们同工，借着相随的神迹，证实所传的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒出去，到处宣传福音。主和他们同工，用神迹随着，证实所传的道。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went out and preached everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the message by accompanying signs.]]
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word through the accompanying signs. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: And the disciples went everywhere and preached, and the Lord worked through them, confirming what they said by many miraculous signs.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went out and preached everywhere, while the Lord worked with them, and confirmed the word by the signs that followed.]] [[ And they promptly reported all these instructions to Peter and his companions. And after that, Jesus Himself also sent out through them from east to west the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation.]]
verses.textEn: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.
